title: Digital Technology Senior Team Leader/Project Manager – Unified Customer Portal & ServiceNow CSM
description:
**Are you interested in join Project Management Team?**
**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**
**Join our team!**
Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Partner with the Best**
We are seeking a highly skilled Program Manager /Project Manager to lead the delivery, enhancement, and operations of the Unified Customer Portal and ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) & Gen AI capabilities (including Agentic AI) for Cordant Services Business. This role is pivotal in driving the roadmap for the Unified Customer Services Support Program, ensuring seamless integration with upstream and downstream systems, and aligning business requirements with technical execution.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong product management expertise with technical depth, stakeholder management skills, and proven experience in enterprise platform delivery.
  
  
As a
**Digital Technology Senior Team Leader/Project Manager – Unified Customer Portal & ServiceNow CSM**
, you will also be responsible for:
  
  
  

* Roadmap Ownership Drive the strategic roadmap for Unified Customer Services Support, prioritizing enhancements, new features, and operational stability.
* Product Enhancements Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of new functionalities, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
* Integration Management Oversee integrations with multiple upstream and downstream systems, ensuring data consistency, scalability, and automation.
* ServiceNow Gen AI & Agentic AI Prepare the strategy for enabling the Gen AI functionalities for the Cordant Services Tech support business operations
* Data Migration Plan and execute data migration activities, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and minimal disruption to business operations.
* Stakeholder Alignment Collaborate with business stakeholders to capture requirements, manage expectations, and resolve issues/defects effectively.
* Backlog & Issue Tracking Maintain the product backlog and issue tracker, ensuring clear prioritization and timely resolution.
* Requirement Translation Translate business requirements into technical specifications and hand over to development teams for execution.
* Risk Management Identify potential risks, predict challenges, and define mitigation strategies to ensure delivery success.
* Timeline & Delivery Prepare and manage delivery timelines, ensuring projects are executed on schedule and within scope.
* Vendor Management Manage the DevOps vendor resources for prioritization and bandwidth allocation/utilization
* DevOps Lead Drive the Development, enhancement & support and operations for business continuity and future deployments

**Fuel your passion!**
To be successful in this role you will:
  
  
  

* Proven experience as a Program Manager or Project Manager in enterprise platforms.
* Have experience with 8 to 10 years.
* Strong technical understanding of customer support platforms, integrations, and data migration.
* Experience managing backlogs, issue trackers, and agile delivery frameworks.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on execution.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on automation and process optimization.
* Basic understanding of the Gen AI/Agentic AI
* Understanding of the DevOps & Agile methodology
* Basic understanding of Enterprise systems like CRM, ERP and data lakes

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of enterprise architecture principles.
* Familiarity with risk management frameworks and deployment best practices.
* Strong analytical skills to convert complex business needs into actionable technical requirements.
* Strong understanding of the DevOps & Agile methodology including backlog prioritization and sprint planning
* Strong understanding of driving strategic vision into technical roadmaps and leading the execution & delivery

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to lead a high-impact enterprise program.
* Collaborative environment with cross-functional teams and leadership visibility.
* Platform to drive innovation, automation, and customer experience transformation.

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
  
  
**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
  
  
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  
  
Comprehensive private medical care options
  
  
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  
  
Tailored financial programs
  
  
**Additional Elected Or Voluntary Benefits**
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Senior Team leader - Digital Operations
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

title: Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst - Policy
description:
TITLE
  
  
Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst-Policy
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst-Policy, plays a critical role and is responsible for upgrading client applications to the latest base versions. This involves a thorough understanding of the current application landscape and the new version's features and improvements. Post-upgrade, the engineer will identify, debug, and resolve any issues that arise. This ensures that the upgraded applications function seamlessly and meet client expectations. The engineer will analyze client code to identify deviations and determine what can be upgraded directly and what requires client confirmation.
  
  
The Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst-Policy will work closely with various departments, including development, quality assurance, and client support teams, to ensure a smooth upgrade process and effective issue resolution
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Meticulously analyze and assess the impact of upgrades based on release notes and code changes for new release features. This involves understanding the nuances of each release and predicting how these changes will affect the existing applications.
* Debugs custom code and base code to provide workarounds or solutions to third-party implementation teams or customers. This requires a deep understanding of the application and the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.
* Leverage Duck Creek upgrade tools to generate differential analysis and produce low-impact upgrade paths for Duck Creek customers.
* Leverage AI-driven tools and processes to identify automation opportunities and reduce manual effort across product upgrade and certification activities.
* Apply strong product implementation knowledge and technical expertise to effectively support product upgrade and certification processes
* Expected to act independently, demonstrating initiative and self-reliance in managing their tasks and responsibilities.
* Identify opportunities to automate processes or develop utilities that assist in faster and more effective upgrades.
* Interacts with customer counterparts to triage issues and present solutions.
* Reviews, Mentors and Shares knowledge with the team members.
* Informs the Technical Lead and Project Manager of any issues and risk that may affect overall upgrade schedules.

* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:

+ Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
+ Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
+ Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  


* Bachelor’s degree, or higher educational level, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science strongly preferred
* Minimum 3 years’ related industry experience in system development and implementation
* Demonstrated proficiency in Analysis, Development, and Triage.
* Demonstrated proficiency and implementation experience in any of the Duck Creek Policy Product
* Strong understanding of Duck Creek Policy concepts such Policy Transactions and Policy Forms
* Hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, SQL Server, XML/XSLT, REST/SOAP APIs, and Duck Creek extensibility/configuration
* Hands- on experience of Duck Creek Policy debugging tools like Trace Monitor, TSV Monitor etc.
* Experience with SQL query development, stored procedures, database troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Demonstrated proficiency in Insurance domain knowledge

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Knowledge of insurance products a plus
* Experience/knowledge of P&C Insurance software applications a plus
* Experience/knowledge of software development life cycle for P&C insurance software a plus
* Experience developing and troubleshooting integrations between Duck Creek Policy and external systems.
* Good to have knowledge in TFS, GitHub and GIT workflow.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
* Experience in Duck Creek Policy upgrades/certifications and assessing customizations, integrations, and compatibility

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
AI STATEMENT
  
  
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

title: Client Services Manager
description:
-->Who Should Apply

If you've managed real ad budgets across platforms, owned client relationships, can read a dashboard and explain where performance is everything and can create meaningful narratives we would like to meet you.

--> Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Client Servicing Manager who sits at the intersection of client management and hands-on ad operations. You will own client relationships end-to-end while also being deeply involved in campaign execution and performance delivery across multiple self-serve advertising platforms. This is not a purely account management role we need someone who understands the technology, speaks the language of performance, and can translate data into compelling client narratives and business.

**--> Key Responsibilities and Expectations**

--> Client Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, building long-term, trust-based relationships

Lead weekly/monthly client reviews, presenting performance reports, insights, and strategic recommendations

Understand client business objectives deeply and align campaign strategies accordingly

Proactively identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts

Manage client expectations and ensure timely communication on deliverables, escalations, and campaign updates

--> Ad Operations & Campaign Management

Plan, optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), Amazon Advertising, and other self-serve platforms such as LinkedIn, Snapchat, DV360, or programmatic DSPs with the Operations team.

Conduct in-depth audience research, keyword planning, and competitive analysis to inform campaign strategy

Monitor daily spends, budgets, and pacing to ensure efficiency and delivery targets are met

Perform regular A/B testing on creatives, copies, landing pages, and audience segments

Troubleshoot tracking, pixel, and attribution issues across platforms

--> Performance Analysis & Reporting

Create and maintain performance dashboards using tools like Google Looker Studio, or similar ( with the help of tech team)

Analyse campaign data to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization levers

Provide actionable insights and data-backed recommendations to both clients and internal teams

Track and report on KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, LTV, and conversion rates

--> Internal Collaboration

Work closely with creative, content, and strategy teams to brief and deliver campaign assets

Collaborate with the tech/analytics team on tracking setup, UTM frameworks, and attribution models

Mentor and guide junior executives within the client servicing team

Participate in new business pitches and research involving pitches and proposals where required

--> Required Skills & Qualifications

2-3 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on paid media / ad operations

Hands-on, proven experience managing campaigns on two or more of the following platforms:

Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max)

Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram)

Amazon Advertising (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP)

LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Snapchat Ads, DV360, The Trade Desk, or similar

Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics and campaign optimisation techniques

Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), tag management (GTM), and reporting tools

Experience with pixel/conversion tracking setup and troubleshooting

Excellent communication and presentation skills — ability to simplify complex data for clients

Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple accounts simultaneously

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven agency environment

--> Good to Have

Google Ads Certified / Meta Blueprint Certified / Amazon Ads Certified

Experience with e-commerce clients or D2C brands

Familiarity with tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, SpyFu, or SimilarWeb

Knowledge of programmatic advertising and DSP platforms

Exposure to CRM tools like Salesforce or HubSpot

--> What We Offer

Competitive salary + performance incentives

A collaborative, learning-first culture with access to the latest ad tech tools

Clear career growth path — Senior CSM →Assoc Account Director → Account Director

Certifications and upskilling support across platforms

Auburn is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Customer Service Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
**Your future role**
Take on a new challenge and apply your
**customer service, railway systems, and techno-commercial expertise**
in our Parts & Overhaul Services business.
  
  
You’ll lead the end-to-end customer relationship for
**Metro Parts, Repairs, Overhaul and Warranty Services**
, from opportunity identification through order execution, delivery, and payment.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Operations, you’ll drive
**customer satisfaction, delivery performance, business growth, and continuous improvement**
.
  
  
**We’ll look to you for:**

* Managing customer inquiries, orders, returns, complaints, and critical issues
* Coordinating Metro Parts, Repairs, Overhaul and Warranty Services
* Driving techno-commercial plans for Propulsion, Bogies and Drives
* Monitoring delivery KPIs and leading RCA, action plans, and performance reviews
* Identifying customer needs and opportunities and partnering with Sales/Business Development
* Supporting the conversion of ad-hoc Parts & Repairs business into long-term agreements and overhaul opportunities
* Coordinating bids, material planning, stock, and logistics costs
* Supporting reliability improvement and obsolescence solutions with Engineering
* Driving effective use of SAP/GSI and Customer Service tools
* Developing Customer Service competencies within the team
* Ensuring compliance with Quality, ISO and EHS requirements

**All about you**
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that will help you succeed and grow in this role:
  
  

* 12–14 years of relevant experience
* Graduate in Engineering or an Industrial discipline
* Experience in Customer Service, Parts & Overhaul, Repairs, Maintenance, or After-Sales Services
* Knowledge of train parts and sub-assemblies
* Knowledge of Propulsion and Bogie Drives systems
* Strong customer relationship and delivery performance management skills
* Basic knowledge of SAP/GSI
* Understanding of supply chain, inventory, material planning, and MRP
* Good English and Microsoft Office skills
* Strong problem-solving, leadership, and team management capabilities

Railway experience, customer-facing field exposure, Quality/Audit knowledge, and data analytics experience would be advantageous.
  
  
**Your key network and stakeholders**
You’ll work closely with:
  
  

* Parts & Overhaul and Customer Service teams
* Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and Operations
* Sales, Business Development, Tender/Bid teams, and Customer Directors
* ISR, Maintenance, RAMS, and Contract Management
* Customer site and maintenance teams
* External suppliers

**How your success will be measured**

* Parts & Overhaul performance
* On-time delivery and dispatch
* Contractual milestone achievement
* Customer satisfaction
* QCD performance
* REX implementation and audit results
* EHS and process compliance
* Workload and competency development

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join a dynamic Services environment where you’ll combine
**customer management, railway technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and operational delivery**
.
  
  
You’ll collaborate across functions, contribute to Metro Parts & Overhaul activities, develop long-term customer solutions, and help continuously improve service performance.
  
  
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**Important to note**
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Client Service Manager – Equity
description:
About Fintoo

Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and a fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing and tax advisory services. Our philosophy is simple: planning comes before execution, and client interests come first. We combine professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions and work towards their life goals.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Operations & Client Relationship Manager to support our equity team. This is a hybrid role that sits between the investment team, the client facing team, and our Ultra High Net Worth (UHNI) clients. You will own the clarity and accuracy of portfolio communication, keep backend equity operations running smoothly, and make sure client queries are resolved quickly and credibly. The ideal candidate is genuinely curious about equity markets, comfortable with numbers, and polished enough to engage with sophisticated, high-expectation clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. UHNI Client Communication & Relationship Management

• Act as a point of contact for UHNI clients on portfolio performance, holdings, and market developments

• Communicate performance updates clearly, including returns, attribution, benchmark comparison, and drivers of gains or drawdowns

• Convey action items from the investment team (rebalancing, entry/exit levels, corporate actions, rights/buyback/open offer decisions) and follow up to ensure timely client response

• Prepare talking points and briefing notes ahead of client calls and review meetings

• Maintain a record of all client interactions, preferences, mandates, and risk profiles in the CRM

• Handle sensitive client matters with discretion and professionalism

2. Backend Operations & SOP Management

• Execute and monitor day-to-day equity operations in line with documented SOPs

• Coordinate trade instructions, order execution confirmations, settlement, and reconciliation with brokers, custodians, and the back office

• Ensure client portfolios match mandates, investment guidelines, and compliance limits

• Track and process corporate actions (dividends, splits, bonuses, rights issues, mergers)

• Review, update, and improve SOPs; flag process gaps and propose efficiency improvements

• Support audit, compliance, and regulatory documentation requirements (KYC, risk profiling, suitability records)

3. Platform Integration & Systems Support

• Support integration and day-to-day use of portfolio management, order management, CRM, and reporting platforms

• Ensure data flows accurately between trading platforms, custodians, and internal systems

• Perform periodic data reconciliation (holdings, cash, prices, transactions) and escalate discrepancies

• Coordinate with IT/vendors on platform issues, upgrades, and testing (UAT)

• Document workflows and maintain user guides for internal teams

4. Portfolio Performance Reporting

• Prepare periodic (monthly/quarterly) and ad hoc portfolio performance reports for UHNI clients

• Include holdings, allocation, sector/market-cap exposure, realized and unrealized P&L, XIRR/TWRR, and benchmark comparison

• Add concise commentary on market conditions, portfolio positioning, and outlook, in consultation with the research team

• Ensure all reports are accurate, consistently formatted, and delivered on schedule

• Build and maintain dashboards and templates to improve reporting speed and quality

5. Internal Coordination with Client-Facing Teams

• Serve as the equity subject-matter contact for relationship managers and wealth advisors

• Respond to equity-related queries on stocks, portfolio positioning, research views, and market events

• Translate research and portfolio manager views into clear, client-ready language

• Maintain an internal FAQ/knowledge base of common client queries and approved responses

• Escalate complex or high-impact queries to the investment team promptly

6. Research & Market Support

• Track market news, earnings, sector trends, and regulatory changes relevant to client holdings

• Assist the research team with data compilation, earnings summaries, and model updates as needed

• Circulate daily or weekly market and portfolio-relevant updates to internal teams

7. Compliance & Risk Hygiene

• Ensure all client communication complies with regulatory and internal guidelines (including disclosures and record-keeping)

• Maintain confidentiality of client and portfolio data • Flag potential conflicts, errors, or compliance concerns immediately

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business, or a related field. NISM certification (X-A and XB) are a plus

• Experience in equity operations, portfolio servicing, client relationship management, or research support in an asset/wealth management or broking environment

• Working knowledge of equity markets, corporate actions, and portfolio performance measures (XIRR, TWRR)

• Strong Excel skills; familiarity with portfolio management, OMS, and CRM platforms

• Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain performance and market views clearly to senior clients

• High attention to detail, ownership mindset, and strong discretion with confidential information

title: Community Relations Manager
description:
Role Purpose

We are looking for a hands-on manager to develop and manage,combining luxury client relations, community engagement and disciplined CRM management.

This person will take ownership of the participant experience—from someone first

subscribing to communications through to becoming an engaged member,

customer and advocate.

The role requires someone who can build genuine personal relationships while

maintaining the systems, follow-up processes and commercial awareness needed to

make the programme effective.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

1. Programme Development and Ownership

\* Translate Hueb Circle’s purpose into a clear operating plan, engagement calendar

and service standards.

\* Work with leadership to define the experience, benefits and communications

appropriate to subscribers, members and customers.

\* Develop clear onboarding journeys so participants understand what Hueb Circle

offers and how they can participate.

\* Identify meaningful reasons to join and remain involved, beyond discounts and

purchase incentives.

\* Maintain an annual programme calendar and manage agreed budgets, priorities

and delivery timelines.

\* Regularly review the programme and recommend improvements based on

feedback and results.

2. Community Engagement and Relationship Building

\* Act as the primary relationship contact for Hueb Circle participants.

\* Welcome new subscribers, members and customers with appropriate, personalised

communication.

\* Build an understanding of participants’ interests, preferences and connection to

Hueb.

\* Maintain regular contact through relevant messages, invitations and individual

follow-ups.

\* Encourage participation in brand experiences, conversations and events.

\* Identify engaged members and customers who could become advocates or

introduce others to the community.

\* Ensure interactions feel warm, thoughtful and consistent with a luxury brand.

3. CRM and Database Management

\* Own the day-to-day quality and organisation of the Hueb Circle database.

\* Maintain accurate profiles, contact details, communication preferences, interests,

purchase history and relationship notes.

\* Segment the database to support relevant communication and appropriate levels of

attention.

\* Establish processes for capturing new contacts from events, enquiries, referrals

and other approved sources.

\* Create reminders, follow-up schedules and workflows so relationship opportunities

are not missed.

\* Coordinate with technical support or external vendors on CRM configuration,

integrations and automation.

\* Follow company policies on consent, privacy, confidentiality and access to

customer information.

4. Member Communications and Content Coordination

\* Develop a communications calendar covering welcome messages, brand updates,

collection previews, event invitations and personalised outreach.

\* Write or coordinate polished, engaging communications across approved channels,

including email, telephone and messaging.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director and marketing team to maintain Hueb’s

tone, visual standards and brand identity.

\* Adapt communication to different audiences rather than sending the same

message to every contact.

people behind Hueb.

and engagement.

\* Propose and coordinate experiences that make participation in Hueb Circle

valuable.

conversations, styling appointments, trunk shows and selected partner experiences.

\* Manage invitation lists, participant preferences and personalised follow-up.

\* Coordinate with sales teams, retail partners, venues and service providers as

required.

subject to leadership approval.

subsequent relationship development.

concerns are handled promptly.

\* Identify opportunities for relevant recommendations, gifting support and future

appointments.

outreach.

contact.

\* Track enquiries, appointments, referrals and purchases influenced by Hueb Circle.

\* Support repeat purchases and referrals while maintaining the trust and quality of

the community experience.

\* Coordinate carefully with retail partners and internal teams to respect existing

customer relationships and agreed channel arrangements.

\* Distinguish community engagement from immediate buying intent and manage

both appropriately.

8. Reporting and Continuous Improvement

\* Prepare a concise monthly dashboard covering programme activity, engagement

and commercial contribution.

\* Report on database quality, participation, customer feedback and outstanding

follow-up.

\* Identify which activities are building stronger relationships and which need

improvement.

\* Recommend practical changes based on evidence, rather than focusing only on

contact-list growth.

premium lifestyle brands.

through, alongside experience managing a structured programme or database.

communication tools.

promotional.

balanced set of measures:

\* Member participation, response rates and event attendance.

\* Customer satisfaction and quality of feedback.

\* Reactivation of inactive relationships.

\* Qualified appointments, enquiries and referrals generated.

Guidance

Need candidates who combine personal relationship-building ability, luxury service

standards and CRM discipline.

A background limited to social media management, digital advertising, database

administration or event logistics will not, on its own, meet the requirements of this

role.

* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

* Strong sales and key account management experience in medical devices.
* Experience handling multi-state territories and diverse customer segments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Cardiac Rhythm Management devices, Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI), Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR), or Impella therapies.
* Experience managing corporate and government healthcare accounts.
* Knowledge of cardiac electrophysiology procedures and clinical workflows.

title: Client Servicing Manager
description:

- Internal Coordination: Ensure accurate flow of information between clients and internal teams. Maintain clear documentation of briefs, feedback, approvals, changes, timelines and action items.

- Highly organised with strong task and time-management abilities.

- Exceptional eye for detail and accuracy.

- Polite, professional and confident with clients.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven start-up environment.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace / MS Office; project-management tools are a plus.

- Keep tasks structured and follow through reliably.

- Projects delivered on time, accurately and to the expected quality.

- Strong task tracking and consistent follow-ups.

- Minimal errors, delays and communication gaps.

- Onsite

title: Payments Cross-Currency Solutions Specialist - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
**Job summary**
JPMorgan Payments is looking for a business development / solutions Vice President to execute our Cross-Currency Solutions growth strategy. FX and global payments are critical drivers of the international growth agenda for the Payments and FX business.
  
  
The Cross-Currency Solutions Vice President will drive the accelerated growth of the regional and cross-regional Cross-Currency Solutions P&L through a full range of sales and advisory activities.
  
  
The role serves as a subject matter expert in Cross-Currency Solutions, actively supporting client solution pitches, identifying opportunities for growth and digitalizing clients' workflows. The incumbent acts as an advisor and extension of sales for the Payment Sales Managers and Global Corporate Bankers, helping to win new business through Request for Proposals, Differentiated Solution Pitches and leveraging client relationships.
  
  
In addition, the role serves as the voice of the client—channeling client feedback and competitive intelligence back to our product partners to strengthen product and solution features. Cross-Currnecy Solution Specialists stay closely aligned to product governance, legal/compliance/regulatory requirements, market practice and technology/operational constraints. This proximity enables early validation of feasibility, reduces late-stage surprises and rework, and ensures solutions are productized in a way that can be replicated across clients and segments.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Distinct accountability and partnership model: Lead solution feasibility and productization strategy for regulated and complex payment / foreign exchange control-enabled flows, working in close partnership with: Product (owns product vision/roadmap and approval forums); Payments Sales (owns go-to-market execution, pipeline shaping and client engagement, as applicable)
* Drive the outlined strategy for growing the Cross-Currency APAC P&L for the assigned portfolio, leveraging existing JPMorgan relationship, developing new relationships with Corporate Banking and Payments Sales, and CDM Marketer.
* Sales enablement for simple cross-currency payment flows for a defined set of client portfolio: Train relevant coverage partners on cross-currency payment capabilities, including spot foreign exchange payment solutions available via supported payment platforms. This includes the end-to-end payment flow from initiation through automated payment processing, tracking and client reporting.
* Ownership of complex flow / foreign exchange control-enabled solutions: Serve as the primary solution partner for complex client needs, working with Sales (and other stakeholders when applicable) to configure or tailor existing capabilities. As a client-facing Vice President, drive organic growth by increasing penetration with existing clients and pitching solutions to new clients, including proposal responses and bundling of products & solutions, and educate clients on new ways of execution.
* Governance, legal and regulatory rigor (continuous, not episodic): Ensure governance and regulatory alignment are embedded throughout the client solutioning lifecycle. Stay current on product approvals, policy constraints, licensing/regulatory requirements and required controls—reducing late-stage surprises and minimizing rework when feasibility checks happen too late.
* Structured translation layer between Sales and Product: Convert pipeline signals, proposal inputs and client feedback into actionable product requirements, enhancement requests and prioritization inputs. Translate roadmap constraints into clear client positioning, field-ready enablement and guidance on what is feasible now vs. later. Work with Sales to maintain a healthy client pipeline, ensuring involvement across the sales cycle from opportunity identification through solution pitches and winning mandates. The role is expected to support multiple client segments and industries in India and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Coordination between Payments Sales, Corporate and Commercial Banks and CDM Markets for pro-active and target client calling, develop and present client relevant and thoughtful solution presentations and set-out pricing strategy for all of the Cross-Currency Solutions.

**Key Skills**

* Cross-border payments and FX expertise: strong understanding of cross-currency payment flows, foreign exchange, client implementation considerations and operating/processing constraints
* Regulatory and controls mindset: ability to operate effectively within governance frameworks, legal/compliance requirements, and local regulatory expectations applicable to cross-border transactions
* Advisory and Solutioning: capability to assess feasibility early, design repeatable solutions, and standardize patterns that can scale across clients and segments, while taking an consultative approach going beyond the standard product offering.
* Commercial acumen and client-facing leadership: strong executive presence, ability to influence outcomes, and proven experience supporting complex solution pitches and proposal responses
* Stakeholder management: demonstrated ability to drive alignment across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Implementation and Service teams
* Analytical and structured problem solving: ability to leverage data and structured thinking to prioritize opportunities, develop replication strategies, and deliver clear recommendations
* Globalized view: ability to recognize patterns across markets and segments, apply global standards with local expertise.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Significant experience in cross-border payments, transaction banking/cash management and/or FX-related solutions
* Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows and the practicalities of delivery and execution in a regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience partnering across Product, Sales and delivery organizations to deliver client outcomes
* Track record in complex client solutioning, commercialization and supporting proposal responses
* Understanding of APAC regulatory environment related to cash management, account services and foreign exchange

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Verdantis | Mumbai | On-Site

**About the Company**

Verdantis builds MRO360, an AI-native platform that helps maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) teams in asset-heavy industries clean, enrich, reason over, and act on their spare parts, inventory, procurement, and reliability data.

**About the Role**

Our customers are large plants and refineries in energy, manufacturing, mining and CPG that run MRO360 and our MDM product is on top of SAP. Once Delivery hands over a live system, you own the account are the planners and buyers acting on the AI's recommendations, is the customer seeing the savings we promised, will they renew, and where is the next plant or module we should be selling them.

This is not a ticket queue or a relationship-management role. It is a commercial role with a number on it- net revenue retention earned by driving adoption. We are AI-native: the product makes recommendations on its own, and the strongest sign of a healthy account is a plant that has stopped arguing with them. You will also use AI heavily in your own work- usage analysis, QBR decks, value reports, renewal risk scoring and define how a one-person CS function covers a growing book without adding headcount at the same rate.

**What you do**

**Adoption**

* Take formal handover from Delivery at go-live with a written success plan per account: the business outcomes the customer bought (inventory reduction, duplicate elimination, stock-out avoidance), the personas who must use the product, and the usage metrics that prove it.
* Track adoption weekly from product usage data: recommendations generated, accepted, rejected, overridden by plant and by user. Call the customer when the curve flattens, not when the renewal is due.
* Run enablement for new users, new plants and new modules; turn recurring questions into help content and in-product guidance with the product team.
* Produce a quarterly value report per account that puts a currency figure on what the product delivered and presents it to the economic buyer.

**Renewal**

* Own every renewal from 180 days out: health score, risk flags, mitigation plan, commercial proposal, signature.
* Build the renewal risk model- usage, sponsor changes, support history, value delivered and review it with the Leadership monthly.
* Run escalations when things go wrong: pull in Delivery, Engineering early, keep the customer informed, and close the loop in writing.

**Expansion**

* Map each account: plants not yet live, modules not yet bought (equipment criticality, work order management, MDM alongside MRO360), and adjacent business units.
* Qualify expansion opportunities and either close them directly for in-contract add-ons or hand a warm, well-documented opportunity to the account executive for larger deals.
* Turn happy customers into references, case studies and speakers; keep a live list of who will take a call from a prospect.

**Building the function**

* Set up the CS tooling- health scoring, usage dashboards, renewal pipeline using the stack we have and AI where it saves time, rather than buying a CS platform on day one.
* Write the playbook as you go: onboarding checklist, QBR template, renewal cadence, escalation path. The second CS hire should be productive in two weeks because of what you documented.

**What we are looking for**

* 3-5 years in customer success, account management, implementation or pre-sales at a B2B SaaS company. Early in your career, with at least one renewal or expansion you personally carried to signature.
* Commercially minded: comfortable talking price, contract terms and ROI with a VP of Supply Chain or a plant head, and comfortable asking for expansion.
* Reads data before calling the customer: can pull usage numbers, build a health score in a spreadsheet, and tell the difference between a quiet account and a dying one.
* Uses AI daily and can show it: a QBR deck drafted from usage data, a value report generated from a template, a renewal-risk summary produced from support tickets. We will ask for examples.
* Curious about the domain: willing to learn what a reorder point, a material master or a criticality ranking is, because the customer conversation is about their plant, not our features.
* Write clearly and briefly- the value report, the escalation notes, the renewal email and run a meeting with an agenda and a next step.
* Comfortably being the only CS person for a while sets own priorities, asks for help early, does not wait for a process to exist.
* Willing to travel to customer sites, including internationally, around 20% of the time.

**Nice to have**

* Domain exposure to MRO, spare parts, plant maintenance, procurement or supply chain in process or heavy industry.
* Prior experience with SAP MM/PM or another EAM/ERP from the user side.
* Experience setting up CS tooling (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Vitally, or a home-grown stack) or defining a health-score model.
* Basic SQL or spreadsheet modelling for usage and value analysis.
* Prior work at an early-stage or scaling company where you built the function rather than inherited it.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (L3)
description:
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent - Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for an On-Site Technical Account Manager (L3) to act as a dedicated Resident Engineer for a major enterprise deployment. Working directly at the customer site, you will serve as the primary technical bridge between local operations, internal engineering teams, and vendor support to ensure high availability and rapid issue resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Investigate and resolve escalated Hazelcast component issues. Lead root-cause analysis for P1, recurring and critical incidents with Hazelcast support, keep stakeholders informed and track permanent corrective actions through closure. When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned.
* Coordinate Hazelcast support cases for product bugs, patches and escalations; promptly notify RBI of critical defects or security vulnerabilities and track remediation and closure status.
* Recommend, configure and validate RBI-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues.
* Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post-change validation.
* Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure-lifecycle roadmap recommendations.
* Work with RBI’s performance-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before-and-after results.
* Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches.
* Maintain senior-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation.
* Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.

**What You Have**

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high-availability, resilience and distributed-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre-production and production.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations.
* Strong performance-tuning, capacity-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation.
* Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge-transfer guidance.
* Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

* Manage relationships with domestic gift card aggregators and content providers (Pine Labs / Qwikcilver, Vouchagram and others) to ensure catalogue depth, competitive rates, inventory availability and fulfilment reliability — while progressively moving high-volume brands to direct tie-ups where it improves margin.
* Maintain a live brand map and category coverage plan; identify and close gaps against competing distributors and marketplaces.
* Support launch of new global brands entering India, and expand existing brands into new use cases (consumer rewards, employee benefits, channel incentives, corporate gifting).

**Commercials, Margin & Offers**

* Negotiate and continuously improve brand commercials — base discounts, slab-based and volume-linked margins, incentive and rebate structures, marketing support and payment/credit terms.
* Secure differentiated and, where possible, exclusive consumer offers, cashback and promotional constructs that channel partners can merchandise to drive conversion.
* Own brand-wise margin performance; track realised versus contracted margin and drive corrective action with brands and internal teams.
* Build and present brand-wise revenue, volume and margin projections based on inputs from brands, channel partners and the channel sales team; track actuals against plan and explain variances.
* Benchmark competitor commercials and offer constructs in the domestic gift card market and use these insights in negotiations.

**Digital Distribution & Scale (with Channel Partnership Team)**

* Work hand-in-hand with the channel partnership and channel sales teams to enable the domestic gift card catalogue across digital distribution partners — banks, fintech apps, e-commerce and retail platforms, loyalty and rewards programmes, and corporate gifting channels.
* Drive catalogue placement, merchandising, visibility and campaign calendars on partner interfaces, working with the product and marketing teams.
* Translate brand-level commercials into channel-level pricing and incentive constructs that make the business attractive and profitable for distribution partners.
* Run joint business reviews with key channel partners; identify growth levers for under-performing brands and channels and execute against them.
* Partner with the internal marketing team to build promotions, festive and seasonal campaigns and co-branded activity with brands.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the single point of connect between brand partners and internal teams — Product, Technology, Operations, Reconciliation, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Channel Sales.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to set processes for order fulfilment, voucher delivery, inventory availability, refunds and escalations, ensuring a strong end-customer experience at channel partners.
* Work with the Reconciliation and Finance teams on settlement cycles, invoicing, credit and float management, dispute resolution and timely closure of brand and channel reconciliation.
* Coordinate with Technology and Product for API integrations, catalogue management, order-management improvements and new feature rollouts required by brands or channels.
* Manage contract negotiations with brands in collaboration with Legal, Finance, Product and Operations to secure internal approvals and execute opportunities.
* Evaluate the financial and strategic benefit of partnerships and present business cases and portfolio reviews to Euronet management.

**Business Ownership & Governance**

* Carry and deliver the annual revenue, GMV/TPV and margin targets for the domestic gift card portfolio.
* Own all KPIs including the P&L for domestic gift card sales, covering end-to-end management of the sales cycle.
* Maintain governance rhythm — monthly brand reviews, quarterly business reviews with top brands and aggregators, and periodic management reporting on portfolio health.
* Ensure partner contracts, commercial approvals and operating processes remain audit-ready and compliant with internal policy and applicable regulation.

**Requirements**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate the value of epay’s products and distribution reach to brands.
* Result-oriented, self-driven and effective in a fast-paced environment.
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills, commercial acumen and process orientation.
* High customer centricity with focus on partner success and long-term relationships.
* Dynamic professional with a hands-on approach and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders

Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**

title: Manager / Sr Manager - B2B Growth
description:
**About the Company**

This opportunity is with Handelnine Global, an e-commerce company that owns and operates 10+ online retail brands in over 30 countries. The company is profitable, self-funded and has exhibited strong quarter-on-quarter growth in the last 7 years. The company has offices in India as well as the USA and serves global markets including the UK, USA, Europe, Australia, Middle East and Southeast Asia. Handelnine Global is currently in a phase of rapid growth with new brands and markets being launched every quarter.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Work as part of the Growth team, reporting directly to the Growth Head.
* Own the end-to-end B2B sales funnel, from first customer interaction through quotation, negotiation, order confirmation, and overseeing post-sale relationship management.
* Convert inbound B2B leads into profitable, well-margined orders through proactive follow-ups, commercial negotiation, and timely proposal management.
* Engage directly with prospective customers across global markets via phone calls and email to build relationships, drive conversions, and cultivate long-term customer relationships that encourage repeat business.
* Take ownership of key B2B growth metrics, including revenue, gross margin, lead conversion, repeat business, pipeline health, and quarterly sales targets.
* Manage the sales pipeline by prioritising opportunities, maintaining accurate trackers, meeting response timelines, and ensuring consistent follow-through.
* Drive the expansion of our B2B business by identifying and developing new lead generation channels, including global B2B marketplaces.
* Handle bulk order enquiries across a diverse range of product categories, including electronics, beauty & cosmetics, health & nutrition, home & kitchen, toys & games, fitness, fashion, and more.
* Work closely with internal procurement teams to source the right products at competitive prices, ensuring commercial viability while meeting customer requirements.
* Strengthen the commercial engine that powers B2B growth by contributing to sourcing, pricing, shipping, and operational process improvements.
* Run small, data-driven experiments across sales channels, marketplaces, outreach strategies, and pricing models to identify scalable growth opportunities.
* Help build and scale a relatively new business vertical by refining processes, improving systems, documenting SOPs, and enhancing operational efficiency.
* As the business scales, take increasing ownership of the B2B operating rhythm—including pipeline management, reporting, systems, and process governance—with the opportunity to independently lead the B2B vertical in the future.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* This is a hybrid role based in Mumbai, with an expectation of working from the office 2–3 days per week.
* 5–8 years of experience in inside sales, business development, or account management, preferably in a B2B ecommerce environment. Experience working with international customers will be an added advantage.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer satisfaction, pricing, margins, and long-term profitability while confidently negotiating with both customers and suppliers.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills, with the ability to drive timely follow-ups, influence internal stakeholders, and successfully close sales opportunities.
* Highly analytical and comfortable working with numbers, with the ability to prioritise leads, interpret data, perform commercial calculations, and identify opportunities for optimisation.
* Well-organised with strong project management skills, process discipline, and follow-through. The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple opportunities simultaneously while consistently meeting deadlines.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability, with a proactive approach to identifying problems, driving solutions, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Candidates with experience in fast-paced startup environments or scaling new business verticals will be preferred.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new products, markets, systems, and commercial processes, including international sourcing and cross-border trade requirements.
* The candidate should share our mindset of working with incremental improvements and must be open to learn new things quickly. We are looking for someone who can work independently with a result-focus and is not afraid to experiment within accountability.
* The candidate should be solution-oriented with the ability to think clearly, logically and even laterally, when presented with a problem. We need someone who can communicate freely and fluently, and collaborate effectively with customers and stakeholders across geographies.

title: Premier Relationship Manager (Rajkot)
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
Wealth and Personal Banking serves more than 50 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and protect and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Wealth and Personal Banking-Overseas Indian team.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the
**Premier Banking**
team.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager or Corporate Executive Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans.
  
  
You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions.
  
  
Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Business Impact:**

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products

**Client Management**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development**

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**
**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements:**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Industry Experience:

+ GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of relevant experience.

* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licences and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: India Customer Success Leader
description:
NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered through advanced analytics and state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™.

NIQ operates in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population. For more information, visit
https://www.niq.com
.

**Job Description**

**India Customer Success Leader**

**Location: Gurgaon/ Mumbai**

**The Role**

We are seeking a transformational Customer Success & Consulting Leader to drive strategic growth, customer value realization, and executive engagement across NielsenIQ’s FMCG and Technology & Durables businesses in India. This leader will define and execute the customer success strategy, build deep C-suite relationships, and position NIQ as a trusted strategic partner for some of India's leading organizations.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, consulting expertise, customer leadership, and people management capabilities to accelerate growth, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver measurable business outcomes. They will serve as the voice of the customer internally while influencing strategic decisions across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Operations teams.

This highly visible leadership role offers the opportunity to shape a future-ready Customer Success organization, foster a culture of collaboration and excellence, and influence the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model

**Key Leadership Accountabilities**

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Build and manage strategic relationships with C-suite executives across key customer accounts, positioning NIQ as a trusted advisor and growth partner for both the verticals
* Act as the voice of customers within NielsenIQ, ensuring customer priorities are reflected in product innovation, business planning, and service delivery strategies
* Lead customer transformation conversations, connecting market intelligence, analytics, and insights to measurable business outcomes. Drive customer adoption, value realization, retention, and long-term partnership growth
* Serve as the executive escalation point for critical customer opportunities and challenges

**Drive Commercial Growth**

* Drive a disciplined account growth strategy by identifying whitespace opportunities, expanding strategic partnerships, and accelerating cross-sell and upsell initiatives
* Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Pricing, and Operations teams to unlock sustainable growth and maximize customer lifetime value
* Influence revenue growth by aligning customer priorities with NIQ capabilities and innovation roadmap
* Create a scalable framework for value-based customer engagement that strengthens loyalty and accelerates growth

**Lead a High-Performing Organization**

* Inspire, align, and empower a high-performing Customer Success and Consulting organization to achieve ambitious growth and customer impact objectives
* Develop future-ready capabilities and a strong leadership pipeline through coaching, talent development, mentoring, and succession planning
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, customer centricity, and excellence
* Drive organizational effectiveness through clear governance, workforce planning, resource allocation, and fit-for-purpose operating models
* Champion employee engagement, inclusion, and continuous learning to build a best-in-class Customer Success function

**Shape Cross-Functional Strategy**

* Influence strategic priorities and decisions across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Operations, and Analytics teams to deliver integrated customer outcomes
* Translate customer needs and market opportunities into clear priorities for business planning, solution development, and service innovation
* Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, operational excellence, solution adoption, and overall business performance
* Establish strong alignment and accountability across functions to ensure consistent execution against strategic customer commitments
* Contribute customer and market perspectives to NielsenIQ’s broader India business strategy and innovation agenda

**E**
**stablish Customer Success Excellence**

* Define and institutionalize Customer Success methodologies, performance standards, governance mechanisms, and operating rhythms across the organization
* Build differentiated and scalable customer engagement models based on customer needs, strategic value, and growth potential
* Establish a disciplined approach to measuring customer health, adoption, value realization, satisfaction, retention, and growth
* Leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to proactively identify risks, resolve barriers, and unlock growth opportunities
* Drive continuous improvement across customer experience, service quality, consulting effectiveness, and operational efficiency
* Embed best practices and capability-building programs that strengthen Customer Success maturity and deliver consistent customer outcomes

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful leader will:

* Elevate NielsenIQ's strategic position with key customers
* Increase customer retention, advocacy, and lifetime value
* Accelerate revenue growth across existing customer portfolios
* Strengthen executive-level customer relationships
* Improve Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and customer satisfaction metrics
* Build a highly engaged and high-performing team
* Drive greater adoption of NielsenIQ's analytics, measurement, and consulting solutions
* Create a scalable and future-ready Customer Success organization

**Why This Role?**

This is not a traditional Customer Success leadership position.

It is an opportunity to lead a strategically important function at the intersection of customer growth, consulting, analytics, and commercial strategy. You will shape how some of the world's leading brands leverage data and insights to make critical business decisions while building a high-performing team and influencing the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of progressive leadership experience across Customer Success, Consulting, Consumer Intelligence, FMCG, Retail, Analytics, Professional Services, or related industries
* Proven track record of leading large customer-facing teams, driving customer outcomes, and delivering sustainable business growth
* Demonstrated success building strategic client partnerships and influencing C-suite stakeholders
* Strong commercial mindset with experience identifying and converting growth opportunities through expansion, cross-sell, and value-based engagement
* Strong understanding of how data, analytics, insights, and measurement solutions drive business performance and customer outcomes
* Experience working with FMCG clients and a strong understanding of the consumer goods landscape will be a distinct advantage
* Experience in market research, consumer intelligence, data-driven consulting, or value-based solution selling is preferred

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs-ai-safety-policies/

  

**About NIQ**

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve.
