title: Sale Manager- Battery Materials
description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
  
  
We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
  
  
Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities .
  
  
**About The Role**
The position is responsible for driving the growth of BASF Battery Materials across South Asia & ASEAN by developing customers, advancing product qualifications and commercializing cathode active materials. The individual will coordinate effectively across internal functions and external stakeholders to drive lengthy customer qualification and commercialization cycles.
  
  

* Execute the regional business strategy by identifying priority customers and translating market needs into targeted commercial actions.
* Work closely with Regional and Global teams for effective cross-collaboration (e.g. R&D).
* Develop market potential through lead generation, opportunity qualification, forecasting, product recommendations and support qualification.
* Strengthen existing customer relationships while building new strategic accounts and partnerships across hierarchical levels at customers’ organization.
* Build BASF’s position and network as a trusted industry partner through active participation in conferences, exhibitions, roadshows and automotive forums..

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Regional business development: Build and execute the regional growth plan for South Asia and ASEAN, prioritize target markets and customers, and develop a qualified opportunity pipeline.
* Customer acquisition and account development: Engage cell manufacturers, battery producers, OEMs and ecosystem partners; build strategic relationships and convert qualified opportunities into sustainable business.
* Qualification and commercialization: Lead customer programs from technical alignment and sampling through qualification, commercial framework finalization, contract negotiation and first regular supply.
* Market and competitor intelligence: Monitor customer investments, technology choices, localization trends, policy developments and competitor activity, and translate insights into commercial priorities and actions.
* Cross-functional coordination: Collaborate with regional product management, R&D, technical service and supply chain, as well as local finance and legal teams, to assess commercial risks and liabilities and support well-informed customer negotiations.
* Sales forecasting and reporting: Monitor sales performance, pipeline status and market trends; maintain accurate forecasts and provide timely, actionable updates to senior management.
* Compliance and regulatory affairs: Remain current on relevant policy frameworks, regulatory requirements and industry standards, and ensure commercial activities comply with applicable internal and external requirements.

+ Compliance in accordance with BASF Code of Conduct means adherence to:

- Applicable laws and regulations,
- Internal guidelines and policies, and
- Ethical business practices

+ Keep the Managing Director informed of any and all matters concerning or impacting Compliance from time to time.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree - Chemical Sciences or Chemical Engineering; Executive management program or MBA preferred.
* 5-10 years in Sales of similar business line or Technical sales in chemical industry.
* Proven track record of success in sales roles within the sector or related technologies.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders at all levels.
* Strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset and a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing business opportunities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software; experience with Salesforce or similar platforms is a plus.
* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients, attend industry conferences, and participate in networking events.

title: MDS AMEA Customer Experience Regional Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**
You are part of a team that experiments with cutting-edge technologies, delivering solutions revealed as a result of the testing and learnings, and developing strong partnerships to enable growth through innovation and agile methodologies.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will implement pilot projects to drive disruptive ideas across the organization, using the learnings from these projects to inform decisions on whether to incorporate them as a portfolio project or to introduce them as a new proof of concept. You will also get to experiment with cutting-edge technologies while at the same time building strong partnerships within the business to build a strong pipeline of ideas to pursue. In addition, you will get to bring the outside in by building relationships with start-ups and building your knowledge of actual proof-of-concept cases, and scope, align, adopt and leverage technology for respective learnings and pilots.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
  
  

* Project management including knowledge of Agile
* Technical expertise and a passion for innovation, understanding a variety of disruptive technology products and services
* Technical and business acumen to evaluate opportunities with internal and external partners
* Machine learning/artificial intelligence programming languages
* The start-up landscape
* Familiarity with the fast-moving consumer goods or related sector
* Leading internal and external teams through complex challenges and developing creative solutions/options
* Driving for results and Analytical Skills

**More About This Role**
**What you need to know about this position:**
This is a hands-on leadership role with a
**Product mindset**
— not a coordination or engagement function. The OTC Regional Success Manager is the
**regional integrator**
across all four OTC product areas, responsible for connecting strategy to execution and ensuring value delivery at scale.
  
  
The role holder acts as the single point of accountability at the regional level for:
  
  

* Synergizing business requirements across Business Units
* Maintaining real-time visibility on project portfolio and operations performance
* Driving digital adoption of OTC tools
* Holding Product Managers and Operations leaders accountable for outcomes

This role spans all four OTC product areas:
  
  

* Order Capture - End-to-end order intake, validation, EDI/portal management
* Order Fulfillment - Order processing, availability, delivery execution & monitoring
* Bill to Cash - Invoicing, collections, cash application, dispute resolution
* Customer Care - Customer query handling, issue resolution, service performance

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**
**Regional OTC Community of Practice & Governance**

* Establish and sustain a Regional OTC Community of Practice spanning all four product areas.
* Drive a monthly governance cadence with structured inputs/outputs that feed all downstream accountabilities.
* Ensure the Community of Practice serves as the activation engine for change adoption, best practice sharing, and regional alignment.
* Curate and escalate regional themes, pain points, and opportunities into global product and operations forums.

**Business Requirements Synergization & Gatekeeper Role**

* Synergize and rationalize OTC business requirements (BRDs) at regional level in partnership with OTC Product Business Analysts.
* Act as the gatekeeper to prevent BU-level fragmentation — blocking unauthorized customizations in the form of MEs, siloed projects, shadow IT, or ungoverned local builds.
* Ensure all regional requirements are aligned with the enterprise product roadmap and S4/HANA migration timelines.
* Provide a consolidated regional demand view to Global Product Managers for backlog prioritization.

**Project Portfolio Visibility & Accountability**

* Own the OTC Project Portfolio view — maintaining real-time visibility across MEs, ND Projects, and Celonis-linked value delivery initiatives.
* Connect the dots between Funding, Cost, and Value Realization — ensuring every investment has a measurable outcome.
* Hold Product Managers accountable for delivery gaps, timeline slippages, and value leakage.
* Provide executive-ready portfolio reporting (weekly/monthly) to the Global OTC Lead and regional stakeholders.

**BPO Operations Performance & Accountability**

* Own the BPO Operations performance lens — tracking Celonis KPIs across the regional operations footprint.
* Hold Operations Leaders and OTC Product Managers accountable for performance gaps against contracted SLAs and KPIs.
* Drive corrective action plans when performance deviates from targets — not just flagging, but fixing.
* Partner with BPO governance leads to ensure operational insights inform technology roadmap priorities.

**Digital Adoption & Value Realization**

* Drive digital adoption of OTC tools (Celonis, SAP, Non-SAP) by setting adoption targets and measuring usage.
* Leverage the Community of Practice as the primary channel for driving tool awareness, training, and behavioral change.
* Track adoption metrics at country level to identify laggards and deploy targeted interventions.
* Ensure adoption translates to measurable business value (not just login counts, but process improvement outcomes).

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in OTC/shared services operations, product management, or transformation leadership.
* 3+ years in a senior role (Senior Manager or Director) with cross-functional accountability.
* Proven track record of driving adoption and value realization across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience in OTC / Order Management / Finance shared services in a large CPG/FMCG or similar enterprise.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a gatekeeper — saying “no” to fragmentation while maintaining stakeholder relationships.
* Experience with process mining tools (Celonis preferred) and linking process insights to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with Agile product management frameworks and portfolio governance.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of OTC end-to-end processes: Order Capture, Fulfillment, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute Management, and Customer Care.
* Working knowledge of SAP ECC / S4HANA OTC modules (SD, FI-AR).
* Proficiency in Celonis — ability to interpret process mining data and translate into action.
* Familiarity with project portfolio management tools and dashboards.
* Data literacy — ability to connect cost, adoption, and value metrics into a coherent narrative.
* Financial acumen — understanding of funding models, cost allocation, and value realization tracking.

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience across fast growing FMCG brands

**Work arrangement:**

Full-time, on-site | Worli, Mumbai

**Key Responsibilities:*****Revenue Strategy & Channel Ownership***

* Own the overall revenue plan and delivery against monthly, quarterly and annual business targets.
* Develop channel-wise growth strategies and targets across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and GT/MT.
* Track revenue, orders, average order value, repeat behaviour, channel mix and growth trends; identify gaps and build clear action plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve channel productivity, expand distribution, increase product visibility and accelerate sell-through.
* Build a strong understanding of the economics, operating models and growth levers of each channel.

***Commercial Planning & Performance***

* Build and maintain revenue forecasts, budgets, monthly business plans and channel-wise performance dashboards.
* Monitor net sales, gross-to-net movements, discounts, promotions, commissions, trade spends and contribution margins.
* Strategize on & Evaluate the commercial impact of offers, bundles, pricing, assortment, launches and channel-specific promotions.
* Partner with Finance to track revenue realisation, channel costs, profitability, reconciliations and business performance.
* Use data to distinguish between topline growth and profitable, sustainable growth.

***Channel Partner & Account Management***

* Build and manage working relationships with marketplace, quick-commerce and other channel partners.
* Coordinate with channel teams on onboarding, assortment, catalogue readiness, visibility plans, promotional calendars and business reviews.
* Track channel-specific requirements, commercial terms, campaign opportunities and execution timelines.
* Work with partners to address sales or operational bottlenecks and improve availability, discoverability and conversion.

***Growth & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work closely with the Performance Marketing Associate to connect paid media performance with overall revenue outcomes, channel priorities and business targets.
* Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to translate consumer, category and channel insights into campaigns, launches, offers and growth initiatives.
* Partner with Supply Chain & Operations on demand forecasts, inventory availability, replenishment priorities and launch planning to minimise stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Work with Finance to ensure that revenue reporting, budgets, channel costs and profitability metrics are accurate and timely.
* Bring together insights from D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should focus.

***Reporting & Business Reviews***

* Own the weekly and monthly revenue review cadence, including channel-wise performance against targets.
* Create clear, decision-oriented reports that explain performance drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Establish consistent metrics, reporting definitions and processes so that leadership has a reliable view of business performance.
* Translate analysis into decisions and follow through to ensure agreed actions are implemented.

**What We're Looking For**

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in revenue, sales, business growth, category management, e-commerce or commercial roles.
* Previous experience in fast-paced FMCG or consumer brands is ideal; experience in D2C, beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness or lifestyle is highly relevant.
* Strong understanding of multi-channel consumer businesses, ideally spanning D2C, e-commerce marketplaces and quick commerce.
* Demonstrated ability to own revenue targets, build forecasts and translate business goals into channel-level plans.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including familiarity with net revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, discounts, trade spends and channel economics.
* Comfortable working with data, building and interpreting dashboards, and using Excel/Google Sheets to drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder and partner-management skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external platforms.
* A hands-on, ownership-oriented approach and the ability to operate in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Stakeholders & Liaison**

* Founder: revenue priorities, business reviews, growth plans and key commercial decisions.
* Performance Marketing Associate: paid marketing performance, acquisition efficiency, channel contribution and budget priorities.
* Finance: budgets, revenue reporting, reconciliations, channel costs and profitability.
* Brand & Creative: product launches, campaigns, promotions, consumer insights and channel-specific marketing plans.
* Supply Chain & Operations: demand planning, inventory availability, replenishment and fulfilment readiness.
* External channel partners: marketplace, quick-commerce and other sales-platform teams.

﻿

**Preferred Traits**

* Commercially sharp, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of business outcomes.
* A builder mindset: able to create structure, reporting rhythms and processes where they do not yet exist.
* Able to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
* Curious about consumer behaviour, category trends and the evolving Indian beauty and personal-care landscape.
* Clear communicator who can influence stakeholders and turn insights into action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, pace and the demands of building a new consumer category.
* Candidates from Tier-1 institutions will be preferred.

*Project Noon is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.*

title: Practice Development Manager - Medical Devices
description:
**Practice Development Manager (Medical Devices / Digital Dentistry)**

Mumbai | Field sales, full time

I'm hiring a Practice Development Manager in Mumbai for a global MedTech leader in digital dentistry. You'll own a territory of dental and orthodontic practices, grow existing accounts, bring new doctors on board and help them move to digital workflows such as intraoral scanning, digital treatment planning and clear aligner therapy.

This is a sales role with clear numbers attached. What changes is the conversation. You'll sit with doctors and their teams as a business partner, look at how the practice runs and where it can grow, and sell on value rather than price. Parts of the territory are underpenetrated, so we need someone who enjoys building demand from a low base.

**What you'll do**

• Build and run a territory plan using account data and opportunity analysis

• Grow revenue with existing doctors and activate new practices

• Run consultative, value-led conversations with clinicians and handle competitive objections

• Drive adoption of digital workflows and help practices fit them into daily operations

• Work with clinical, marketing and training teams on doctor education and events

**What you need**

• 6 to 9 years of sales experience, with at least 4 years in medical devices

• Direct selling to doctors (surgeons, specialists, dentists). This is mandatory. Distributor-only or trade sales profiles won't fit

• Experience with an MNC medical device company or a global MNC pharma company

• A record of beating targets that you can back with numbers: rankings, awards, growth %

• Stable career history, around 2.5 to 3 years or more in each organisation

• Experience growing a low-revenue or new territory

• Degree in science, pharmacy, biomedical, engineering or similar. MBA is a plus

Dental or orthodontic experience helps but isn't required. Backgrounds that tend to do well: orthopaedics, cardiology, ophthalmology and surgical devices, diagnostics, capital equipment, and specialty pharma with strong doctor relationships.

**Package**

Fixed CTC up to ₹20 LPA, plus retirals, incentives of up to 65%, and medical insurance.

Many device sales people see dentistry as niche. In practice, this role builds clinician influence, digital adoption skills, territory ownership and practice consulting experience, all of which carry across healthcare technology. The company is also expanding its presence in India.

To apply, send your CV to megha@peopleedgehr.com or WhatsApp +91 93563 96466. Please mention your current CTC, notice period and target achievement for the last two years.

title: Customer Success Manager II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Role**
**Job Description**
As the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners, this role involves relationship management with technical know-how. The position requires proactive communication, troubleshooting, and quality management, while also focusing on upsell opportunities and customer health. Key responsibilities include handling escalations, developing action plans, managing reports and dashboards, coordinating product updates and integrations, and maintaining customer-specific playbooks. This role demands a blend of customer service, industry expertise, and strategic thinking to ensure customer satisfaction and to drive business growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for top tier global Gracenote customers and partners
* Follow a cadence with clients, including dashboard and report reviews
* Create and deliver Quarterly Business Review (QBR) presentations, documenting highlights and action items.
* Monitor and ensure adherence to contractual commitments, including SLAs and NPS
* Drive internal engagement around upcoming renewals
* Gather valuable feedback on customer/partner strategic goals and recommend solutions for customer use cases with a focus on upsell opportunities
* Provide visibility to management on overall customer and partner health
* Strict adherence to adopt tools defined to track customer adoption, usage, health and other relevant metrics
* Drive internal improvements to enhance the customer/partner experience
* Handle quality escalations and issues unresolved through standard Customer Care processes, collaborating with internal departments to ensure timely resolution and preventive measures.
* Initiate and monitor action plans for identified quality trends and provide regular progress updates to customers/partners
* Coordinate data and information in response to and drafting of RFP/RFIs/SOWs and other new customer opportunity inquiries and proposals.
* Manage copyright infringement escalations
* Identify customers to receive standard Customer Dashboards, Quality Reports, and Product Usage Reports
* Coordinate setup of non-standard customer reports and dashboards as needed
* Work with management to design and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) for assigned segment
* Review key performance indicators (KPIs) regularly with customers/partners
* Communicate essential details to customers/partners about product retirements and replacement solutions
* Ensure customer readiness for new product features integration
* Coordinate completion of and deliver Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for all Severity Level 1 Discrepancies and Quality Trends (as needed)
* Coordinate setup and delivery of new metadata for customers (new license deals) or partnership deals
* Manage customer/partner deliveries and communication for limited release products
* Create Product Inquiry tickets and coordinate customer responses
* Create and maintain customer and partner-specific playbooks

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience working in a global technical account management role demonstrating successful customer satisfaction and relationship management outcomes
* 3+ years of experience working with global accounts in the Media & Entertainment space; specifically with Platforms, Consumer Electronics, Pay TV or Publishers
* 4+ years of technical implementation experience with top global customers and partners
* 4+ years of hands on experience driving solutions and identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities
* Ability to work daytime hours for the regions of assigned global customers
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities for interacting with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve complex issues and find mutually beneficial solutions
* Project management experience, including skills to coordinate multiple tasks, deadlines, and stakeholders
* Expert-level presentation skills
* Support the Customer & Partnerships Success team with internal Crisis Management, as needed
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities efficiently and independently
* Flexibility to handle various customer needs and changing product landscapes
* Proficiency in creating and maintaining documentation
* Experience guiding customers and partners through complex changes
* Data analysis experience, including the ability to design, interpret and present data
* Ability to travel as needed to customer locations/trade shows

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Manager, Advisory Services, South Asia
description:
**Summary**
:

Women’s World Banking is looking for a senior team member with at least 10 years of experience to join a forward thinking, cross-functional, high-performing, collaborative team focused on delivering innovative customer experiences, banking services and products, that create business and customer value to serve low-income women.

In this role, you will manage a bouquet of advisory projects independently – this will include relationships management, project management and designing women centered solutions for low-income women. Projects may vary in number, size, and complexity.

The ideal candidate has
*either*
:

1. Credible experience in working with leading financial service providers, especially in credit products & roles (policy, underwriting, operations & collections) OR
2. Credible experience in working as a management consultant on projects in financial services, financial inclusion, or development fields.

You must be a strategic thinker who understands and drives the business case for financial service providers to deliver inclusive financial solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

1. **Design of financial solutions (including credit solutions)**
   in the space of savings, micro –credit, micro-insurance, digital financial services, or last mile solutions for low income women that are viable and scalable for Financial Service Providers:
2. Develop a research-based perspective on financial products for low-income women, including the current context, key challenges, emerging trends, and solutions to increase financial inclusion in the sector.
3. Develop business cases for new product and product enhancements to enable prioritization and justify investments into new and existing products.
4. Conduct industry assessments through stakeholder connections to provide detailed insights into the competitive landscape in the sector that can help define solutions.
5. Establish relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and customer needs, continually enhance project processes, service offering and delivery for partners.

1. **Conceptualization, design & delivery of large-scale program**
   across various initiatives, locations and stakeholders such that solutions designed are implemented at scale and embedded within the ecosystem for impact.
2. Conceptualize large scale delivery program with financial service providers, government bodies, policy makers etc. for national level rollout & scale.
3. Develop strong partnerships and mechanisms to implement projects in the field across multiple geographies and last mile channels. This also includes external support organizations such as last mile agencies (training, sales promotions etc.) and local government bodies (state / region level) to drive project success.
4. Establish relationships and work with a cross-functional teams (internal and partner banks’) to ensure timely delivery of milestones.
5. Lead project management including the development, delivery and monitoring of work plans, milestones, targets, budgets, and both internal and external reporting. Projects may vary in number, size and complexity.

1. **Mange and deepen relationships with institutional partners**
2. Develop, and drive execution of high priority business initiatives, financial products and services for the partner FSPs
3. Establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with key client contacts
4. Initiate and handhold the project through all stages
5. Ensure positive client satisfaction results
6. Influence senior management at existing partner institutions to act on insights and data from the field and bring in technical expertise to support key conversations.
7. Be the “voice of the clients” by interpreting the clients’ business plans and strategic intent into Women’s World Banking
8. Deepen relationships with existing financial services partners and provide expertise that helps build new relationships and alliances

**Required Qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in related field
* 10+ years or more experience in banking, financial services, consulting, or other relevant role
* Demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders (e.g., CXO-level or business heads) to drive adoption of new products, policies, or program changes
* Must be willing to travel extensively within India and be on-site for extended durations

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Direct experience in the credit product lifecycle (e.g., underwriting, portfolio management, collections, operations)
* Interest in the field of women’s financial inclusion and economic empowerment
* Demonstrated ability to execute and successfully manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

**Success within the first 75 days:**

* Assume full responsibility of the position; which includes ownership of 1–2 active projects with defined deliverables and leading client interaction or project updates
* Producing an initial analysis or business case / concept note for a partner

title: Growth Manager
description:
**Company:**

**Job Description**
**IBDIC (Indian Banks' Digital Infrastructure Company)**
is a consortium of eighteen banks – Axis Bank, Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank, Federal Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, IDBI Bank, IDFC Bank, IndusInd Bank, Indian Bank, PNB, RBL Bank, Kotak Bank, South Indian Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, SBI, Yes Bank, Union Bank of India as investors.
  
  
The objective of the organisation is to build Public Digital Infrastructure for Banking using blockchain and other emerging technologies leveraging the network of members to enable high volume and cost- effective financial transactions.
  
  
IBDIC is looking for a dynamic and result-oriented
**Manager – Ecosystem Partnerships & Growth (EPG)**
to support business development, strategic partnerships and product adoption across banks, NBFCs, fintechs and other financial institutions. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, building strong relationships with banking stakeholders, driving engagement and coordinating with internal teams to support the commercialization and adoption of IBDIC's solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Banking Partnerships: Build and maintain relationships with private sector banks, NBFCs, fintechs and other ecosystem partners to drive business growth.
* Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, generate leads, develop partnership pipelines and support commercial closures.
* Stakeholder Management: Engage with banking stakeholders, business heads and key decision makers to understand requirements and identify potential use cases.
* Product Adoption & Growth: Drive awareness, onboarding and adoption of IBDIC's digital banking solutions across partner institutions.
* Strategic Alliances: Identify opportunities for collaborations and partnerships to expand IBDIC's ecosystem presence.
* Commercial Coordination: Support pricing discussions, business proposals, negotiations and partnership agreements.
* Market Intelligence: Track industry trends, competitor activities and emerging opportunities within the banking and fintech ecosystem.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Technology, Customer Success, Finance and Legal teams to ensure successful partnership execution.
* Reporting & Tracking: Maintain partnership pipelines, track engagement progress and provide regular updates on business development activities.

**Must Have**

* 5–10 years of experience in Banking, BFSI, Fintech, Payments, Digital Banking or related sectors.
* Strong experience in business development, strategic partnerships, relationship management or ecosystem growth.
* Good understanding of private sector banking operations, financial products and digital banking solutions.
* Existing relationships with banking stakeholders and decision makers, preferably within private sector banks.
* Experience in identifying business opportunities, managing partnership pipelines and supporting commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* MBA / Management qualification preferred.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with banks, transaction banking, trade finance or digital banking solutions.
* Exposure to Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), payments, fintech platforms or financial infrastructure.
* Experience in onboarding banking partners and driving digital product adoption.
* Understanding of banking technology platforms, API-based solutions and financial ecosystems.
* Proficiency in Trade Finance products, processes and banking operations, including Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees and Import/Export transactions.
* Exposure to banking industry associations and ecosystem initiatives.

**Compensation: Industry Benchmarking**
**Location: Times Square, Marol, Andheri, Mumbai**
**Why IBDIC**

* Be part of consortium backed by 18 Banks
* Highly enthusiastic team with excellent management support & growth path
* Strong leadership inspiring lives with amazing success stories

Ready to be part of something extraordinary? Join our team in this dynamic, new frontier where we're backed by 18 National banks, driven by a highly motivated and well-supported team, and led by an inspirational leadership that's already scripted remarkable success stories. Let's shape the future together.

title: Manager - Cell & Gene Therapy - Bioscience
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Various outside weather conditions
  
  
Job Purpose Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific's Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by identifying, developing, and expanding commercial opportunities across biopharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, CDMOs, academic research institutes, hospitals, and emerging Cell & Gene Therapy organizations. Collaborate with internal business units to deliver integrated workflow solutions that accelerate customers' research, process development, clinical translation, and manufacturing of advanced therapies. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  
  

* Drive business growth for the Cell & Gene Therapy portfolio across assigned territories and customer segments.
* Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities within biotech, biopharma, CDMOs, academic institutes, and translational research organizations.
* Develop strong relationships with scientific investigators, manufacturing teams, procurement, quality, and commercial stakeholders.
* Promote Thermo Fisher's comprehensive CGT portfolio, including cell culture media, reagents, viral vectors, plasmids, bioprocessing solutions, analytical instruments, consumables, and services.
* Collaborate with Business Unit Specialists, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, and Service teams to deliver integrated One Thermo Fisher solutions.
* Generate and manage a healthy sales pipeline while achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Develop account plans for strategic customers and execute activities to increase share of wallet.
* Conduct scientific discussions, product demonstrations, customer presentations, workshops, and seminars to increase market awareness.
* Monitor customer pipelines, funding activities, clinical programs, and manufacturing expansion plans to identify future business opportunities.
* Gather market intelligence on competitors, customer needs, emerging technologies, and industry trends to support business strategy.
* Maintain accurate opportunity tracking, forecasting, and CRM updates in accordance with company expectations.
* Work closely with marketing to support lead generation campaigns, conferences, scientific meetings, and customer engagement activities.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through timely follow-up and coordination with internal support functions. QUALIFICATION & EDUCATION:
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Molecular Biology, or a related scientific discipline.
* MBA is desirable but not mandatory. EXPERIENCE
* 6–10 years of commercial experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biopharma, Cell & Gene Therapy, Bioprocessing, or related industries.
* Experience in technical sales, business development, application support, or account management within the life sciences market.
* Good understanding of Cell & Gene Therapy workflows, including cell culture, gene editing, viral vectors, cell processing, bioprocessing, and analytical technologies.
* Experience working with biotechnology companies, pharmaceutical organizations, research institutes, hospitals, or CDMOs is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a sales pipeline and consistently achieve business objectives.
* Experience working within a matrix organization is an advantage. KEY COMPETENCIES
* Strong business development and consultative selling skills.
* Ability to identify customer needs and position workflow-based solutions.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Scientific aptitude with the ability to engage technical and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong planning, organization, and territory management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Customer-focused mindset with a passion for building long-term partnerships.
* High level of learning agility and adaptability in a rapidly evolving Cell & Gene Therapy market. At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 100,000 extraordinary minds have a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

title: Account Director, India
description:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!
  
  
As an
**Account Director**
at Recorded Future, you will play a critical role in driving revenue growth by managing a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts and generating new business. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to close, while building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders in cybersecurity, IT, and procurement. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a strategic, driven, and customer-obsessed sales leader.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
**New Business Acquisition**

* Identify and pursue net-new logo opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, and channel networks
* Conduct strategic discovery to align cybersecurity needs with Recorded Future’s intelligence solutions
* Engage channel partners in joint go-to-market motions, leveraging their reach and relationships

**Account Management**

* Own and grow key enterprise accounts across multiple verticals
* Drive upsell, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities by identifying unmet needs and usage patterns
* Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across technical and executive audiences (CISO, CIO, VP of Security)
* Act as a trusted advisor, delivering insights and value beyond the initial sale
* Partner with Customer Success and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless onboarding, support, and long-term customer value

**Sales Execution & Forecasting**

* Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles lasting 6–12 months
* Apply MEDDPICC and value-based selling frameworks to qualify and advance deals
* Develop and present compelling proposals, with a strong grasp of both technical value and business ROI
* Use Salesforce, Clari, and Gong to manage pipeline health, track activity, and maintain forecast accuracy
* Handle objections and pricing conversations with clarity, confidence, and professionalism
* Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets

**Market Intelligence & Strategy**

* Maintain a deep understanding of cybersecurity trends, competitive dynamics, and enterprise buying behavior
* Provide market feedback to internal teams to inform product, positioning, and roadmap priorities
* Operate with urgency, professionalism, and high standards of customer care

**What You'll Bring:**
**Experience**

* 8+ years in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity sales roles, with a focus on complex, multi-stakeholder deals
* Track record of consistently exceeding quota and driving territory growth
* Experience managing long sales cycles and closing 7-figure, multi-year contracts with Fortune 1000 clients
* Strong experience with direct sales and partner-driven go-to-market models

**Skills & Abilities**

* Proficient in discovery, objection handling, and closing
* Deep knowledge of MEDDPICC and value-based consultative sales approaches
* Skilled in managing sales processes including approvals, legal reviews, and quoting workflows
* Comfortable engaging with C-level executives and adapting communication to a range of stakeholders
* Highly organized and operationally disciplined; fluent in tools like Salesforce, Clari, Gong

**Traits**

* The grit, curiosity, and resilience to thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment
* An entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, self-starter attitude
* A customer-obsessed approach, with a desire to solve meaningful problems and deliver long-term value
* A collaborative and team-oriented; able to work cross-functionally and build internal champions
* Thoughtfulness, self-awareness, and composed under pressure

**Why should you join Recorded Future?**
Recorded Future employees (or “Futurists”), represent over 40 nationalities and embody our core values of having high standards, practicing inclusion, and acting ethically. Our dedication to empowering clients with intelligence to disrupt adversaries has earned us a 4.6-star user rating on G2 and more than 50% of Fortune 100 companies as customers.
  
  
**Want more info?**
Blog & Podcast: Learn everything you want to know (and maybe some things you’d rather not know) about the world of cyber threat intelligence
  
  
Linkedin, Instagram & Twitter: What’s happening at Recorded Future

Recognition: Check out our awards and announcements
  
  
*We are committed to maintaining an environment that attracts and retains talent from a diverse range of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. By ensuring all feel included and respected for being unique and bringing their whole selves to work, Recorded Future is made a better place every day.
  
  
If you need any accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to our recruiting team at careers@recordedfuture.com*
*Recorded Future is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Recorded Future does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

or a live, scheduled

title: Growth Director - CleverAI
description:
**About The Role**
CleverAI is central to CleverTap's next phase of growth. This role is the single owner of making it succeed in the market: taking customers from adoption to measurable business impact, turning those wins into proof points, and converting that proof into revenue. You will work across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing and Product, with no ownership of any one of them but accountability for the combined outcome.
  
  
**What you will do?**

* Own the end-to-end CleverAI growth journey, from customer adoption, implementation, use-case discovery, measurement, and scaling.
* Define success metrics, adoption frameworks, and best practices to help customers achieve measurable business outcomes.
* Partner with Customer Success teams to drive seamless implementations, improve time-to-value, and resolve adoption challenges.
* Create repeatable onboarding frameworks, playbooks, and enablement programs for CSMs and AEs.
* Drive monetisation by partnering with Sales and CS teams on expansion opportunities, account strategies, and upsell motions.
* Enable Sales teams with AI use cases, customer insights, proof points, and positioning to support pipeline generation.
* Partner with Marketing to build the CleverAI narrative, customer stories, campaigns, and market-facing content.
* Act as the voice of the customer by gathering insights, influencing product improvements, and driving customer-centric innovation.
* Build a strong library of customer success stories, testimonials, and case studies that demonstrate business impact.
* Evangelise CleverAI internally by developing training programs, certifications, and resources to keep teams aligned as the product evolves.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in growth, product marketing, customer success, GTM or related functions, with prior experience in a growth team.
* Experience taking a product or feature from early adoption to scaled usage and revenue.
* Hands-on understanding of customer implementations and onboarding, and comfort working alongside CS teams on technical and data-dependent rollouts.
* Comfort with data: you define metrics, build dashboards or work with analysts, and use the numbers to tell a story.
* Strong cross-functional influence. You can align Sales, CS, Marketing and Product without direct authority.
* Credibility in customer and prospect conversations, including with senior stakeholders.
* Excellent storytelling, written and verbal, and the ability to turn complex AI capabilities into clear business outcomes.
* Background in martech, CRM, SaaS or data/AI products is a strong plus.

**Measures Of Success**

* Consistently drive high-quality CleverAI implementations, with faster time to go-live and time to first value
* Rising CleverAI adoption and depth of usage across customers
* A growing library of measurable customer success stories and testimonials
* Expansion and upsell revenue attributable to CleverAI
* CSMs and AEs confidently positioning and delivering CleverAI
* Visible product improvements driven by customer feedback

**Why join us**

* Contribute to a product backed by 11 technology patents, showcasing industry-leading innovation. You are passionate about technology and its impact on the high-growth mobile technology space
* Power personalized engagement at scale, processing over 30 billion events daily and reaching 3+ billion devices worldwide.
* Flourish in an Environment that Nurtures Growth and Curiosity

**Learn More**
Get to know us better before you apply!
  
  
Check out our product documentation, engineering blog, and customer stories to see how we work and what we value.
  
  

* Our Culture Video
* CleverAI
* CleverTap Developer Documentation
* Blogs
* TesseractDB™
* CleverTap Product Demo

**About CleverTap**
CleverTap is the world’s leading AI-first, all-in-one customer engagement and retention platform, redefining how brands build lasting customer relationships in the Agentic era. Powered by its proprietary CleverAI™ Decisioning Engine and the Agentic Universe, CleverTap enables autonomous, real-time decision-making that helps organizations deliver 1:1 individualized experiences at scale while maximizing ROI.
  
  
Its unified platform brings together an AI-native Personalization Engine, automated Journey Orchestration, its proprietary Customer Data Platform – TesseractDB™, and deep customer and product analytics to power truly intelligent, self-optimizing engagement across channels including mobile, web, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more. By seamlessly connecting data, insights, and activation, CleverTap ensures every interaction is contextual, coordinated, and conversion-driven.
  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Personalization Engines and a Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™, CleverTap is at the forefront of the shift from campaign-led marketing to agent-led growth. Trusted by more than 2,000 global brands including IKEA, Tesco, Burger King, Levi’s, Decathlon, Domino’s, 7-Eleven, Jio, Grab, Carousell, and Emirates NBD, CleverTap helps businesses drive measurable growth through meaningful, autonomous customer engagement.
  
  
Backed by Accel, Peak XV Partners, Tiger Global, CDPQ, and 360 One, CleverTap has 550+ employees across offices in the US, the Middle East, Asia, and LATAM.
  
  
For more information, visit https://clevertap.com/ or follow us on Linkedin and X.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future of engagement.
  
  
CleverTap is dedicated to establishing an inclusive culture that welcomes individuals from diverse backgrounds, encouraging them to contribute their unique perspectives to our workplace.

title: Senior Manager - Trade Credit Insurance
description:
Dear Candidates ,

We at Edme Insurance Brokers are hiring for the position of Senior Manager -Trade Credit Insurance at Mumbai - Wadala

Interested candidates can share CVs to neetu.b@edmeinsurance.com.

**Job Purpose**

To manage the servicing and retention of existing Trade Credit Insurance clients by ensuring effective policy administration, timely renewals, coordination with insurers, and proactive client engagement. The role involves maintaining strong relationships with corporate clients, supporting policyholders throughout the policy lifecycle, and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and retention.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Client Retention & Relationship Management**

* Manage a portfolio of existing Trade Credit Insurance clients.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure long-term retention.
* Initiate renewal discussions well in advance of policy expiry.
* Understand client requirements, business changes, and evolving credit risk exposures.
* Identify potential client attrition risks and implement appropriate retention strategies.
* Coordinate with relationship managers and placement teams to retain existing business.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling related insurance products.

**B. Trade Credit Policy Servicing**

* Handle day-to-day servicing requirements of Trade Credit Insurance policies.
* Coordinate policy issuance, endorsements, amendments, cancellations, and renewals.
* Assist clients with buyer additions, deletions, and credit limit enhancement requests.
* Coordinate with insurers for credit limit approvals, modifications, and reviews.
* Ensure timely communication of policy terms, conditions, exclusions, and coverage changes.
* Monitor policy expiry dates and ensure timely renewal documentation.
* Maintain accurate client and policy records.

**C. Insurance Company Coordination**

* Liaise with insurance companies for policy servicing and client-related requirements.
* Follow up on pending buyer credit limit approvals and credit limit revisions.
* Coordinate with underwriters for policy-related clarifications and exceptions.
* Track insurer response timelines and ensure adherence to agreed service standards.
* Resolve policy-related discrepancies in coordination with insurers.

title: Business and Banking Alliance
description:
We're hiring a Manager - Business & Banking Alliances at Indicpay Payments! 🚀

Build and grow the bank and business partnerships that power payments for India's growing businesses.

📍 Andheri East (Saki Naka), Mumbai (On-site)

💼 5+ years experience

🕒 Full-time

ABOUT INDICPAY

Indicpay Payments Pvt. Ltd. is a payment service provider for modern Indian businesses. We offer UPI collection, Payment Gateway, Payment Links, UPI AutoPay, Instant Settlement, Soft POS, Payouts and a Verification Suite (Bank, PAN, Aadhaar, GST) for e-commerce, D2C, SaaS, EdTech, NBFC, insurance and SMB merchants.

THE ROLE

You will own Indicpay's relationships with banks, financial institutions and business partners, and turn them into payment volume, better commercial terms and new merchant business. You will work closely with our sales, product, tech, risk and compliance teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Identify, approach and onboard banks, NBFCs and financial partners for acquiring, settlement and payouts

• Build alliances with software platforms, fintechs, aggregators and channel partners that bring merchants to Indicpay

• Manage relationships with senior stakeholders at partner banks and businesses

• Negotiate commercial terms, pricing and revenue-sharing, and manage renewals

• Set up referral, co-selling and white-label models

• Coordinate integrations, go-lives and issue resolution with our tech and operations teams

• Work with risk and compliance on partner due diligence and RBI guidelines

• Track partner performance, volumes and revenue, and report to leadership

• Represent Indicpay at banking forums and fintech events

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 5+ years in banking alliances, partnerships, business development or relationship management in payments, fintech or banking

• Strong knowledge of the Indian payments ecosystem: UPI, cards, net banking, gateways, aggregators, settlement, nodal and escrow accounts, MDR and revenue-sharing

• A network among banks, financial institutions or business partners, and a record of building partnerships

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills in English and Hindi

• Ability to work with technical, risk and compliance teams

• Graduate in any discipline (MBA preferred)

GOOD TO HAVE

• Experience setting up white-label or referral models

• Familiarity with RBI payment aggregator guidelines

• Exposure to payouts, collections and verification products

WHY JOIN INDICPAY

• Fast-growing fintech with direct access to leadership

• Competitive pay with performance-linked incentives

• Exposure to industry platforms like Global Fintech Fest

HIRING PROCESS

Resume screening → HR discussion → Leadership round → Final round and offer

Click Easy Apply and share your updated resume.

Applicant privacy: Your details will be used only for recruitment purposes at Indicpay.

title: Technical Account Manager - RHEL
description:
**About The Job**
The Technical Account Manager (TAM) delivers strategic technical and architectural guidance along with hands-on technical support to key customers, enabling them to optimize their Red Hat infrastructure. This role cultivates strong relationships, develops deep technical expertise of customer environments and exercises good judgment to make informed decisions that impact customer success. The TAM is responsible for working independently with minimal instruction to resolve moderately complex technical issues. This role proactively coaches customers on best practices for utilizing Red Hat solutions, anticipates and mitigates potential customer challenges, serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for assigned accounts. The TAM demonstrates a solid understanding of customer business needs and technical environments, contributing significantly to customer success and retention.
  
  
**Note:**
This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Proactively identify and address potential technical risks within customer environments.
* Develop and support the implementation of solutions for complex technical challenges.
* Provide hands-on support to the assigned customer
* Collaborate with engineering and product management teams on customer escalations.
* Conduct regular technical reviews with customers to ensure optimal performance.
* Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in assigned Red Hat products.
* Serve as a technical mentor for junior team members.
* Contribute to the development of best practices and internal training materials.
* Conduct regular account reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience working in a support, development, engineering, IT, or quality assurance (QA) organization
* Experience in system administration and troubleshooting with Red Hat Enterprise Linux, other Linux platforms in a production environment
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with shifting priorities and timelines
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers both clearly and concisely
* Ability to travel for customer visits and events within the region
* Upstream involvement in open source projects is a plus
* Ansible experience is a plus

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
  
  
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Job Title : CRM Manager**

**Company: Ace Blend**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Employment Type: Full-time, On-site**

**Experience: 5–6 years**

**About the Role**

Ace Blend is looking for a proactive and technology-driven CRM Manager to lead our customer experience and CRM operations team, comprising Nutrition-based CRM Executives and Sales Executives.

The role will be responsible for ensuring seamless customer query resolution, maintaining high service quality, monitoring ticket turnaround times, managing escalations, and driving customer satisfaction.

We are particularly looking for someone who is comfortable working with AI tools, CRM platforms, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive queries, streamline ticket management, improve response times, and build scalable customer support processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. CRM Operations & Customer Experience**

* Oversee daily CRM operations and ensure all customer queries, complaints, and tickets are addressed within defined turnaround times.
* Ensure customer issues related to products, orders, delivery, returns, refunds, and nutrition-related queries are resolved efficiently.
* Maintain strong operational hygiene across the CRM platform, ensuring tickets are categorised, assigned, tracked, updated, and closed appropriately.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and identify recurring customer pain points.
* Ensure consistent service quality across calls, chats, emails, and other customer communication channels.
* Drive continuous improvements in response times, resolution rates, and overall customer experience.

**2. Team Management & Performance Monitoring**

* Manage and mentor Nutrition-based CRM Executives and Sales Executives.
* Monitor daily productivity, ticket volumes, response times, resolution timelines, and quality of customer interactions.
* Review agent performance and provide regular feedback, coaching, and guidance.
* Support team members in handling complex queries, difficult customers, and escalations.
* Ensure team adherence to defined processes, service standards, and communication guidelines.
* Coordinate staffing and workload allocation to maintain service levels during peak periods.

**3. Escalation & Complaint Management**

* Take ownership of critical and unresolved customer escalations.
* Guide agents in resolving complex cases and ensure timely communication with customers.
* Coordinate with internal teams, including logistics, warehouse, sales, and other relevant departments, to resolve customer issues.
* Identify recurring complaints and root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent similar issues.
* Ensure all escalations are documented and tracked until closure.

**4. AI Tools & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive customer queries and manual CRM processes using AI tools and automation platforms.
* Implement AI-powered workflows for FAQs, product information, order-related queries, ticket categorisation, routing, and response suggestions.
* Build automation journeys that resolve routine queries independently while routing complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate human agent.
* Continuously evaluate and upgrade AI tools, chatbots, workflows, and CRM integrations to improve efficiency.
* Work on automating repetitive tasks such as ticket tagging, follow-up reminders, response templates, and reporting.
* Monitor the accuracy and effectiveness of automated responses and ensure appropriate human intervention wherever required.
* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to integrate CRM platforms with other business tools and systems.

**5. Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare daily operational reports and weekly CRM performance reports for senior management.
* Track and analyse key metrics, including:
* Ticket volume and resolution rate.
* First response time and ticket turnaround time.
* Pending and overdue tickets.
* Escalation volume and resolution timelines.
* Customer satisfaction scores and service quality.
* Agent productivity and performance.
* Automation adoption and operational efficiency.
* Identify trends, recurring issues, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
* Present data-backed recommendations to senior management and track the implementation of corrective actions

**6. Process Improvement & Quality Control**

* Develop and maintain SOPs, escalation matrices, response templates, and customer service guidelines.
* Conduct regular quality checks on calls, chats, and written responses.
* Ensure accurate documentation and consistent handling of customer queries across the team.
* Review CRM workflows regularly and implement improvements to enhance productivity and service quality.
* Maintain strong coordination with senior management and provide timely updates on operational performance, customer concerns, and improvement initiative

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5–6 years of experience in CRM, customer experience, customer support operations, or service delivery.
* Prior experience managing a team of customer support, CRM, or sales executives.
* Strong understanding of ticketing systems, SLA management, escalation handling, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer support platforms such as Freshdesk, Kapture, Intercom, Zendesk, or similar tools.
* Practical knowledge of AI tools, chatbots, workflow automation, and CRM integrations.
* Experience implementing or improving AI-driven customer service workflows will be a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical skills with experience preparing operational reports and performance dashboards.
* Excellent communication, people management, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, growing D2C business environment.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Experience in D2C, FMCG, wellness, nutrition, supplements, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce brands would be preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for a hands-on CRM leader who combines strong people management and customer service skills with technical expertise in AI and automation.

The ideal candidate should be able to manage daily operations, support the team through complex escalations, analyse performance data, and proactively implement technology-driven solutions that make customer service faster, smarter, and more efficient.

**This role requires both operational ownership and a technology-first mindset, with a strong focus on customer satisfaction, team performance, and scalable automation.**

title: Account Manager
description:
Title- Manager Account Management

Experience- 4 Years

Location- Mumbai

**Job Description Summary**

The Associate Manager/Manager/Senior Manager – Account Management (Client Servicing) is responsible for managing end-to-end client relationships, driving strategic account growth, and ensuring seamless delivery of integrated marketing and communication solutions. The role serves as the primary point of contact for clients, understanding their business objectives and translating them into effective strategies and campaigns. The incumbent collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, including Strategy, Creative, Media, Production, and Operations, to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget. The role focuses on strengthening client partnerships, identifying opportunities for business growth, managing project execution, mitigating delivery risks, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction while contributing to the overall commercial success of the business
**.**

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day relationships with assigned clients and serve as the primary point of contact for project-related communication.
* Understand client objectives, business priorities, and campaign requirements to support the delivery of effective marketing and communication solutions.
* Coordinate the end-to-end execution of campaigns and projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality, and adherence to agreed timelines and budgets.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Strategy, Creative, Media, Digital, Production, Finance, and Operations, to ensure seamless project execution.
* Prepare client presentations, meeting agendas, project plans, timelines, status reports, estimates, and other project documentation.
* Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, dependencies, or delays, and proactively work with internal teams to resolve issues.
* Ensure all client deliverables meet quality standards and align with client expectations and agreed objectives.
* Support account growth by identifying opportunities for additional projects or services within existing client accounts and sharing recommendations with senior stakeholders.
* Coordinate project budgets, invoicing, commercial documentation, and resource planning in collaboration with relevant internal teams.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and effective stakeholder management.
* Stay informed about industry trends, market developments, client businesses, and competitive activities to provide relevant insights and recommendations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, delivery efficiency, and client experience.
* Demonstrate strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and organizational skills while managing multiple projects and stakeholder expectations.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* **4–7 years of relevant experience**
  in Client Servicing, Account Management, Marketing, Advertising, Brand Management, or Integrated Communications within an advertising agency, media agency, digital agency, or a similar client-facing environment.
* Strong understanding of client relationship management, project coordination, campaign execution, stakeholder management, and integrated marketing communication.
* Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely delivery of client campaigns.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and familiarity with project management and collaboration tools is preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and organizational skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* **Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, Communications, Mass Media, or a related discipline.**
  Relevant certifications in Project Management, Digital Marketing, or Client Relationship Management are an added advantage.

title: Principal Professional Services Consultant-SOC Transformation
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Your Career The Customer Success team is critical to our customers and is a cornerstone of our success. As a team, we are responsible for the health of our customers and work to ensure they are getting the most out of our products. We are a team of problem-solvers who are passionate about our customers and are focused on delivering a world-class customer experience. Your Impact Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM. Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented processes into a unified, AI-driven platform. Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy through to full operationalization. Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform. Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats. Proactively collaborate with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities, ensuring alignment on shared objectives. Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability and ensuring all stakeholders follow through on commitments. Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows and enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree with 15 years of experience, or Master's degree with 12 years of experience, or PhD with 8 years of experience in a related field. Demonstrated experience running a Security Operations Center (SOC), with a proven track record of modernizing operations. Extensive hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments. Deep expertise with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows. Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence. Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex). Preferred Qualifications Exceptional executive presence, with strong communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO. Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations. Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar. Industry-recognized certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, etc.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
