Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited is a publicly listed health insurance provider committed to giving every individual in India the confidence to access quality healthcare. Guided by its brand philosophy “Zindagi Ko Claim Kar Le,” the company focuses on enabling customers to live life without constraints. As of March 31, 2026, Niva Bupa operates over 210 physical branches across India and delivers health insurance solutions through a large ecosystem of agents, brokers, and corporate partners. It currently covers more than 25 million lives and offers access to over 10,500 hospitals in its empanelled network. With an employee base of over 10,100 people, Niva Bupa has maintained a claim settlement ratio above 90% for five consecutive financial years and has been certified a Great Place to Work six times in a row.

**Role Description**
The Unit Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. This role is responsible for managing and guiding a sales or service unit to achieve business targets, including acquisition of new customers and retention of existing ones. The Unit Manager oversees day-to-day team operations, monitors performance metrics, and ensures adherence to company processes and regulatory requirements. The role involves coaching and motivating team members, conducting regular reviews, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to resolve customer issues and streamline workflows. The Unit Manager also contributes to local market development, supports partner relationships, and identifies opportunities to improve unit productivity and service quality.

**Qualifications**

* Strong team leadership and people management skills, with experience in supervising and developing high-performing teams.
* Proficiency in sales planning, target achievement, and portfolio management, preferably within insurance or financial services.
* Ability to analyze performance data, track key metrics, and drive operational improvements.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills for working with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Sound understanding of health insurance concepts, regulatory guidelines, and customer service best practices (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Bachelor’s degree in business, management, finance, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, MS Office, and digital platforms to manage unit activities and reporting.
* Proactive, result-oriented mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment in Mumbai.

* Strong ability to apply AI/ML capabilities to solve business problems and drive transformation outcomes, engaging both technical and business audiences on generative AI, agentic systems, and applied AI

title: E-Commerce And Marketplace Business Manager
description:
Job Title: E-commerce & Marketplace Business Manager

Company: Really Agritech Private Limited

Location: Kolshet Road, Thane West, Maharashtra

Department: Sales / E-commerce & Marketplace Business

Reporting To: Sales Head / Directors

Experience: 3–5 years

Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience and profile relevance, plus performance-based incentives.

About Really Agritech

Really Agritech Private Limited is engaged in the import, distribution and supply of agricultural machinery and equipment across India through an extensive B2B dealer and distributor network. Our product portfolio includes brush cutters, power weeders, sprayers, chainsaws, water pumps, cultivators and various other agricultural machinery and equipment.

As part of our next phase of growth, we are expanding our presence across B2B and B2C online marketplaces, aggregators and e-commerce platforms.

Role Overview

We are looking for a commercially driven and experienced E-commerce & Marketplace Business Manager to lead and expand our marketplace business.

The candidate will be responsible for managing existing marketplace partnerships, onboarding new platforms and business partners, driving online sales, managing marketplace advertising budgets, monitoring business performance and building a team to handle day-to-day marketplace operations.

The role requires a combination of marketplace operations, business development, digital marketing, commercial understanding and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketplace Operations & Management

\* Manage existing B2B aggregators and marketplaces, including Toolsvilla, Agrim, Shoption, Moglix and other relevant platforms.

\* Manage B2C marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart and other suitable e-commerce platforms.

\* Oversee product listings, catalogue creation, product descriptions, images, pricing, specifications, keywords and product categorisation.

\* Ensure accurate and timely updates of product information, inventory, pricing, offers and availability across platforms.

\* Monitor orders, dispatch coordination, cancellations, returns, customer complaints, claims and marketplace service-level requirements.

\* Coordinate with internal sales, warehouse, logistics, accounts and customer service teams to ensure smooth operations.

2. Business Development & Platform Onboarding

\* Identify, evaluate and onboard new B2B aggregators, e-commerce marketplaces, online retailers and strategic channel partners.

\* Develop relationships with marketplace category managers, business development teams and key account managers.

\* Negotiate commercial terms, commissions, margins, payment cycles, promotional support and other partnership conditions within company policy.

\* Evaluate new platforms based on customer reach, sales potential, commercial viability and strategic relevance.

\* Prepare business proposals and expansion plans for management approval.

\* Develop and execute plans to grow revenue from existing and newly onboarded partners.

3. Marketplace Advertising & Performance Marketing

\* Plan, execute and optimise advertising campaigns on Amazon, Flipkart and other platforms wherever advertising facilities are available.

\* Manage sponsored listings, keyword campaigns, promotional campaigns and platform-specific advertising tools.

\* Analyse advertising performance using relevant metrics such as sales, impressions, clicks, conversion rate, advertising cost of sales (ACoS), return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost, where applicable.

\* Allocate and monitor advertising budgets, ensuring expenditure remains within approved limits.

\* Identify high-performing products, optimise campaigns and recommend improvements to increase profitable sales.

\* Monitor campaign outcomes and prepare regular performance reports.

4. Sales Growth & Commercial Management

\* Develop platform-wise and product-wise sales plans, revenue targets and growth strategies.

\* Monitor gross margins, marketplace commissions, logistics costs, advertising expenses, returns and other variable costs to assess profitability.

\* Analyse pricing, competitor activity, product demand and marketplace trends.

\* Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, conversion rates, average order value and repeat business.

\* Ensure marketplace pricing, discounting and promotional activities comply with company policies and approved commercial terms.

\* Track outstanding payments, settlement discrepancies, deductions, claims and reconciliation with the accounts team.

5. Inventory, Order & Supply Chain Coordination

\* Monitor stock availability and inventory accuracy across all active platforms.

\* Coordinate with warehouse and dispatch teams to maintain adequate stock and fulfil orders within committed timelines.

\* Prevent stock-outs, overselling, unnecessary inventory accumulation and avoidable cancellations.

\* Forecast product demand based on historical sales, seasonality, campaigns and planned promotions.

\* Coordinate returns, damaged goods, replacement requirements and inventory reconciliation.

6. Team Building & Leadership

\* Build, train and manage a dedicated marketplace operations team as the business expands.

\* Allocate responsibilities for catalogue management, inventory updates, order processing, advertising, reporting and partner coordination.

\* Establish clear responsibilities, operating procedures, productivity measures and performance targets.

\* Review team performance regularly and ensure timely completion of daily operational activities.

\* Develop a scalable operating structure that can support an increasing number of platforms and SKUs.

7. Reporting & Management Reviews

\* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports covering platform-wise sales, orders, inventory, returns, advertising spend and business performance.

\* Track revenue, gross margin, contribution after variable costs, marketplace commissions and advertising ROI.

\* Maintain a pipeline of prospective platforms and report onboarding progress.

\* Highlight operational issues, commercial risks and growth opportunities to the Sales Head and Directors.

\* Recommend corrective actions and business expansion initiatives based on data and performance analysis.

Required Qualifications & Experience

\* 3–5 years of relevant experience in e-commerce marketplace management, online business operations or marketplace account management.

\* Demonstrated hands-on experience with both B2B aggregators/marketplaces and B2C e-commerce platforms.

\* Practical knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub and relevant marketplace or aggregator portals.

\* Proven experience in managing product catalogues, inventory, orders, pricing, returns and account performance.

\* Experience in planning and optimising marketplace advertising campaigns and managing budgets.

\* Ability to analyse sales, advertising performance, margins and profitability using Excel or Google Sheets.

\* Previous experience managing, supervising or building a team.

\* Experience in onboarding new marketplaces, negotiating commercial terms and developing business partnerships.

\* Strong coordination, communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.

\* Ability to work with multiple departments and manage a large product catalogue.

Preferred Qualifications

\* Experience in agricultural machinery, industrial equipment, tools, hardware, automotive products or other technical product categories.

\* Experience managing large catalogues with multiple SKUs.

\* Understanding of marketplace settlements, commissions, returns, claims and reconciliation.

\* Familiarity with marketplace analytics, inventory management systems, ERP or order management systems.

\* Experience in scaling an online business from an initial stage to a structured, team-led operation.

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

\* Grow revenue from existing marketplace partners.

\* Onboard new platforms and commercially viable business partners.

\* Improve catalogue quality, inventory accuracy and order fulfilment.

\* Generate profitable sales through effective marketplace advertising.

\* Maintain control over marketplace expenses, commissions and promotional budgets.

\* Build and manage a capable team for daily operations.

\* Establish a scalable and measurable marketplace business for Really Agritech.

Compensation & Application

Compensation: Competitive fixed salary based on experience and profile relevance, plus performance-based incentives.

Work Location: Kolshet Road, Thane West, Maharashtra.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

Email: hr@reallyagritech.com

Contact: +91 89280 21959

Please mention “E-commerce & Marketplace Business Manager” in the subject line of your application.

title: Customer Fulfilment Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
As a Customer Fulfillment Team Manager, you will lead a team of 8–15 Customer Operations Specialists to deliver operational and service excellence, strengthen customer order processes, and improve supply chain efficiency. You will create a culture of belonging, coach and develop team members, and work with Customer Fulfillment, Logistics Operations, the Customer Center of Excellence, and cross-functional partners to execute customer strategies and continuously improve standard processes. The role includes daily direction setting, resource allocation, onboarding, training, issue resolution, and accountability for process performance. Based in Mumbai, this hybrid role reports to the Customer Fulfillment Head and works the 3:30 PM to 12:30 AM shift, collaborating with demand, deployment, product supply management, customer order services, replenishment teams, and regional counterparts.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead and manage a team of 8-15 Customer Operations Specialists, ensuring adherence to customer order process standards and delivery of customer initiatives.
* Educate, coach, and motivate team members while strengthening customer operations and SAP technical capabilities.
* Build a culture of belonging through individual development plans, team camaraderie, open communication, trust, and respect.
* Provide guidance on order-to-cash processes, including allocations, order additions, and pricing issues, and implement improvements that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* Own onboarding and continuous training in partnership with the New Hire Training and Process Lead, including staffing coordination and training execution.
* Partner with Customer Fulfillment, Logistics Operations, Warehousing, Transportation, Sales and cross-functional teams to eliminate losses, share information, and maintain standard process rigor.
* Provide daily leadership and direction for customer strategies and priorities; lead the Daily Direction Setting process, including team health checks, prioritization, and resource allocation.
* Lead continuous improvement, maintain standard processes and team accountability, and ensure effective communication and alignment across customer teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Experience: 7–10 years of related experience in supply chain management, logistics, customer operations, manufacturing, or a similar environment.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP ERP and supply chain processes; strong data analysis and interpretation skills; working knowledge of tools such as Excel, SQL, or Tableau; and experience with process mapping, standardization, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and process performance monitoring.
* Order-to-Cash (O2C): Sound understanding of the end-to-end O2C process, including order management, pricing, allocations, delivery, invoicing, and collections.
* Soft Skills: Strong people leadership, communication, collaboration, mentoring, motivation, conflict resolution, negotiation, analytical and critical thinking, customer orientation, attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm and systematic under pressure.
* People Management: Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and managing teams; conducting performance reviews and providing feedback; building inclusive team environments; resolving team dynamics; and leading cross-functional groups.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of related experience, particularly in supply chain planning and execution, logistics, manufacturing, or customer operations.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Experience with SAP implementation or upgrades, relevant SAP modules, and training team members on SAP best practices.
* Experience with quality management systems or continuous improvement methods such as ISO or Six Sigma, including process audits and assessments.
* Experience leading diverse and cross-functional teams, using customer satisfaction metrics and feedback to improve operations, and managing end-to-end supply chain risks and bottlenecks.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Manager - Automotive & Mobility

**About us:**
1Lattice™ is a 360-degree business decision support partner with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights.
  
  
**Location:**
Gurugram/Mumbai
  
  
**About the role:**
As a Senior Manager (SM) you will have four key responsibilities: (1) Driving account growth and supporting business development activities, (2) Client management, (3) Ensuring project delivery, and (4) Team management.
  
  

* The foremost responsibility of this role is to drive account growth, client retention, and project profitability. You will be expected to seamlessly own and nurture existing client accounts for repeat and continued business, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, and ensure sustained client engagement. In addition, you will support the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, and other pre-sales initiatives. Apart from ensuring account continuity and growth, you will also be responsible for the profitability of your projects by effectively managing direct and indirect costs. You will further contribute towards the development and enhancement of product offerings and capabilities within 1Lattice.
* This role will be expected to develop close connections and relationships with senior leaders across the Automotive & Mobility sector, including automotive OEMs, auto components, electric vehicles (EVs), aftermarket, commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, and related automotive segments.This will require playing a significant role in influencing client thinking, identifying opportunities for account expansion, supporting proposal development, and assisting the Director in driving opportunities to closure. This will also involve ensuring high-quality project delivery through your teams to maintain high client satisfaction and drive repeat business.
* This position will lead and drive delivery teams of 10+ members, including mid-management members who will be responsible for project delivery, and junior team members for execution. This will involve supervising and guiding the research process, managing complex engagements, and generating actionable insights that help clients make strategic and operational business decisions.
* You will also play a very meaningful leadership role internally and assume the leadership responsibility for your team. You will support the 1Lattice culture by motivating your colleagues and helping team members under you train and develop their skills, showcase their talents, make them feel part of the 1Lattice family, and overall help them grow professionally. As such, you will be responsible for both their growth and overall engagement, while fostering a high-performance and collaborative team environment.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Ensuring sustained growth and profitability of existing accounts through effective account farming, client retention, and identification of expansion opportunities within key accounts.
* Driving business continuity with existing clients, ensuring repeat business and long-term engagement from key accounts.
* Supporting the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, client discussions, and other pre-sales initiatives.
* Driving sectoral marketing, industry visibility, representing the 1Lattice brand, and supporting lead generation and conversion initiatives.
* End-to-end ownership of project scoping and delivery by leading high-impact teams and ensuring overall client satisfaction and engagement.
* Driving thought leadership in projects and developing compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to complex client challenges.
* Managing team growth and satisfaction - being responsible for their success while building a strong team culture.
* Playing an active role in recruitment and building project delivery teams within the vertical.

**Competencies and Skills:**

* Deep understanding of the Automotive & Mobility domain, including OEMs, auto components, electric vehicles, batteries, charging, aftermarket, and related automotive industries. Experience within an automotive or auto components company is an added advantage.
* Proven experience in business research, consulting, market intelligence, or data services, with a minimum of 8+ years of experience leading and managing teams in the Automotive & Auto Components industry.
* Strong and credible industry relationships, with the ability to manage senior stakeholder conversations, drive account growth within existing clients, understand client needs, and develop trusted relationships across the automotive and auto components ecosystem.
* Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach and support business development initiatives to maximise conversions.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and manage large-scale projects from beginning to completion, with a strong orientation towards planning work, defining scope and approach for assignments, and driving work through teams with high efficiency.
* Strong team management skills, including building a high-performance culture, driving impact and efficiency, and ensuring team growth and engagement.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to derive insights from data, industry trends, market developments, and stakeholder discussions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written (reports, presentations, proposals) and verbal (client interactions and executive presentations).

**Educational qualification and Certifications:**

* Consistent track record of academic excellence - at least an MBA degree.
* Demonstration of leadership in educational and professional career. Experience in secondary and primary research of 5 yrs+ is a must.
* Very high drive and energy.
* Clear, confident and articulate presentation skills.

title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch

The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.

At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every

aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.

With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food & nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.

How will we do it?

There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life-transforming service:

Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.

Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.

Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.

Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:

* Individuals & Families
* Landlords & Second Home Owners
* Developers & RWAs
* Corporates

*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family*

A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences & behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family & its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient & a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family & thus, the most important link between the company & the customer.

*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager*

1. Customer Onboarding

* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold & onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.

2. Solution Deployment

* Define & agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day-to-day chores, & undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.

3. Partner Management

* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.

4. Customer Lifecycle Management

* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight & transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.

5. Customer Feedback & Service Improvement

* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify & work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise & highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.

Who are we looking for?

* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start-up
* Self-motivated & loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, & is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity & uncertainty
* Focused on problem-solving, has a solution-oriented mindset
* Hard-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
  
  
Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
  
  
The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day-to-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
  
  
**Day-to-day Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day-to-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused team culture.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned business stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and reliable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing regular updates on service requests, priorities, and operational performance.
* Resolve operational issues and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
* Support service reviews by providing updates on performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process standardization, simplification, and automation.
* Lead implementation of process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, knowledge articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Monitor operational metrics and identify trends to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the team.
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Client Service Operations to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Work closely with leadership to support operational planning, resource management, and service expansion initiatives.
* Share best practices across Business Support Services to promote consistency and standardization.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Service Delivery: SLA achievement, Turnaround time, Queue management, Delivery throughput
* Quality: Quality scores, Rework rates, Process compliance, Audit readiness
* Operational Performance: Productivity, Capacity utilization, Workload balancing, Operational efficiency
* Stakeholder Experience: Stakeholder satisfaction, Escalation resolution, Responsiveness, Service adoption
* People: Team engagement, Performance management, Training completion, Capability development
* Continuous Improvement: Process improvements implemented, Standardization initiatives, Automation opportunities identified, Knowledge management contributions

**Essential Traits**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Management, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Client Service Operations, Shared Services, Business Operations, Business Support Services, or Professional Services.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or coordinating operational teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery within a shared services or operational support environment.
* Strong operational leadership and service delivery management.
* Experience managing teams within a shared services or business operations environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience with workflow management, reporting, and operational governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Monday.com, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or similar workflow tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

description:
**Job Summary**
We are an international ship owning and operating company in the dry bulk, breakbulk and project sectors. We are seeking an experienced commercial shipping leader to head our India office and drive revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion.
  
  
Reporting to senior management in Singapore, the candidate will serve as the Company's senior representative in India, leading customer engagement, business development, and commercial activities across the market. This hands-on role requires a commercially driven shipping professional with strong chartering, commercial, and operational experience, an established industry network, and a proven ability to deliver business results while fostering alignment across the Mumbai office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Leadership & P&L Performance**

* Drive revenue growth, profitability, and commercial performance of the India business.
* Develop and execute strategies to expand cargo volumes, customers, and market presence.
* Identify new trade opportunities and growth areas.
* Grow the trading desk out of India.
* Ability to manage FFA positions.
* Expand the charter base on Handy, Ultramax and Kamsarmax tonnage.
* Monitor business performance and contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and business planning.

**Business Development & Customer Relationships**

* Build and maintain senior relationships with cargo owners, traders, brokers, and key industry stakeholders.
* Generate and convert new business opportunities into profitable revenue streams.
* Lead commercial negotiations and strengthen the Company's market presence.

**Strategic Contribution**

* Provide market intelligence and strategic insights to senior management.
* Monitor freight markets, cargo trends, and competitive developments.
* Identify growth opportunities across trades, customers, and commercial partnerships.
* Support the Company's long-term growth strategy in India and the region.

**Chartering & Commercial Excellence**

* Provide leadership and guidance on chartering and commercial activities.
* Support fixture development, commercial decision-making, and market positioning.
* Leverage industry relationships and market knowledge to maximize commercial opportunities and business outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Foster a collaborative, high-performance, and commercially focused culture.
* Promote alignment and teamwork across chartering, commercial, post-fixture, marine, technical, and port operations personnel.
* Facilitate effective coordination between India-based teams and Singapore-based functional leaders.
* Ensure local teams work cohesively to deliver commercial objectives and customer commitments.
* Lead initiatives to modernize ways of working, improve cross-functional collaboration, and enhance processes, systems, and reporting to support the Company's growth and commercial objectives.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Shipping, Maritime, Logistics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* At least 10-15 years of experience in dry bulk and/or breakbulk shipping and/or projects, ship owning, ship operating, or commercial shipping environments.
* Demonstrated ability to identify business opportunities, grow revenue, and contribute to commercial performance and profitability.
* Good understanding of freight markets, cargo flows, vessel operations, post-fixture activities, and commercial shipping practices.
* Strong experience in chartering, commercial management, business development, and customer relationship management.
* Established network within the Indian and regional shipping, commodities, trading, or logistics sectors.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across commercial, chartering, operational, marine, and technical functions.
* Self-driven, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in a lean, fast-paced environment.
* Prior experience leading teams or managing commercial activities.
* Mentor and groom the team in India and expand the value proposition of this office.

We appreciate your interest in joining our team and would contact you if you are shortlisted for the next stage.

title: Sr. Business Director - Mumbai
description:
**Who We Are**
DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.
  
  
**The Role**
DoubleVerify seeks a talented, resourceful and well-connected Senior Business Director to sit in our India office, to help expand business across India’s agencies and largest advertisers directly. This unique individual’s primary responsibility will be to prospect and win new Brands or Advertisers, directly or through their agency partners. To achieve the primary focus and goal of driving revenue growth from new logo wins, this Sr Business Director will think strategically about our client’s brand goals and challenges, build and convey compelling value propositions and achieve an annual new business target. We are looking for a strong, strategic salesperson who has a deep understanding of the advertising ecosystem and a passion for the latest emerging technologies. Very strong knowledge of digital environments (display, video, mobile), online marketing techniques and technologies (Platforms, DSPs, AdExchanges etc.), programmatic ecosystem.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Grow existing accounts: Identify opportunities to increase DV adoption, expand solution usage, and grow revenue across existing clients.
* Develop new business: Prospect, build relationships, and convert new advertisers and agencies into DV clients.
* Build strong client relationships: Engage with key stakeholders, understand their business needs, and position relevant DV solutions.
* Drive sales opportunities: Manage opportunities through the sales cycle, from initial engagement and pitching through negotiation and closure.
* Promote DV solutions: Build awareness and adoption of DV's measurement, brand safety, media quality, and optimization solutions.
* Deliver revenue targets: Own business development goals, maintain a healthy pipeline, and consistently deliver against targets.
* Collaborate internally: Work with Client Services, Marketing, Product, and Solutions teams to support client growth and successful sales execution.
* Achieve personal quarterly/annual revenue and new business targets, as agreed with the India Group Director
* Cultivate strong relationships with senior client and agencies stakeholders in order to develop client- specific value propositions, positioning DoubleVerify as a strategic/preferred partner in the region
* Evangelise DoubleVerify’s value proposition, best practices and perspectives to our customers and our industry peers via events, webinars, and other direct client communications channels.
* Define the growth strategy for your portfolio with clear guidance on key client and agency stakeholders, client/opportunity prioritization
* Ensure sales pipeline and activity is maintained and provide timely management / Salesforce reporting as required.
* Must demonstrate accountability/ownership through every stage of client business: prospecting, presenting, negotiating, must have a real knack for customer service.
* The ability to deepen partnerships based on value and a talent for consultative selling
* Able to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to analyze and articulate information with product team
* Attend industry events and follow-up with leads generated in a timely fashion

**What We’re Looking For**

* You will have a clear and proven track record of winning new business
* Experience managing or selling solutions in advertising technology, data or other solutions related to online advertising.
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically to identify a brand’s key business objectives and challenges, and translate and build into compelling value propositions.
* Skilled at building a robust pipeline to fuel business growth.
* Team player mindset with proven experience in working collaboratively with internal teams to drive business growth and sales.
* Extensive contacts across Indian Advertisers as well as Agencies and a strong knowledge of accounts, planning teams and planning cycles.
* Solid troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, along with an ability to collaborate cross-departmentally.
* Skilled at communicating effectively throughout the organization.
* Capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, with collaboration and teamwork at the core of your approach.
* Ability to craft a strong presentation and have excellent communications skills.
* Rigorous attention to detail, drive for excellence, and a positive can-do approach.
* Ability to work from our Mumbai office at least three days per week.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits.
  
  
**Not-so-fun fact:**
Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

title: Key Account Manager (Tech & Digital Services)
description:
**About BOMBAYDC**

BOMBAYDC is a strategic digital platform firm helping enterprises build intelligent digital platforms that increase adoption, retention and revenue.

We work at the intersection of strategy, product, design, technology and AI to turn complex business problems into products people actually use.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a dynamic, articulate and relationship-oriented Account Manager who can independently manage multiple client accounts, strengthen existing relationships, identify growth opportunities and ensure exceptional client servicing.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a polished professional personality and prior experience working with technology, IT consulting or digital services organisations.

This role requires someone who can balance relationship management with a strong commercial mindset, ensuring both client satisfaction and account growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Account Management & Client Servicing**

* Manage and nurture multiple client accounts, acting as the primary point of contact for client communication and coordination.
* Build strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Understand client requirements, business objectives and expectations to ensure effective service delivery.
* Proactively address client concerns, resolve escalations and maintain high levels of client satisfaction.
* Conduct regular client check-ins and account reviews to strengthen engagement.

**2. Account Farming & Revenue Growth**

* Drive account farming initiatives by identifying opportunities to expand existing client engagements.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling and introducing additional services.
* Develop a deeper understanding of existing clients' businesses to uncover potential requirements.
* Build account growth plans and work towards increasing revenue from existing accounts.

**3. Account Mining & Business Development**

* Proactively mine existing accounts to identify new projects, business opportunities and potential engagements.
* Identify key stakeholders and decision-makers within client organisations.
* Generate leads and explore opportunities to expand BOMBAYDC's footprint within existing client accounts.
* Collaborate with internal sales and delivery teams to convert opportunities into successful engagements.

**4. Internal Stakeholder & Delivery Coordination**

* Work closely with design, technology, project management and leadership teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Ensure clear communication between clients and internal teams regarding deliverables, timeline and expectations.
* Track project progress, client feedback and account health.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and seamless coordination across multiple accounts.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in Account Management, Client Servicing or Client Relationship Management.
* Prior experience working with IT services, technology consulting, digital transformation or software services companies is essential.
* Proven experience in both account farming and account mining.
* Strong understanding of upselling, cross-selling and account expansion strategies.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to confidently engage senior stakeholders and CXOs.
* Strong interpersonal skills, professional presence and the ability to build lasting client relationships.
* Ability to independently manage multiple accounts and prioritise competing requirements.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of revenue growth and client profitability.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates currently based in Mumbai, preferably from the Western suburbs.
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period will be preferred.
* Candidates from established IT consulting, technology services, digital agencies or software development companies.
* Someone with a confident, polished, proactive and approachable personality.
* A self-starter who can take ownership of client relationships and drive account growth independently.

**What We Are Looking For**

Someone who goes beyond simply managing client relationships — a professional who can build trust, anticipate client needs, identify business opportunities and grow accounts while representing BOMBAYDC with confidence and finesse.

title: Remarketing Manager
description:
Remarketing Manager – OTT, Lifecycle & Growth Marketing

**Rusk Media | Mumbai, Maharashtra | On-site**

**About Rusk Media**

Rusk Media is building the future of entertainment for the next generation. We create and distribute youth-first entertainment across the AVOD, SVOD and OTT ecosystem, combining original IPs, branded entertainment and digital-first storytelling. We are focused on building engaging entertainment experiences while continuously growing our audience and subscriber base.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a data-driven
**Remarketing Manager**
to own audience re-engagement, retention and monetisation initiatives across our digital entertainment ecosystem.

The role will focus on developing audience segmentation strategies, designing personalised and behaviour-driven campaigns, and driving repeat content consumption and subscriber conversions. The candidate will be responsible for engaging existing, inactive and at-risk users through targeted campaigns across the user lifecycle, ultimately improving retention, reactivation and revenue.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, remarketing, marketing automation and performance optimisation, preferably within OTT, media, entertainment or consumer internet businesses.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Remarketing & Lifecycle Strategy**

* Develop and execute remarketing strategies across different stages of the user lifecycle.
* Build audience segmentation frameworks based on user behaviour, engagement patterns, viewing history and subscription status.
* Identify inactive, dormant and at-risk users and develop targeted reactivation strategies.
* Create campaigns to improve repeat engagement and long-term user retention.

**2. Personalisation & Campaign Management**

* Design personalised, show-specific, genre-based and behaviour-driven campaigns to drive content discovery and consumption.
* Develop targeted campaigns based on viewing preferences, user activity, content interests and engagement history.
* Plan and execute campaigns across relevant channels such as Push Notifications, Email, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM channels.
* Ensure relevant content recommendations and messaging are delivered to the right audience at the right time.

**3. Retention & Monetisation**

* Drive repeat viewership, active users (DAU/MAU), subscriber conversions and subscription renewals.
* Develop strategies to improve user retention and reduce churn.
* Identify opportunities to monetise existing users through targeted campaigns, personalised content recommendations and subscription-led initiatives.
* Improve the overall user lifecycle journey from engagement and repeat consumption to subscription and renewal.

**4. Performance Tracking & Optimisation**

* Track and analyse campaign performance across reactivation, repeat views, conversions, retention and incremental revenue.
* Monitor campaign ROI and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
* Analyse user cohorts, engagement patterns and drop-off points to identify retention opportunities.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve campaign targeting and performance.

**5. Experimentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Conduct A/B testing across messaging, creatives, audience cohorts, campaign frequency, timing and offers.
* Experiment with different engagement strategies to improve campaign response and conversion rates.
* Identify successful campaign approaches and scale them across relevant audience segments.
* Work closely with Product, Data Analytics and Content teams to improve user engagement and lifecycle performance.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 4–7 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, remarketing, retention or growth marketing.
* Prior experience in OTT, media, entertainment, gaming, e-commerce or consumer internet businesses is preferred.
* Hands-on experience in audience segmentation, campaign automation, personalised marketing and user reactivation.
* Strong understanding of Push Notifications, Email Marketing, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM communication channels.
* Experience working with CRM, marketing automation and customer engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, user cohorts and engagement metrics.
* Understanding of user acquisition, retention, churn, subscriber conversion and monetisation metrics.
* Ability to independently plan, execute and optimise multiple campaigns.

**Key Success Metrics**

* User reactivation and repeat engagement
* DAU / MAU growth
* Repeat viewership and content consumption
* Subscriber conversion and renewals
* User retention and churn reduction
* Campaign ROI and incremental revenue

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**About Gruve**
Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Account Manager with strong hands-on experience in Network Security, Firewall technologies, and team leadership. The ideal candidate will be an individual contributor as well as a team manager, capable of driving complex projects while also mentoring and managing a team of Network Security Engineers and Consultants.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage end-to-end network security projects across global enterprise environments.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert on Palo Alto Networks, FortiGate, Cisco Firewalls, and Load Balancers (Citrix/F5).
* Design, implement, and manage security rules and configurations on Palo Alto and FortiGate firewalls.
* Troubleshoot Layer 4 and Layer 7 application and connectivity issues.
* Oversee Global Protect VPN configurations and support.
* Manage firewall backups and recovery operations for business continuity.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables aligned with PMP and ITIL frameworks.
* Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for configuration changes and operational processes.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of network security engineers and consultants, ensuring high-quality project delivery.
* Interface with clients, vendors, and internal teams to present project status, security recommendations, and risk assessments.
* Lead and mentor a team of network security engineers and consultants.
* Allocate tasks, review configurations, and guide the team to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Conduct training and upskilling sessions for team members on security best practices and tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across network security operations.

**Basic Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s or Master's in one of: Computer Science or Related filed.
* 8+ years of overall experience in Network Security and Project Management.
* Strong hands-on expertise with Palo Alto or FortiGate firewalls and Load Balancers (F5/Citrix).
* In-depth understanding of Network Security, Firewalls, VPN, and advanced troubleshooting at L4-L7.
* Proven experience managing global security infrastructure projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of ITIL processes, change management, and incident/problem management.
* Experience in creating security rules, policy updates, and access control configurations.
* PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)
* PCNSE (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer)
* NSE4 (Fortinet Network Security Expert Level 4)
* Citrix (Networking / ADC)

**Why Gruve**
At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Engagement Manager
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

8. Spot opportunities to expand services with existing clients, such as Virtual CFO, fundraising support and advisory

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

3. Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP 9 / Prime)

4. Solid understanding of GST, TDS and tax compliance

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

2. Familiarity with other accounting software such as Zoho or QuickBooks

3. Exposure to FP&A, fundraising support or investor reporting

4. Exposure to D2C, e-commerce, F&B, SaaS or financial services clients

5. Experience in a CA firm, advisory firm or virtual CFO setup

**What You'll Gain**

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

4. A fast track to larger portfolios and leadership responsibilities

description:
**About The Role**
PubMatic is looking for a strategic and commercially driven Associate Director, Advertiser Solutions to help grow our buyer-side business across South Asia. This role will focus on building and scaling relationships with advertisers, agencies, trading teams, and other demand-side stakeholders, while driving adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused programmatic solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the programmatic advertising ecosystem, strong understanding of buyer and DSP workflows, and a proven ability to win new business, grow strategic accounts, and influence go-to-market priorities. This role requires strong direct brand relationships in addition to agency connectivity, with the ability to engage senior marketing, media, and programmatic decision-makers and translate PubMatic’s capabilities into clear commercial value.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Drive business growth
  
  

* Own and grow revenue for PubMatic’s Advertiser Solutions business across South Asia.
* Build, manage, and convert a strong pipeline of opportunities across advertisers, agencies, trading desks, and other buy-side partners.
* Identify, prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new business opportunities.
* Expand PubMatic’s footprint with both existing and new buyers through strategic account planning and targeted growth initiatives.
* Drive adoption of PubMatic’s buyer-side solutions, including private marketplace, preferred, programmatic guaranteed, curated, and Activate-led opportunities.

Build strategic client relationships
  
  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with brands, agency investment teams, trading desks, and programmatic leads across South Asia.
* Strengthen PubMatic’s direct access to brand-side decision-makers across digital, media, and marketing teams.
* Build senior-level relationships with strategic clients and position PubMatic as a consultative partner for premium supply access, efficiency, transparency, and performance.
* Partner closely with agencies and advertisers to uncover growth opportunities and drive long-term adoption.

Lead strategic customer engagement
  
  

* Own strategic engagements with key accounts, ensuring high-quality pre-sales support, thoughtful solutioning, and strong post-sale alignment with internal teams.
* Map customer business goals to PubMatic solutions and develop account strategies that drive measurable outcomes.
* Support renewals, account expansion, and deeper buy-side integration through proactive relationship management and opportunity development.
* Provide clear market and customer feedback to improve solution adoption and account growth.

Influence product and market strategy
  
  

* Bring actionable customer feedback, market insight, and competitive intelligence into internal product and commercial discussions.
* Help shape go-to-market strategy based on customer needs and evolving buyer dynamics.
* Partner with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions teams to refine positioning, strengthen messaging, and improve sales readiness.
* Develop a strong understanding of PubMatic’s marketplace design, supply dynamics, and advertiser value proposition.

Represent PubMatic in market
  
  

* Build PubMatic’s visibility and credibility across the South Asia buy-side ecosystem.
* Stay current on industry trends, supply path optimization, privacy and addressability changes, and shifts in advertiser buying behavior.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Meets or exceeds monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for Advertiser Solutions.
* Builds a strong pipeline and converts strategic opportunities into long-term customer value.
* Expands PubMatic’s direct relationships with both brands and agencies in South Asia.
* Increases adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused solutions across key accounts.
* Contributes meaningful customer and market insight that helps shape strategy and execution.

Who You Are
  
  
**Must Have**

* 9–12+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, AdTech, media sales, agency partnerships, DSP, SSP, or advertiser-facing platform roles.
* Strong understanding of the buyer-side and DSP ecosystem and how advertisers and agencies buy programmatically.
* Proven success in new business development, pipeline building, and strategic account growth.
* Strong direct relationships across brands, agencies, and trading teams in South Asia.
* Experience selling or positioning programmatic advertising solutions to advertiser and agency stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of private marketplace deals, programmatic guaranteed, supply path optimization, curation, and premium programmatic buying models.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate technical and platform capabilities into compelling client value.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with strong ownership and accountability.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience at an SSP, DSP, agency trading desk, media platform, or advertiser technology company.
* Experience managing strategic partnerships and complex commercial negotiations.
* Familiarity with South Asia market dynamics, major holding groups, independent agencies, and key advertiser categories.
* Experience contributing to product feedback loops, go-to-market planning, or market enablement initiatives.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

Keeping abreast with the changes in regulations (site, regional, global, HO), assess its impact.

The incumbent will drive process efficiency, team performance, and adherence to global and local regulations while maintaining audit-ready records and fostering collaboration with Relationship Managers, Compliance, and Legal teams.

Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Client Onboarding Specialists, ensuring high performance, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Set clear team objectives, KPIs, and SLAs aligned with BNP Paribas Wealth Management’s policies and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and implement training programs to enhance team skills.
* Drive continuous improvement in client onboarding processes, including SOP updates, control plans, and automation initiatives.
* Identify process bottlenecks and propose efficiency-enhancing solutions (e.g., reducing false positives in name screening).
* Support the execution of controls and tasks required in the Client‑Onboarding – Data‑Maintenance & Banking‑Services process, ensuring that client documentation, data‑capture activities and banking services meet the Bank’s policies, standards and all applicable local legal‑regulatory requirements.
* Perform daily and name‑screening checks (on‑boarding and periodic re‑screening). Keep watch‑lists, match‑thresholds and screening parameters up‑to‑date, investigate alerts, assign risk ratings, document decisions, and promptly escalate high‑risk matches. Maintain complete audit trails and respond to internal‑ and external‑audit queries. Work closely with Relationship Management, Legal and Compliance to resolve exceptions and drive process‑improvement/automation initiatives.
* Provide end‑to‑end support to internal customers for the onboarding of new clients, including linking clients to banking‑service tools (e.g., direct advisory‑desk access, dormant/deceased accounts, block/unblock requests).
* Maintain sound work processes, data‑integrity and the secure storage of client documents (electronic, scanned‑image or paper).
* Stay abreast of regulatory changes (site, regional, global, head‑office) and assess their impact on local workflows (SG/HK).
* Verify that controls are in place for the safe custody of account documentation and for mitigating operational risks arising from user requests to access databases containing sensitive client data, signatures or document images.
* Contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of permanent‑control policies, procedures and control‑plans for daily operations; assist with updating SOPs.
* Comply with regulatory requirements, internal guidelines and operational‑risk procedures; promptly escalate incidents to Management, Permanent‑Control or Compliance as appropriate.
* Report all incidents through the Incident‑Management System and help minimise operational failures (including fraud) by applying regular controls.
* Ensure the integrity of client‑data creation and maintenance while meeting SLA/KPI targets; manage account‑closure processes.
* Prepare regular management reports (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/periodic statistics).
* Provide regional support in line with SG and HK working hours and public‑holiday calendars.
* Work collaboratively within a flexible, transversal team; coordinate with internal partners (WM‑COB SG/HK, Compliance, Legal, Front‑Office, Client‑Onboarding & Due‑Diligence, and other WMHK/WMSG support teams) to resolve complex cases and maintain a smooth support process.

* Understand the principles and be familiar with Client databases’ requirements individuals/Corporates/Holding Companies/Trust Accounts.

* Must possess strong fundamental and technical skills, awareness of operational risk.

* Knowledge of advanced formulas & pivot tables in excel is must.

* Proactively seeks root cause solutions to recurring false positive trends.
* Handles high volume alert periods (e.g., sanctions regime updates) while maintaining quality.

**Specific Qualifications**

Bachelor Degree or equivalent

title: Associate Director — Agency Activation
description:
**About The Team**
JioAds help connect marketers and businesses to over hundreds of millions of Indian consumers. Our consumers spend more than seven hours a day with us. They connect to the internet via our Jio mobile network and JioFiber solutions. They engage with us across our media and connectivity solutions like JioTV, JioGames, JioChat and Jio Cinema to name a few. With unique first-party consumer insights, JioAds helps advertisers grow their business across their offline-online consumer purchase cycle. We deliver an optimized brand experience for both the advertiser and consumer across video, display, custom experiences, in-store experiences, digital OOH, audio, connected devices and coupons. All in a “brand-safe” omnichannel network. We also work with premium publishers, helping monetize their ad inventory. With high performing, customized ad formats including native, interstitial and pre-roll and mid-roll, JioAds helps drive revenue across all publisher platforms. With our powerful technology and insights, led locally by our Indian technology and product team, we are able to meet specific business and growth needs of advertisers and publishers effectively.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Director — Agency Activation is a senior commercial and relationship role responsible for building and deepening JioAds’ presence across India’s agency ecosystem. You will own two distinct but connected mandates~ activating JioAds within agency planning and buying teams across all holding groups, and delivering high-impact client activation events that drive brand consideration and pipeline.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a boardroom presenting JioAds’ data story to an agency CSO and on the ground running a brand engagement event in Bengaluru. You will be the face of JioAds to the agency world.
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES~**
**Agency Evangelisation & Relationships**

* Own and deepen the JioAds relationship with all major agency holding groups at planning, strategy, and leadership levels.
* Build a structured evangelisation programme that gets JioAds on the standard media plan across agencies — not just as a one-off but as a consistent, preferred platform.
* To ensure agency partners are fully briefed on JioAds’ volume deal structure, cohort capabilities, and product benchmarks. Identify, recruit, and onboard agency champion groups that have historically been flat for JioAds and represent the single biggest growth opportunity in FY 26-27.
* Track agency-wise revenue, pipeline, and engagement — reporting weekly to the Business Head with clear visibility on what is converting and what is blocked.

**Client Activation & Events**

* Lead the planning and execution of JioAds’ client activation programme — brand engagement sessions, agency roadshows, and immersion events targeting senior brand marketing teams.
* Build a quarterly activation calendar that creates consistent touchpoints with the advertiser universe — covering South, North, and West markets.
* Work closely with the marketing team to ensure each activation event is supported by strong JioAds collateral — case studies, cohort playbooks, product decks — and that follow-through is tracked.
* Coordinate post-event CRM — ensuring every brand contact from an activation is logged, followed up by the relevant regional CP, and tracked through to pipeline.
* Represent JioAds at industry forums, agency summits, and trade events (FICCI, IAA, adtech, Goafest) as a visible platform spokesperson.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with regional sales leads to align agency activation with regional revenue priorities.
* Coordinate with the product and data teams to ensure the JioAds cohort story is always current, accurate, and differentiated in market.
* Provide regular market intelligence on agency sentiment, competitor activity, and pricing feedback to the Business Head.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Outstanding relationship builder — able to open doors, build trust quickly, and sustain relationships over time at senior levels.
* Strong commercial instinct — understands how agency economics work (VDs, trading deals, margins) and can navigate them without losing the partnership.
* Credible presenter and storyteller — able to take complex data and audience proposition and make it land simply and compellingly for an agency planner or brand CMO.
* Organised and disciplined — can run multiple activation programmes and relationship tracks simultaneously without losing sight of pipeline impact.
* Comfortable working in a high-growth, high-ambiguity environment where structure is still being built.

**EXPERIENCE~**

* 8–12 years of experience in digital advertising, media, or marketing, with at least 5 years in a senior agency-facing or partnerships role.
* Demonstrable experience managing relationships with one or more major agency holding groups at a senior level
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth through agency channels — not just managing relationships but converting them to commercial outcomes.
* Experience owning or co-owning large-format brand events, immersion sessions, or industry roadshows.
* Prior experience in a programmatic, data-led, or audience-first advertising platform is strongly preferred.
