title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

Trade Relations & Strategic Alliances will be responsible for developing, managing, and strengthening strategic relationships across the travel ecosystem, including tourism boards, destination and attraction partners, airlines, hotel chains, and other key stakeholders. The role will drive joint marketing initiatives, secure co-operative marketing investments, and ensure the successful execution of partnership commitments that support business growth, brand visibility, and customer acquisition objectives.

Joint Marketing & Campaign Management

* Conceptualize and implement co-branded marketing campaigns with partners across online and offline channels.
* Develop annual partnership and marketing plans to maximize joint business opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure timely execution of campaigns and promotional activities.

Commercial Negotiations & Funding

* Negotiate marketing support, co-op funding, sponsorships, and commercial agreements with partners.
* Secure partner investments and ensure optimum utilization of approved budgets.
* Track and deliver agreed commercial commitments, marketing KPIs, and passenger/revenue targets.

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Business, Product, Revenue, MIS, Finance, Accounts, Legal, and Operations teams to ensure smooth implementation of partnership initiatives.
* Facilitate contract execution, compliance reviews, campaign approvals, and budget management processes.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

* Monitor campaign performance, ROI, partner commitments, and business outcomes.
* Prepare periodic reports, presentations, and business reviews for internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Ensure accurate tracking of partner investments, marketing deliverables, and business generation.

Financial & Contract Management

* Work with Finance and Accounts teams to manage partner invoicing, reconciliations, fund utilization, and claim settlements.
* Ensure timely closure of contracts, documentation, reporting requirements, and financial obligations.
* Maintain compliance with internal policies and legal requirements.

Key Competencies

* Strategic partnership development
* Commercial negotiation and influencing skills
* Stakeholder management
* Marketing and brand collaboration expertise
* Financial and budget management
* Project management and execution excellence
* Analytical and reporting skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Relationship-building and networking capability

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Partner funding secured
* Number and quality of strategic partnerships established
* Campaign ROI and lead/passenger generation
* Delivery against partner marketing commitments
* Revenue and business generated through partnership initiatives
* Timely closure of commercial agreements and reconciliations
* Partner satisfaction and relationship health

This role is ideal for a professional who combines strong commercial acumen, relationship management expertise, and marketing execution capabilities to drive mutually beneficial partnerships and business growth.

description:

Property Manager

The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Property Managers to manage the owner and tenant experience across active residential property-management files.
  
  
Direct property-management experience is preferred but not required. Strong account, portfolio or client-service managers with experience managing multiple files, relationships and escalations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
This role is for someone who can keep files moving, keep clients informed, manage urgent issues and remain organized in a high-volume environment. You will be responsible for communication, follow-up, documentation, issue resolution and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  
  
This is not a basic customer-service position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of client outcomes, manage multiple properties and files simultaneously, and communicate professionally with property owners, tenants, internal teams and service providers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the main point of contact for property owners and tenants throughout the management relationship.
* Manage multiple active clients, properties and files with strong organization and follow-through.
* Provide proactive updates so owners understand what is happening, what is pending and what comes next.
* Handle time-sensitive property and tenancy matters with urgency, professionalism and clear communication.
* Coordinate next steps between owners, tenants, internal departments, vendors and other service providers.
* Collect, review and track required property, owner and tenant documentation.
* Maintain complete CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow-ups, updates and file movement.
* Identify stalled files, missed follow-ups, client concerns and service problems before they escalate.
* Escalate serious issues promptly and use sound judgment to protect client satisfaction.
* Support a structured, process-driven property-management experience from onboarding through ongoing management.

**Requirements**

* Three to five or more years of property management, account management, client success, client services, relationship management or comparable client-ownership experience.
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients, properties, accounts or active files simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and confidence handling owner, tenant or client concerns.
* Strong process discipline and comfort working within a structured CRM and task-management system.
* Strong follow-up habits, task management and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize quickly in a high-volume environment.
* Professional judgment when handling complaints, escalations, deadlines and sensitive client matters.
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Direct property-management, leasing, real estate operations or housing-related experience.
* Experience supporting both clients and end users, such as owners and tenants or customers and service providers.
* Experience working with North American clients.
* Experience in a high-volume, service-based, operations-heavy or SLA-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating maintenance, leasing, payments, documentation or service-provider activities.
* Comfort using AI and other tools to improve documentation, reporting, summaries and internal efficiency.

Remote Technology Requirements
  
  

* Dual-monitor setup
* Computer with at least 16GB of RAM
* Reliable internet connection of at least 100 Mbps
* Webcam
* Noise-cancelling headset
* Professional and quiet environment for calls

**Compensation**
Total annual compensation ranges from
**C$30,000 to C$36,000**
, based on experience, qualifications and performance.
  
  
Candidates with direct property-management experience, strong owner and tenant communication skills, and proven success managing a high volume of active files may be considered near the top of the range.
  
  
Complete details regarding base compensation and performance bonuses will be shared during the interview process.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview from our recruitment partner within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Senior Data Consultant
description:
**The Group**
Morningstar provides independent analysis on individual securities, funds, markets, and portfolios. Morningstar also provides data on hundreds of thousands of investment offerings, including stocks, mutual funds, and similar vehicles, along with real-time global market data on millions of equities, indexes, futures, options, commodities, and precious metals, in addition to foreign exchange and Treasury markets. Morningstar is one of the largest independent sources of fund, equity, and credit data and research in the world, and our advocacy for investors’ interests is the foundation of our company.
  
  
**The Role**
Morningstar Managed Investment Data Team seeks a (
**Senior) Data Consultant / Data Relationship Manager**
to champion Morningstar data capabilities in India. The employee will represent Morningstar’s data capabilities to clients and industry groups and return the voice of the local market back to the global and central teams. In this role you are responsible for identifying new data opportunities and will collaborate with teams across the company to define and execute upon Morningstar’s unique value proposition in response to industry trends.
  
  
The (Senior) Data Consultant / Data Relationship Manager plays a significant role in ensuring that Morningstar’s offering in the managed investments space exceeds industry expectations. The managed investments space includes, but is not limited to, Managed Funds, Insurance funds, ETF’s, Separate Accounts, Models, and other emerging investment vehicles and marketplaces. All data sets including returns, portfolio and ESG data are within the scope of this role. The position will be based in
**Mumbai, India,**
and report to the Data Director, Managed Investment Data - Asia Pacific.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage relationships with Indian fund companies and third-party administrators. Visit fund companies and providers to set up acquisition channels as well as acting as a point of escalation when such channels are failing.
* Data expert on investment data points, processes, methodologies, calculations & different fund structures.
* Promote Morningstar data at a local level to internal & external clients. Produce materials to assist retaining & obtaining business.
* Partner with sales, product & support teams on the prospect discovery process & lead generation and serve as the subject matter expert to address data inquiries.
* Collaborate with members of the Global Data teams to align priorities based upon local business requirements.
* Conduct business analysis & manage projects focused on enhancing our database in order to meet changes in our industry and client’s needs.
* Bring back voice of client for data or process enhancement.
* Monitor competitor behavior, trends and services in order that Morningstar are well placed to act on any opportunities that may arise.
* Monitor local asset management industry trends, regulatory movements, and transform them into implications to Morningstar data business.

**Requirements**
Candidates should have a strong interest in the investment world, strong analytical skills, and excellent communication skills. More details as follows.
  
  

* A minimum of 5-7 years of experience, with demonstrated ability to foster successful external relationships with asset managers, regulator, and third-party data providers.
* Solid understanding of the Indian investment management industry and passionate about investment data.
* Expertise in Morningstar managed investment data, methodology, processes and quality.
* Ability to demonstrate client centric approach.
* Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong learning ability; interested to learn the complex structure of numerous investment vehicles.
* Self-motivated, independent, strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
* A bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, or equivalent is required.
* Excellent capabilities with MS office and Advance Microsoft Excel is required.
* Previous experience in Portfolio Management Services (PMS), Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) and relationship management role is highly preferred.
* Prior experience in Morningstar products and services is a plus.

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

* Progressive experience in account management, client success, sales, or business development, including direct people-management or team-lead responsibility.
* Experience managing mid-market B2B, SaaS, technology, HR technology, or recurring-revenue client portfolios; background screening knowledge is preferred.
* Demonstrated strength in coaching, portfolio strategy, executive communication, pipeline management, forecasting, and cross-functional problem solving.

**Core Competencies**
People leadership and coaching; execution; portfolio strategy; client and escalation management; strategic account management; data-driven forecasting; and cross-functional influence.
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Achievement of team retention, growth, pipeline, revenue, and product adoption goals.
* Improvement in client health, risk management, forecast accuracy, and CRM data quality.
* Consistent delivery and documented follow-through of Business Reviews for designated accounts.
* Account Manager performance, capability development, engagement, and adherence to agreed operating standards.

**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

description:

title: Managing Consultant, Account Management.
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Managing Consultant, Account Management.
  
  
Managing Consultant, Services Account Management, Acquiring & Processing
  
  
Mastercard Services, the professional services arm of Mastercard, provides payments-focused consulting services to financial institutions and merchants worldwide. Within Services, the Acquiring & Processing practice helps financial institutions, processors, fintechs, merchants, and other ecosystem participants navigate the evolving payments landscape and unlock growth opportunities.
  
  
We are seeking a Managing Consultant, Services Account Management, to support the regional teams driving the growth of Mastercard’s Acquiring & Processing business across Asia Pacific. This role combines subject matter support, client engagement support, and industry expertise to help identify opportunities, support the shaping of client solutions, and support the commercialization of Mastercard Services capabilities led by authorized regional teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of acquiring, processing, acceptance, payment infrastructure, and merchant ecosystems, coupled with the ability to translate client challenges into actionable growth opportunities.
  
  
Key questions for candidates
  
  
Are you passionate about helping clients solve complex acquiring, acceptance, and payment processing challenges?
  
  
Can you leverage your industry expertise to support the identification of business opportunities and contribute to client value?
  
  
Do you enjoy working across clients, account teams, and product specialists to bring innovative solutions to market?
  
  
Serve as a subject matter expert in acquiring, payment acceptance, processing, merchant acquiring, and payment infrastructure trends.
  
  
Support the Regional Services Business Development teams and Account Management teams to identify, qualify, and advance acquiring & processing opportunities.
  
  
Support the development of client growth plans, business cases, and solution recommendations that address key client priorities.
  
  
Engage with clients to understand business challenges, document opportunities, and articulate the value of Mastercard Services capabilities, with the direction of the regional team.
  
  
Support in preparing proposal content, commercial inputs, and client presentations for the regional team.
  
  
Support the development of trusted working relationships with client stakeholders across acquiring banks, processors, fintechs, merchants, and payment ecosystem participants.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams including Consulting, Product, Customer Solutions Center, and regional market teams to support integrated solutions for clients.
  
  
Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies impacting the acquiring and processing landscape.
  
  
Support pipeline tracking, opportunity documentation, and reporting accuracy for the regional Services team.
  
  
Contribute to thought leadership and knowledge sharing activities within the Acquiring & Processing practice.
  
  
**Experience**
6-10 years of experience in acquiring, payment processing, merchant payments, acceptance, fintech, payments consulting, or related financial services fields.
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of merchant acquiring, payment processing, acceptance ecosystems, payment gateways, processor economics, or related areas.
  
  
Prior experience supporting account management, solutioning, consulting, product management, or partnership coordination.
  
  
Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders.
  
  
Ability to translate complex industry concepts into clear business value propositions.
  
  
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking capabilities.
  
  
Proven ability to work effectively across matrixed teams in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  
  
Professional level English language capability required.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
  
  
Location: Mumbai
  
  
At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands - deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end-to-end from the first conversation to go-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" - this role is built for you.
  
  
**We're The Perfect Match If You**

* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI-first and hands-on - you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can-do attitude - when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence - equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product & Engineering.
* Thrive on ownership and ambiguity - you'd rather run a thread yourself than wait for a map.

**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like**

* Own end-to-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients - from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go-live - within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable asks for internal teams - and translate the most appropriate solution back out to the client.
* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on-time.
* Act as the key point of contact across the delivery lifecycle, keeping clients and internal Product / Engineering / Sales / CX aligned.
* Run multiple client implementations at once - tracking dependencies, risks, blockers, and timelines, and prioritizing by client impact and business criticality.
* Spot recurring patterns and push to standardize and improve how delivery gets done.

Why IDfy
  
  
At IDfy, we don't just build products - we build trust infrastructure for the digital economy. In this role, you'll sit at the frontline of how that trust actually reaches clients: owning delivery, shaping solutions, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with Product and Engineering.
  
  
If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins - this is your playground.

title: Senior Manager - Partnership and Alliances
description:

We are looking for a high-impact, strategic leader to drive the growth of our Loyalty & Partnerships ecosystem through powerful alliances and innovative partner-led initiatives. This role will be instrumental in building and owning a differentiated partner ecosystem across banking, retail, travel, and lifestyle, with a strong focus on creating measurable customer and business value. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the partnership strategy and commercial models while building long-term strategic partnerships that strengthen customer engagement.

* Business Performance & Revenue ownership Own the partnership business cases and performance including revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, engagement and retention targets.

* Partner Relationship Management Build and nurture senior stakeholder relationships to drive strategic alignment, sustained engagement and long-term value creation.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business or a related field
* Overall, 8–10 years of experience in partnerships or loyalty marketing, preferably in consumer-facing industries
* Hand-on experience developing, launching or managing credit card programs, payment partnerships & offers
* Experience leading complex commercial negotiations, product development and cross-functional execution

**Skills & Knowledge:**

* Strong financial acumen with the ability to build business case and evaluate partnership economics.
* Proven ability to design and scale high-impact propositions.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with experience in structuring complex deals.
* Ability to translate customer insights into compelling value propositions.
* Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities to unlock value through partnerships. - Experience influencing senior stakeholders internally and externally

**-**

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Manager, you will lead the design and delivery of Decision Intelligence solutions, own stakeholder alignment, and guide cross-functional teams from business problem definition through deployment and value realization. The role requires strong solution leadership, data fluency, and hands-on understanding of Aera delivery.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery workshops to define business objectives, decision triggers, personas, KPIs, constraints, actions, and measurable outcomes.
* Own end-to-end solution design across data, recommendation logic, workflow, user experience, action enablement, security considerations, testing, deployment, and support.
* Guide teams in translating business needs into scalable Aera techno-functional designs and delivery plans.
* Review SQL, data mappings, business rules, solution configurations, test evidence, and release readiness for quality and traceability.
* Manage client stakeholders, scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive-level communication.
* Lead functional and technical teams, allocate work, coach team members, and ensure delivery governance.
* Drive user acceptance, adoption planning, operating model readiness, deployment, hypercare, and outcome tracking.
* Identify reusable assets, accelerators, and delivery standards to improve quality and productivity.
* Partner with sales and account teams on solution shaping, estimates, staffing, and proposal support where required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field; a master's degree is advantageous.
* MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* More than 10 years of overall experience in consulting, enterprise technology, analytics, data solutions, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading techno-functional solution delivery and multi-disciplinary teams.
* Strong SQL and data analysis capability sufficient to review solution logic, validate data, and guide technical teams.
* Proven stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, solution governance, risk management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to connect solution design to business value, adoption, actionability, and measurable outcomes.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior Aera implementation and leadership experience is a strong plus.
* Experience designing Decision Intelligence solutions or equivalent recommendation and action-oriented enterprise solutions.
* Domain experience in supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance transformations.
* Experience with cloud data ecosystems, integration patterns, analytics, AI/ML, or process orchestration.

**What We Look For**

* Who can create clarity across business, functional, data, and technology workstreams.
* Coach teams toward high-quality, reusable, and supportable delivery.
* Escalate risks early and maintain transparent governance with account and client leadership.
* Own the connection between delivery outputs and client business outcomes.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

: KAM – QCom

: 5+ Years

: Mumbai / Ahmedabad

We are looking for an experienced and data-driven E-Commerce Manager to lead and optimize our online business across marketplaces and D2C websites. The ideal candidate will manage key

marketplace accounts, improve product visibility, enhance conversion rates, and drive revenue

growth through strategic planning, performance marketing inputs, and cross-functional

collaboration.

title: Senior Associate / Manager - Delivery and Engagement: VCFO
description:
**Key responsibilities:**

**1. Client calls and relationships**

* Get on client calls regularly - not just when something's on fire. You're the face of delivery for your portfolio.
* Build real working relationships with founders, finance heads and their teams, so trust exists before you ever need it.
* Use calls to understand the client's business rhythm, upcoming pressures and unstated expectations - and feed that back into the delivery plan.
* Run client status reviews and onboarding calls; leave every conversation with clear decisions, owners and dates.

**2. Own delivery and timelines**

* Build and maintain a delivery plan per client: scope, recurring deliverables, owners, client inputs, review stages, TATs, due dates.
* Drive on-time delivery across monthly close, bookkeeping, MIS, financial reporting, tax/compliance handoffs, budgets and forecasts.
* Flag upcoming statutory dates to the subject-matter owner - a calendar reminder is not technical sign-off.
* Set priorities, allocate work, watch capacity and backlog, remove blockers before they put a commitment at risk.
* Nothing reaches a client unreviewed or incomplete; you close out corrections and open items.

**3. Lead the team**

* Lead the delivery team day to day - build rapport, set the tone, and be the person they escalate to without hesitation.
* Allocate work fairly across the team, spot overload early, and coach juniors on quality and turnaround habits.
* Run short, regular internal reviews: what's on track, what's stuck, who needs help.
* Keep the team aligned with client promises - everyone knows what was committed and by when.

**4. Manage client expectations**

* Agree realistic timelines and input requirements at kickoff; confirm any change in scope, priority or date with the client and internal lead.
* Raise risks early, with impact and a recovery plan - never announce a missed date after the fact.
* Own delivery queries and escalations end to end, coordinating across VCFO, accounting, tax and legal.

**5. Run delivery governance**

* Maintain one live view of all commitments: status, overdue items, client dependencies, escalation owners.
* Track and improve the numbers: on-time delivery %, TAT adherence, rework, overdue aging, escalation resolution time.
* Lead new-client transitions into VCFO: agreed scope, owners, reporting cadence, contacts, first-delivery plan.

**Key requirements:**

* Strong background in client servicing, client delivery, or audit is mandatory.
* 6-8 years of experience in a similar field (VCFO services, CA/advisory firm, outsourced finance & accounting, or comparable client-facing finance delivery).
* Qualified CA preferred, but open to candidates with equivalent hands-on experience managing books at scale.
* Has personally managed high-volume books and multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Has led or managed a team - not just delivered individually.
* Strong phone/video presence; genuinely enjoys client conversations, not just tolerates them.
* Working command of accounting and reporting cycles, MIS, month-end close, and tax/compliance coordination.
* Clear, direct communication - comfortable delivering hard news early, with a plan.

**Why this role matters:**
Our clients feel Treelife through delivery. You are the person who makes "on time, every time" true.

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

The Staff Technical Account Manager will be joining the TAM team at Nutanix India. * Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric mindset and the ability to engage effectively with both technical teams and senior customer stakeholders.
* Proven experience in technical account management, strategic customer engagement, and building trusted, long-term customer relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams, including Support, Engineering, Professional Services, and Solution Architects, to drive customer success and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Strong consultative engagement skills, with the ability to understand customer business objectives, identify technical and operational challenges, and recommend solutions that drive product adoption, platform optimization, and business value.
* Ability to proactively manage customer expectations, identify risks and opportunities, influence stakeholders, and drive strategic account initiatives.

Work Arrangement
  
  
This role is fully on-site, requiring work from the customer’s office in Mumbai five days a week to enable close collaboration with customer teams. Your manager will provide additional guidance on team-specific expectations and working norms.

title: Senior Account Manager - IT/ITeS, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
description:
**Description**
Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a Senior Account Manager to lead cloud strategy and revenue growth across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.
  
  
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own the end-to-end cloud strategy for a portfolio of strategic, high-revenue IT services companies, software product firms, and technology-enabled services organizations. You will operate as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, influencing multi-year technology decisions and driving large-scale digital transformation programs. This role requires you to think at the level of how India's leading technology companies architect their platforms, modernize their delivery models, and build next-generation solutions on AWS for their global customers. You will define the strategic direction for your accounts, execute complex multi-stakeholder commercial engagements, mentor junior Account Managers, contribute to segment-level strategy, and represent the voice of the IT/ITeS customer within AWS to influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS.
* Own the long-term cloud strategy for your accounts and develop multi-year account plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives, including platform modernization, IP development on AWS, and enabling customers to build cloud-native offerings for their end clients.
* Executive Relationship Building and Influence: Establish and sustain CXO-level relationships across your accounts. Engage with CEOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Engineering Heads, and Delivery Leaders to position AWS as a strategic partner.
* Influence technology decisions at the board level and drive executive alignment on large transformation programs.
* Complex Deal Structuring and Negotiation: Lead multi-year commercial engagements including EDPs, PPAs, and custom pricing constructs.
* Navigate complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders, legal teams, and partner ecosystems.
* Structure deals that balance customer value with AWS business objectives.
* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Operate as the single-threaded leader for your accounts, orchestrating across Solutions Architects, Partner teams, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.
* Segment Strategy and Market Shaping: Contribute to the IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying industry trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities, pricing strategies, and product investments for the segment.
* Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
* Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement across GenAI, data analytics, and modernization use cases.
* Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice for IT/ITeS organizations

A day in the life
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, deal execution, and team development activities.
  
  
**A Typical Day May Include**
Strategic Planning: Reviewing multi-year account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions. Assessing deal progression across your portfolio, identifying blockers, and aligning resources to accelerate critical opportunities.
  
  
Customer Meetings: Conducting CXO steering committees and executive briefings with business leaders, technical deep-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum on large transformation programs.
  
  
Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go-to-market initiatives, engaging Product teams to address customer requirements, and providing customer feedback that influences service roadmaps critical to the IT/ITeS segment.
  
  
Deal Progression: Advancing complex commercial engagements through the sales cycle, structuring multi-year agreements, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals.
  
  
Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise.
  
  
Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations
  
  
**About The Team**
The IT/ITeS segment team focuses on one of India's most strategic industries, organizations that are transforming their own operations through cloud and building cloud-native solutions and services for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, innovation, and results.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or above, or MBA
* Experience reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals
* Experience navigating prospective accounts from and into a senior executive level to identify new customer opportunities
* 10+ years of technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree, or MBA
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience in technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services

title: Customer Success Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a
**Customer Success Engineer (CSE)**
at Palo Alto Networks, you will be a key Idira(previously CyberArk) technical specialist within our Customer Success organization. You will bridge the gap between technical implementation and business value, acting as an on-demand technical expert to guide deployments, support integrations, and drive customer satisfaction.
  
  
Leveraging your expert product knowledge and consultative skills, you will ensure a seamless onboarding experience and accelerate time-to-value for our customers. You will collaborate closely with Onboarding Customer Success Managers, Sales, and Product Management to solve complex technical challenges and advocate for the customer’s technical needs internally.
  
  

* Onboarding & Adoption: Assist Onboarding CSM to guide new customers through the initial stages of their product journey, orchestrating technical milestones to ensure a smooth transition and early value realization.

title: Implementation Consultant – Client Success & Data
description:
**Implementation Consultant – Client Success & Data**

**Barometer Technologies**

· Mumbai (Worli), hybrid · Full-time · 1–3 years' experience

**₹35,000 – ₹40,000 a month in hand**

, plus health insurance and a half-yearly performance bonus

Restaurants don't need another spreadsheet. They need someone who can make the system work for them, and then show them the numbers that matter. That's this job.

**Who we are**

Barometer builds Baro MATS, the inventory and cost-control system used by restaurants, bars, cafés and cloud kitchens across India. We get our clients live on the system, stay with them every month, and turn their stock and sales data into reports their owners actually use.

**What you'll do**

* **Get new clients live.**

  Map their outlets, items, recipes and processes into MATS, and hit the go-live date.
* **Run the client calls.**

  Most of our work is virtual: training sessions, weekly check-ins, and sorting out whatever is stuck.
* **Keep your accounts on track.**

  Every client has tasks and deadlines. You own them, follow up, and make sure nothing slips.
* **Build the reports.**

  Variance, consumption, food and bar cost. You'll use Claude (AI) every day to analyse data and produce reports faster than anyone thinks is possible.
* **Find the why.**

  When a number looks off, you dig in, find the cause, and fix the process behind it, not just the number.
* **Write it down.**

  Turn what works into SOPs so the next client goes live faster, and pass product feedback to our tech team.

You'll work across full-restaurant clients, bar and liquor clients, and clients who use only our software.

**You'll fit right in if you**

* Have 1–3 years in implementation, customer success, client onboarding, or an analyst or consulting role.
* Think in systems. You like clear rules and step-by-step methods, and you follow a process exactly, every time.
* Are comfortable with data: Excel or Google Sheets (lookups, pivots), and a 5,000-row export doesn't scare you.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with clients in English and Hindi, on calls and on WhatsApp.
* Already use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT at work, or can't wait to.

**Bonus points**

* You've done a similar role at a SaaS company.
* You've worked in food and beverage: a restaurant, hotel, bar or cloud kitchen.
* You've used POS, inventory, ERP or accounting software.

**Probably not for you if**

* You want a back-office job with no client calls.
* You'd rather wing it than follow a process.

**What you get**

* ₹35,000 – ₹40,000 a month in hand, health insurance, and a half-yearly performance bonus.
* Hands-on work with the latest AI tools and workflows, like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. You'll learn them on the job and help build them into how we serve clients.
* Work with some of India's best-known hospitality brands.
* Learn directly from the founders.
* Hybrid working in Mumbai.
* A clear path to senior implementation and account-lead roles.

title: Organic Growth Lead (US Market)
description:
Work Timings - 5 PM to 2 AM IST (US Eastern Time Zone)

Location - Mumbai Office (Andheri East) - In-Person Role

Pepper helps brands win
**organic search, AI search, and every organic channel that drives growth**
. We're building an AI-native customer success team, and we're looking for an
**Organic Growth Lead**
to own organic growth for a small set of our customers across search, AI engines, and channel-level distribution.

Search is changing fast. Buyers now discover brands through Google, through AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and through communities and creators on YouTube, LinkedIn, and Reddit. We're looking for someone who understands this new landscape deeply and can confidently build growth across all of it.

If that sounds like the work you want to be known for, this one's for you.

About the role

As an Organic Growth Lead, you'll be the growth partner for a focused set of accounts (around 5–6). You'll set the growth direction, work alongside an SEO Lead, and lead a small pod that brings the plan to life. You won't do it alone — you'll have a strong team, proven playbooks, our AI workflows, and a center of excellence behind you.

This is a role where strategy and delivery come together: you decide what will move the needle for each customer across SEO, GEO, and distribution, then make sure it actually ships.

What you'll do

* Own the growth plan for your accounts — what we focus on, the pace, and the channels that matter most for each customer
* Partner with an SEO Lead and guide a pod (content, SEO/GEO, distribution, and project management) where everyone does one job really well
* Run and refine our AI-powered content and SEO workflows (we'll train you on these)
* Keep customers close with clear communication, regular reviews, and honest reporting
* Connect the work back to outcomes that matter: organic growth that turns into pipeline

Win in AI Search and GEO

This is central to the role, not a side skill. You'll own how our customers show up in AI-driven search:

* Build a clear point of view on how AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews — retrieve, rank, and cite brands, and what it takes to be the answer they surface
* Shape content, entities, and authority signals so our customers get cited and recommended by AI engines, not just ranked on a blue-link page
* Run GEO audits and turn them into concrete fixes: structure, schema, entity coverage, citability, and brand attribution
* Stay ahead of how AI search is evolving and translate that into an advantage for every account

Own channel-level distribution

Great content only wins when it reaches the right place. You'll build distribution strategy that goes well beyond the website, with a real understanding of how each channel actually works:

* **SEO / GEO**
  — search and AI-answer visibility as the foundation
* **YouTube**
  — search and suggested-led discovery, and how video compounds organic reach
* **LinkedIn**
  — founder- and brand-led organic reach and thought leadership
* **Reddit and communities**
  — authentic presence plus the growing role of community content in both Google and AI search
* **Digital PR**
  — authority, links, and building the brand as a recognised entity

You'll decide which channels matter for each customer, why, and how they reinforce each other — then drive the pod to execute.

What you'll bring

* Strong experience in SEO, content, or organic growth, with a real understanding of how organic compounds over time
* A confident grasp of
  **GEO and AI search**
  — or a deep curiosity and the drive to become an expert fast
* An understanding of
  **channel-level distribution**
  : how YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Digital PR each work, and how to use them together
* An ownership mindset: you like setting direction, not just ticking off tasks
* Comfort using AI tools to work faster and better — we'll help you level up
* Strong communication and the ability to build trust with customers
* The ability to juggle a few accounts and keep them all moving

Nice to have

* Hands-on experience improving AI-search visibility and earning AI citations
* A background in agencies, consulting, or in-house growth teams
* Proven results on a specific distribution channel (YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, or Digital PR)
* A habit of turning wins into repeatable systems and SOPs

Why you'll love it here

* You'll be at the heart of Pepper's shift to an AI-native growth team, working on the most interesting problem in search right now
* Real support: structured onboarding, workshops (including SEO/GEO audits), playbooks, and a sharp engineering team building tools for you
* A focused book of accounts so you can go deep, not spread thin
* Plenty of room to grow as we scale this team

title: Team Lead
description:
**Job Description**
****About TaskUs:****
TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
  
  
The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 45,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
  
  
It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.
  
  
****What We Offer:****
At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
  
  
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your
  
  
teammates and the other departments.
  
  
Being a Team Leader, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department.
  
  
You must be adept at creating reports of your team's performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.
  
  
So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Leader?
  
  
**Requirements**
So, what are we looking for?
  
  

* We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader. Someone with at least one (1) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 10 + teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company.
* We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above-average technical know-how.
* If you have previous experience working in email and live chat customer support roles, then we are looking for you.
* If you're familiar with E-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts - then we definitely want to talk to you.

****How We Partner To Protect You:****
TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.
  
  
****DEI:****
In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
  
  
We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
**https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**
TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
**About Kapture CX**

Founded in Bengaluru in 2014,
**Kapture CX**
began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an
**AI-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises**
.

Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its
**AgentOS platform**
enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows — including
**customer support, sales, collections, and claims**
.

Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end-to-end across
**voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels**
, with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision-making is required.

Today, Kapture is trusted by
**1,000+ enterprises across 18 countries**
, helping organizations transform customer experience, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes through
**AI Agents, Agentic AI, Voice AI, Conversational AI, and intelligent automation**
.

**What is this role all about?**

As a
**Senior Customer Experience Manager**
, you will own the success and growth of a portfolio of enterprise customers on the Kapture platform. You will act as a trusted partner to both business and technical stakeholders, driving CSAT, customer adoption, platform value, advocacy, retention, and long-term account health.

You will combine customer engagement, business understanding, technical expertise, and strong delivery capabilities to help customers achieve their objectives on Kapture. You will also identify opportunities for platform optimization, solutioning, and account growth while partnering closely with internal teams to resolve complex challenges and continuously improve the customer experience.

**Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**

**Client Engagement**

* Own the overall health and success of a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring strong adoption, satisfaction, retention, and long-term value.
* Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor on customer objectives and platform usage.
* Lead QBRs, health checks, success planning, and key customer conversations to understand evolving needs and drive measurable outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks, address concerns, and build mitigation plans to strengthen customer relationships and renewal readiness.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Drive customer onboarding, implementation, integrations, and adoption initiatives, ensuring effective coordination across customers and internal teams.
* Manage multiple customer engagements and cross-functional dependencies to ensure timely delivery and resolution of customer priorities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to drive customer initiatives and ensure effective execution.

**Business Acumen**

* Understand customer business objectives and translate them into opportunities to improve platform adoption, utilization, and ROI.
* Analyze customer health, usage, feedback, and engagement trends to identify risks, improvement opportunities, and areas for growth.
* Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Customer Success and Sales teams to support account growth and long-term customer value.
* Capture customer feedback and translate recurring needs and business challenges into actionable inputs for relevant internal teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Understand the customer's technical architecture and integration setup well enough to have credible conversations with technical stakeholders.
* Maintain/contribute to troubleshooting guides, implementation docs, and RCAs. Owning the documentation of all projects involved in.
* Partner with Engineering/SRE to drive resolution of complex technical escalations, translating root cause into business impact and next steps for the customer.
* Own complex technical escalations by analyzing logs, debugging issues, andPartner with Engineering and Product teams to diagnose issues, drive resolution, and ensure effective communication with customers.

**Solutioning & AI**

* Recommend platform configurations, workflows, integrations, and best practices that address customer requirements and improve business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Kapture's automation and AI capabilities to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Work with Product and technical teams to translate customer requirements into scalable solutions and product improvements.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and contribute to scalable solutions rather than addressing issues individually.

**People Management**

* Mentor and support Customer Experience team members by sharing customer management, technical troubleshooting, and platform best practices.
* Support the team in managing complex customer situations and contribute to building stronger customer-facing capabilities.

**What does success look like in this role?**

Success in this role means
**customers consistently realize measurable value from Kapture's platform, demonstrate strong adoption and engagement, and maintain healthy long-term relationships with Kapture**
.

You build trusted relationships across business and technical stakeholders, proactively resolve customer risks, deliver customer initiatives effectively, and use technical and business insights to improve customer outcomes. You also contribute to retention, account growth, and scalable solutions that improve the overall customer experience.

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**

**Basic Requirements**

* You have
  **5–7 years of experience**
  in fast paced, complex, growth environments in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* You have experience managing
  **enterprise customers across business and technical stakeholders**
  .
* You have a strong understanding of
  **customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management**
  .
* You have experience working with
  **APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations**
  .
* You have experience managing multiple Enterprise SaaS customer engagements in the geography and working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.
* You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance customer, business, and technical priorities.

**You will have an advantage if you:**

* Have exposure to
  **AI-powered CX, conversational AI, chatbots, or automation platforms**
  .
* Have experience with
  **CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot**
  .
* Have experience creating
  **customer playbooks, implementation guides,dashboards, campaign management, troubleshooting documentation, and RCAs**
  .
* Have experience identifying recurring customer issues and driving
  **preventive or scalable solutions**
  .
* Have experience identifying and supporting
  **account expansion opportunities**
  .
* Have experience with
  **dashboarding**
  , APIs, integration frameworks, SQL/NoSQL databases or data flows, tools such as Kafka, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.
