  Help maintain consistency in brand messaging, visual identity, and communication across real estate projects and marketing channels.
* **Reporting & Documentation:**
  Maintain project trackers, meeting notes, briefs, approval records, and status updates to ensure transparency and effective project management.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Identify opportunities to improve internal workflows, coordination, turnaround times, and the overall efficiency of marketing operations.

***Requirements:***

* **4–6 years of experience**

* Good understanding of marketing, branding, and communication requirements.
* Experience coordinating with multiple internal teams and managing projects from briefing to final delivery.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of creative workflows, marketing collaterals, digital campaigns, and brand communication.
* Excellent organizational, coordination, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to ensure accuracy and quality across all deliverables.
* A proactive approach, with strong ownership, accountability, and the ability to work independently.

  **Mumbai**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos
* Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
Job Description: Relationship Manager Prop Trading Firm

Position:
Relationship Manager
Location:
Onsite
Employment Type:
Full-time

About the company

Skillset Squad brings brand strategy, marketing, creative production, technology and business operations together.

Our approach comes from a practical observation: winning attention is only one part of building a business. A company also needs dependable processes, useful systems, clear responsibilities and the ability to deliver what its brand promises.

We work at the intersection of those needs.

Role Overview

We are looking for a customer-focused and sales-driven
Relationship Manager
to own the end-to-end trader experience. You will guide traders through onboarding, evaluation, funding, and payout processes, while building long-term relationships that drive retention and revenue.

This is a
hybrid role
requiring a blend of client success, sales, and operational support, with a strong focus on trader satisfaction and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Trader Relationship Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for trainees, funded traders, and prospective clients.
* Onboard new traders: welcome them, verify accounts, explain evaluation rules, funding stages, and platform setup.
* Manage inbound queries via live chat, email, WhatsApp/Skype, Discord, or CRM in a professional and timely manner.
* Build trust and maintain high levels of trader engagement and loyalty.

Product & Rules Education

* Explain proprietary trading rules clearly:
* Evaluation phases (one-step/two-step challenges)
* Profit targets and minimum trading days
* Daily loss limits and maximum drawdown
* Consistency rules
* News trading restrictions
* Payout cycles and profit splits
* Assist traders with platform-related questions (MT4/MT5/cTrader or in-house platform).
* Educate traders on realistic risk expectations
  do not promise guaranteed returns.

Sales & Upselling

* Identify opportunities to upsell traders to larger account sizes, add-ons, or additional evaluation packages.
* Support conversion from:
* Free trials → Challenge
* Challenge → Verification
* Verification → Funded account
* Funded account → Scale-up plans
* Achieve monthly KPIs related to revenue, retention, and client activation.

Operational Support

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records in CRM systems.
* Coordinate with the risk and operations teams to resolve trader issues, payout requests, and compliance concerns.
* Escalate technical issues to internal support teams and follow up until resolution.
* Track and document trader feedback to help improve products, rules, and user experience.

Brand & Community

* Represent the brand in Telegram/Discord communities, forums, and social media channels.
* Assist in webinars or live sessions when needed.
* Contribute to a positive, long-term trading culture aligned with the companys values.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required Experience

* 2+ years in relationship management, client success, account management, or sales ideally within:
* Prop trading firms
* Forex / CFDs brokers
* Fintech / online trading platforms
* Crypto or digital assets

Knowledge & Skills

* Strong understanding of prop firm business models, evaluation processes, and payout structures.
* Familiarity with trading platforms like
  MT4, MT5, cTrader
  , or similar.
* Experience with CRM tools such as
  HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Intercom
  , or Zoho.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Additional languages (Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Thai, etc.) are a plus.
* Ability to explain complex trading concepts in a simple and empathetic way.

Personal Attributes

* Target-driven and self-motivated.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Able to work in shifts/rotational hours due to global clients.
* Resilient, adaptable, and calm under pressure.
* Genuine interest in trading and financial markets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Trader satisfaction score (CSAT/NPS)
* Trader retention rate after funding
* Evaluation → funded conversion rate
* Upsell and add-on revenue
* Average response and resolution time
* CRM data accuracy
* Active trader engagement levels

Compensation & Benefits

* Opportunities for growth within a fast-growing prop trading firm

You will own the executive-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.

You will champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.

* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre-sales & delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer & internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Certifications: Must have at least either of these Project management certification (PMI-ACP / PMP / PgMP / Prince 2) and having Salesforce Certification is an asset. An AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.

title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Commercial ownership**

* Own end-to-end e-commerce sales for the UK and EU, delivering monthly and annual targets for revenue, orders and contribution margin
* Build and manage the annual e-commerce budget and P&L, including ad spend, marketplace fees, fulfilment costs and promotions
* Set pricing, promotional calendars and channel-wise assortment to balance growth with profitability
* Forecast demand with the supply chain team and plan stock for each channel to avoid stock-outs and ageing inventory

**Marketplaces**

* Manage and grow seller accounts on Amazon UK & EU (Seller Central/Vendor Central), eBay UK & EU, Etsy and Galaxus
* Identify, evaluate and onboard new marketplaces as needed
* Build and manage Brand Registry, Amazon Brand Store and storefronts on each marketplace, including bundles, multipacks and Subscribe & Save
* Drive listing quality: titles, keywords, A+ content, images, reviews and ratings, and Buy Box health

**Advertising and growth**

* Plan, execute and optimise marketplace advertising (Amazon Sponsored Products, Brands and Display; eBay Promoted Listings; Etsy Ads) within agreed ACoS/TACoS and ROAS targets
* Use deals, coupons, Lightning Deals, Prime Day and Vine to drive trial, reviews and repeat purchase; run external traffic to marketplace listings via Meta, TikTok and Google where it pays back

**Operations and compliance**

* Coordinate with the UK office, FBA and 3PL partners on inbound shipments, stock synchronization and timely dispatch
* Ensure food listings meet UK and EU rules: FSA guidance, EU FIC (Regulation 1169/2011) labelling, allergen declarations for nuts and seeds, nutrition and health claims, and HFSS advertising restrictions in the UK
* Maintain compliance with marketplace policies, GDPR, consumer law, VAT/OSS and returns policies
* Keep customer service, account health and seller ratings at high standards across every channel

**Team leadership and reporting**

* Lead, hire and develop the e-commerce team, setting clear targets and reviewing performance
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly dashboards on sales, margins, ad performance and inventory for leadership
* Generate consumer insights from reviews, search terms, Brand Analytics, customer questions and market research; translate them into new flavours, pack sizes, pricing and listing changes

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing or Operations (or equivalent)
* MBA preferred, ideally in Marketing, E-Commerce or International Business
* Certifications in Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4) or Digital Marketing are a plus

**Experience Skills**

* 5-10 years in e-commerce, with a proven record of managing online sales in UK and EU markets. This is a non-negotiable
* Hands-on experience selling on major marketplaces: Amazon UK & EU, eBay, Etsy and Galaxus; exposure to Bol.com, Kaufland or similar is a plus
* Track record of owning revenue, order and margin targets, and managing an e-commerce P&L and ad budget
* Experience launching a brand on new marketplaces, from account setup and compliance to first-sale and scale-up
* Category experience in food, snacks, FMCG or health foods; working knowledge of food labelling, allergen and shelf-life requirements
* Strong grasp of UK and EU consumer insights: shopper behaviour, snacking trends, price sensitivity, seasonality and competitive landscape, with experience turning data and reviews into product and listing decisions
* Proficiency with Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central, eBay Seller Hub, Etsy Shop Manager, Amazon Ads, Amazon Brand Analytics
* Comfort with multi-currency transactions, VAT/OSS reconciliation and marketplace fee structures
* Strong analytical skills, and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

title: Junior Relationship Manager – School Partnerships & Programmes
description:
Hiring: Relationship Manager – Career Ready India

Organisation: Career Ready India

Location: Mulund, Mumbai

Work Mode: Preferred Work from Office | Hybrid option available (minimum 3 days per week in office)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Career Ready India

Career Ready India is a nationwide initiative focused on bringing structured career guidance, psychometric assessments, career education, and counselling to students from Grades 8 to 12.

We work directly with schools, principals, and educators to implement our programmes and help students make informed education and career decisions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Relationship Manager who can build and maintain strong relationships with school principals and management teams.

The role involves managing schools that have already joined Career Ready India, ensuring smooth programme implementation, and developing relationships with new schools and principals to expand our network.

This is a relationship-driven role combining school engagement, programme coordination, and network development.

Key Responsibilities

1. School Relationship Management

\* Act as the primary point of contact for partnered schools and principals.

\* Maintain regular communication with school leadership and coordinators.

\* Build long-term relationships and ensure continued school participation.

\* Address school queries and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.

2. Programme Implementation & Coordination

\* Coordinate onboarding and activation of schools after enrolment.

\* Schedule and manage psychometric assessments, student registrations, and offline group career counselling sessions.

\* Coordinate the implementation of Career Ready India platform features and other programme deliverables.

\* Work with counsellors, trainers, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution.

\* Track programme progress, school participation, and pending activities.

3. New School & Principal Engagement

\* Connect with principals and schools that have expressed interest in Career Ready India.

\* Develop relationships with new schools and introduce them to the initiative.

\* Follow up with principals after meetings, events, and school interactions.

\* Support the onboarding of additional schools into the Career Ready India network.

4. Reporting & Follow-Ups

\* Maintain accurate records of school interactions and programme implementation.

\* Track school engagement, scheduled activities, and completion status.

\* Provide regular updates to the management team.

\* Identify opportunities to improve school participation and engagement.

Who We’re Looking For

\* 0–2 years of experience in relationship management, school engagement, education partnerships, account management, or programme coordination.

\* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

\* Comfortable interacting with school principals, directors, and senior educators.

\* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple school relationships simultaneously.

\* Proactive, responsible, and consistent with follow-ups.

\* Familiarity with CRM tools, Excel, and digital platforms.

\* Prior experience working with schools or the education sector will be an advantage.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to work on a large-scale national education initiative.

\* Direct engagement with school leaders and education professionals.

\* Exposure to career counselling, psychometric assessment, and education technology.

\* A collaborative work environment with scope for professional growth.

\* Flexibility for a hybrid working arrangement.

Interested?

Please share your CV at schools@careerreadyindia.com with the subject line Application – Relationship Manager.

Website: www.careerreadyindia.com

title: Transition Manager
description:
**Company profile :**

Indevia Accounting Pvt Ltd, a subsidiary of Indevia Accounting Inc., is a rapidly growing accounting firm based in Andheri, Mumbai. The company is an “accounting firm of the future,” using Robotics, Analytics, and Lean Six Sigma principles to improve quality, streamline processes and increase productivity. The focus is on providing timely, accurate, and meaningful accounting to franchisees and franchisors, with a specialty in the U.S. Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) industry. The company is the preferred accounting vendor for four national QSR chains in North America and serves over 35 other brands. IAPL maintains Quality Management Systems (QMS) certified to ISO 9001, and Information Security Management Standard (ISMS) to ISO 27001.

This position calls for a project management-driven role that is key in transitioning and onboarding new clients using our CRM solutions. We are seeking an Individual who would leverage his/her unique expertise to influence a move away from traditional accounting service delivery towards a more modern approach and efficient working practices, thereby acting as a critical change agent.As we continue to automate, we also have added value-added services, including dashboards, analytical tools, process improvement consulting, IT services, and more. Our ability to secure Preferred Vendor positions with QSR franchisors is a testimony to our success. We have led the industry in automation, process improvement, and innovation and plan to continue to do so.

The ideal candidate is inquisitive, hands-on, passionate, and highly consultative in nature. The transition manager (TM) will report to the VP – HR and Operations and closely collaborate with the CEO and Senior Stakeholders to drive projects across Indevia. The individual will lead, manage, and drive (US) Accounting client transitions into our environment.

**Scouting for Transition Manager**

Job Summary:

* Responsible for leading and driving new client and existing client transitions for the addition of new services (migrating, improving, and optimizing the business process into our environment)
* Ensuring the satisfaction of client expectations and that company processes and procedures are followed and maintained, which includes all aspects of personnel, relationships with the client, and detailed decisions to make the transition a success.
* Undertake the development, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of the Transition Plan to meet the strategic goals and interests of the Organization.
* Analyze the current transition process to identify areas for improvement.
* Identify opportunities for work redesign, workflow enhancement, shift utilization, Staff mix, and staff utilization in order to meet / exceed internal financial goals.
* Work with and support the sales team to ensure service agreements are consistent with our deliverables, educate the client on the requirements of a successful transition in due diligence discussions/meetings with clients, draft client solutions, etc.
* Map the work process from client to Indevia, service delivery, client communication, and delivery follow-up. Ensure complete documentation of the service process. Since we primarily serve one type of client, create a service process master document and edit for each client.
* Builds and maintains a departmental structure, operating standards, and practices that are responsive and adaptable to evolving business needs.
* Managing team functions and utilizations, viz. workforce planning, facilitating recruitment, selection, induction, performance appraisal, training, etc., in line with overall business goals.
* Lead the transition team in terms of delivery timelines, service quality, documentation, cost, and client (both internal and external) satisfaction.
* Work location : Mumbai

**Candidate profile:**

* Master's or a bachelor's degree in commerce with 8 - 10+ years of experience or in a related field. Experience in a BPO will be an added advantage
* **Preference: Demonstrated/Proven track record of managing US accounting for Quick Service Restaurant clients (QSR)**
* Managing process improvement and transition projects to completion (and to be able to demonstrate tangible business benefits realization) - (onsite or offshore) – accounting /finance/BPO is a plus.
* Demonstrated success as an accounting process transition manager – experience in P2P or O2C will be a plus.
* Passion for using the best tools available to transform accounting (Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics, Sage 100, Quick books, R365 - highly preferable)
* An entrepreneurial spirit who is excited by the prospect of rapid growth.
* Process-driven with a strong Project Management and Product Owner Mindset
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills with a strong orientation toward customer service and the ability to communicate technical information effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

If this sounds like you, write to us at HRteam@indevia.com and leave your contact information. We will be delighted to offer the insights that you seek about Indevia.

For additional information, please visit www.indevia.com.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer with no discrimination as to gender, religion, caste, creed, disability, or national origin.

title: Delivery and Aggregator Manager
description:
**For Mumbai based candidates only**
(No relocation assistance)

**Role Summary**

The Delivery & Aggregator Operations Manager owns the restaurant's presence and performance across third-party delivery platforms. This person ensures listings are accurate and optimized, offers and promotions are live and correctly displayed, order aggregation and reconciliation runs smoothly, and delivery execution meets speed and quality standards — directly driving online sales growth and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Aggregator & Sales Management*

* Monitor and manage day-to-day operations across delivery aggregator platforms
* Track online sales performance, order volumes, and platform-wise revenue; report daily/weekly/monthly numbers to management
* Identify trends, peak hours, and underperforming SKUs/outlets and recommend corrective action
* Reconcile aggregator payouts, commissions, and settlements against actual sales

*Menu & Offer Accuracy*

* Ensure menu items, prices, images, and descriptions are correctly and consistently listed across all platforms
* Set up, schedule, and verify that discounts, combos, and promotional offers are live and displaying correctly on each app
* Coordinate with platform account managers to resolve listing errors, pricing mismatches, or offer discrepancies quickly
* Plan and execute platform-specific campaigns (ads, banners, sponsored listings) in line with the marketing calendar

*Delivery Management*

* Monitor order acceptance, preparation time (kitchen SLA), and rider pickup/handover to minimize delays
* Track delivery TAT, order accuracy, cancellations, and customer complaints; work with kitchen/packing staff to reduce errors
* Liaise with aggregator logistics support for rider shortages, delayed pickups, or delivery escalations
* Ensure packaging quality standards are maintained to reduce spillage/damage complaints

*Customer Experience & Ratings*

* Monitor ratings, reviews, and customer feedback on each platform; respond to or escalate issues as needed
* Work cross-functionally to resolve recurring complaints (missing items, wrong orders, cold food, etc.)
* Drive initiatives to improve platform ratings and repeat order rates

*Reporting & Coordination*

* Prepare regular MIS reports on sales, offers performance, delivery metrics, and platform issues
* Coordinate between kitchen, front-of-house, and platform support teams to keep operations aligned
* Stay updated on new platform features, commission structures, and competitor activity

**Key Skills & Requirements**

* 1–4 years' experience in QSR/restaurant operations, preferably with exposure to food delivery aggregator platforms
* Working knowledge of delivery aggregator partner/owner apps used for restaurant operations
* Strong attention to detail, especially for pricing/offer accuracy
* Comfortable with basic data/Excel reporting
* Good coordination and communication skills to liaise with platform teams and internal staff
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle real-time issue resolution
* Open to work from multiple outlets (Kurla, Oshiwara and Bandra) for smoother co-ordination

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Online sales growth (platform-wise)
* Order acceptance rate & average delivery TAT
* Order accuracy / complaint rate
* Platform ratings
* Offer uptime and accuracy (% of time correct offers are live)
* Commission/payout reconciliation accuracy

The firm integrates wealth, capital, insurance, legacy, and investments into a unified approach, avoiding siloes and blind spots in financial decision-making. Atom focuses on connecting insights others may overlook, helping clients see the full picture of their financial lives and act with precision. Clients turn to Atom for clear, confident answers rather than options alone, trusting the firm to help architect strong financial foundations and enduring legacies.Role Description The Relationship Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. This role is responsible for managing and growing client relationships across Atom’s wealth, capital, insurance, legacy, and investment offerings. Day-to-day work includes understanding clients’ financial objectives, conducting regular reviews, coordinating with internal specialists to deliver integrated solutions, and ensuring high-quality service and timely responses to client queries. The Relationship Manager will maintain accurate records, prepare proposals and presentations, support onboarding of new clients, and proactively identify opportunities to deepen engagement. The role requires consistent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance standards.Qualifications Strong client relationship management skills, including the ability to understand complex financial needs and provide clear, tailored guidance.Experience in wealth management, financial planning, or related financial services domains, with familiarity across investment, insurance, and legacy planning concepts.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to present information clearly and build trust with diverse stakeholders.Solid analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret financial data, identify opportunities, and recommend appropriate solutions.Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and maintain attention to detail in documentation and follow-up.Comfort with using CRM tools and basic office software to track interactions, prepare reports, and support client servicing.Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, economics, or a related field; a relevant professional certification (such as CFP, CFA, or equivalent) is an advantage.Prior experience in a client-facing role within the Mumbai or broader Indian financial services market is preferred.

title: Lead Account Solution Engineer
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
We are seeking a dynamic Lead Solution Engineer to collaborate with our leading Financial Services clients. This role is pivotal in crafting innovative customer engagement strategies, demonstrating Salesforce’s platform capabilities, and translating complex business needs into impactful solutions.
  
  
You will engage with senior stakeholders, including C-level executives, to create roadmaps and deliver transformational pitches that showcase Salesforce’s value.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Solution Discovery & Design: Understand client needs through targeted discovery sessions; craft tailored Salesforce solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Customer Engagement: Demonstrate Salesforce capabilities via live demos, prototypes, and presentations to various client personas.
* Strategic Roadmaps: Build and articulate clear customer journey strategies and IT roadmaps, highlighting Salesforce’s value proposition.
* Business & Technical Consulting: Lead cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive solutions and articulate benefits to stakeholders.
* Solution Selling: Support sales cycles with RFx responses, business cases, ROI analyses, and impactful demos.
* Client Collaboration: Partner with Business and IT teams, uncover challenges, and build out-of-the-box innovative solutions.
* Thought Leadership: Guide large enterprises on digital transformation, leveraging Salesforce for customer success.
* Territorial Engagement: Travel as required for client meetings and workshops.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10+ years in IT, consulting, or technology sales/implementation.
* Proven experience in pre-sales or solution delivery within Financial Services (Banking, Insurance, Fintechs, NBFCs, Wealth/Asset Management).
* Strong ability to develop and present customer journey maps, use case demos, and solutions aligned with industry needs.
* In-depth understanding of the financial industry’s key metrics, customer engagement processes, and ROI justification.
* Expertise in cloud computing, CRM, marketing automation, and related technologies.
* Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience working with large enterprise clients and engaging at the C-level.

**Even Better If...**

* Salesforce Certifications (e.g., SalesCloud, ServiceCloud, Financial Services Cloud)
* Prior experience as a Salesforce Solution or Sales Engineer in a CRM or similar tech environment.

title: Client Manager -BFSI
description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The primary responsibility of the Senior Client Manager is to take full ownership of his/her assigned accounts. Their key focus is to manage and grow relationships to drive land, expansion and renewals across all solutions within assigned accounts. They are required to identify & pursue leads

title: Key Account Manager - Mumbai
description:
**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.
  
  
At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
**Key Account Manager**
is responsible for will manage and grow relationships with strategic customers in the bioprocessing and life sciences sectors. You will be responsible for driving business growth, managing account relationships, and positioning Cytiva’s innovative solutions to meet customer needs.
  
  
This position reports to the Strategic Accounts Manager and is part of the BioProcess Commercial Organization located in
**Mumbai**
and will be working remotely to cover the assigned customers. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Account Growth & Market Share: Drive market share growth through effective territory planning, account management, and value-based selling. Achieve sales targets and contribute to the broader company goals by promoting Cytiva’s portfolio of bioprocess and life sciences solutions. Drive the identification and generation of demand for new technologies, products, and services within assigned accounts. Focus on expanding Cytiva’s footprint in both existing and new customer organizations.
* Customer Engagement: Actively engage with customers to understand their research and bioprocessing needs, challenges, and business goals. Leverage Cytiva’s product offerings to deliver tailored solutions that exceed customer expectations and accelerate discovery and production processes. Lead negotiations for pricing, contracts, and agreements with key accounts, ensuring both customer satisfaction and Cytiva’s business objectives are met.
* Solution Development: Collaborate with technical specialists and cross-functional teams to understand customer workflows, identifying opportunities to develop and support solutions that address customer needs while leveraging the full breadth of Cytiva’s portfolio.
* Account Relationship Management: Build and manage relationships with decision-makers at various levels within customer organizations. Drive customer satisfaction through regular engagement, understanding their strategic goals, and positioning Cytiva as a trusted partner.
* Sales Forecasting & Reporting: Utilize CRM tools (Salesforce.com) to manage customer insights, accurately forecast sales, track performance, and identify areas for improvement. Maintain a clear view of the sales funnel and report on account status and growth opportunities

**Who You Are**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or higher in Life Sciences, Business, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience: A minimum of 8 years of sales experience in the life sciences, bioprocessing, or related industry. Proven ability to manage complex accounts and drive business growth in a B2B sales environment.
* Customer-Focused: Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with both customers and internal teams, engaging in consultative sales and creating customized solutions that meet customer needs.
* Sales Expertise: Ability to manage and close sales cycles, forecast accurately, and achieve sales targets. Experience in leveraging CRM tools (Salesforce.com) for customer relationship management and sales forecasting is a plus.
* Communication & Presentation Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong technical presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex product details in a customer-friendly manner.

Cytiva, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
  
  
At Cytiva we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Cytiva can provide.
  
  
Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Account Manager- Beauty India
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.
  
  
This position is in our Food Enterprise where we are committed to serving food manufacturers, food service customers, and retailers with a complete range of innovative ingredients and branded products.
  
  
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Account Manager – Beauty India will help increase sales and revenue from moderately complex new and existing market segments and channels. In this role, you will help shape business expansion strategies and provide input for the annual business development plans to reach objectives and revenue.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Develop and execute sales growth strategy for Cargill Beauty's ingredient portfolio in South Asia.
* Drive revenue growth and achieve annual sales targets.
* Manage strategic customer relationships with multinational and local beauty manufacturers.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop project pipelines.
* Collaborate with technical, regulatory, supply chain and marketing teams to support customer projects.
* Lead commercial negotiations, pricing discussions and contract execution.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer needs to support business planning.
* Manage distributors and channel partners where applicable.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates to regional leadership.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Business or related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of sales experience in personal care ingredients, specialty chemicals or related industries.

**Preffered Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of the India beauty and personal care market.
* Proven track record in business development and key account management.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Company Description**

CashFlo is an AI-driven Finance & Accounting company transforming how businesses pay and get paid. The company is addressing India's massive working capital challenges by building intelligent financial solutions that streamline payments, lending, and accounting workflows.

Processing over ₹20,000 crore in invoices every month across 300,000 MSMEs and 1,200+ corporates, CashFlo operates at the intersection of Payments, Lending, and SaaS, with over 30 lending partners integrated into its ecosystem.

Backed by Elevation Capital and General Catalyst, CashFlo brings together leadership from BCG, ISB, IIM, and ICAI, along with experienced industry veterans. The company is building technology-driven financial infrastructure to make business transactions faster, smarter, and more efficient.

**Role Description**

As a Customer Success Engineer at CashFlo, you'll play a critical role in ensuring the successful deployment, configuration, and ongoing technical performance of the company's platform for enterprise customers. This is a full-time, in-office role based in Mumbai, where you'll work at the intersection of engineering, customer success, and product, combining hands-on technical problem-solving with direct customer interaction.

You'll support enterprise deployments, configure integrations and workflows, troubleshoot production issues, and investigate challenges related to data pipelines, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. Working closely with customers, you'll understand their business requirements, resolve technical challenges, and translate their needs into actionable inputs for the Product and Engineering teams.

This is not a traditional customer support role. You'll be expected to work directly with technical systems, handle L1 and L2 production support, debug complex integration and data issues, and contribute to deployment documentation and process improvements. You'll also collaborate with senior engineers on complex implementations, ensuring enterprise customers experience reliable and seamless platform performance.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including technical support (L1/L2), deployment, implementation, or solutions engineering.
* Working knowledge of Java (Spring Boot) or Python, with the ability to understand and troubleshoot backend applications.
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and strong proficiency in SQL for querying, investigating, and resolving data-related issues.
* Solid understanding of ETL pipelines and data workflows, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, and file-based integrations, with the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot integration issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools to investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and improve system reliability.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, along with an understanding of cloud networking fundamentals.
* Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex platform, infrastructure, and performance issues.
* Ability to handle L1 and L2 production support, document incidents effectively, and coordinate escalations with engineering teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with enterprise customers and translate technical concepts into clear explanations.
* Experience creating technical documentation, deployment guides, runbooks, and troubleshooting resources.
* Prior experience working with SaaS, fintech, or enterprise technology platforms is preferred.
* Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP, finance and accounting workflows, or enterprise integrations is an added advantage.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment, take ownership of technical challenges, and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

title: Head - Partner Success and Performance Management (PSS08110)
description:
**About The Company**
A technology-driven platform with a wide-reaching presence across India, supported by an extensive network of customers, partners, service providers, and distribution channels. The organisation is focused on scalable growth, strengthening its partner ecosystem, and leveraging data to enhance business performance and governance.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The
**Head - Partner Success and Performance Management**
role exists to establish disciplined partner governance, transparent reporting, and structured engagement across the complete partner ecosystem. This leadership position is responsible for converting MIS into actionable insights, running governance cadences, securing action closure, and improving service, customer, and business outcomes. The role reports directly to the
**Head CX**
.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design a common governance framework covering partner segmentation, KPIs, SLAs, review frequency, escalation paths, and decision rights.
* Create differentiated engagement models based on partner size, criticality, performance, geography, and customer impact.
* Maintain a central partner repository including scope, contracts, locations, contacts, SLAs, scorecards, review history, and open actions.
* Own a single source of truth for partner MIS; ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and on-time publication.
* Build automated dashboards for volumes, TAT, SLA, ageing, quality, productivity, cost, customer experience, escalations, and action closure.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports with trends, root causes, risks, exceptions, and management actions using Advanced Excel and Power BI/Tableau.
* Partner with Data and Technology teams to automate extraction, alerts, and scorecards, reducing manual reporting.
* Establish and run operational huddles, weekly reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews with defined agendas and participants.
* Prepare fact-based review packs covering performance trends, customer feedback, risks, decisions, and improvement actions.
* Document actions with accountable owners, timelines, and outcomes; maintain rigorous follow-through and escalation until closure.
* Define partner-specific scorecards aligned to business commitments and customer expectations.
* Identify performance deviations early and initiate recovery plans before they affect customers or commercial relationships.
* Benchmark partners and recommend load allocation, incentives, penalties, probation, capability building, or exit based on sustained results.
* Govern partner categories including sales partners, service centres, logistics partners, and contact-centre partners with tailored KPIs and recovery plans.
* Convert dashboards, reviews, audits, and VOC into corrective and preventive action plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.
* Track actions centrally, escalate overdue or recurring gaps, and validate effectiveness through operating data and customer outcomes.
* Embed reporting, SOP, system, SLA, and governance requirements during partner onboarding and expansion.
* Identify partner capability and training needs; coordinate targeted interventions and measure post-training improvement.
* Build and lead the Partner Success Office; align Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams.
* Present consolidated partner performance, risks, and recommendations to the CSOO and leadership team.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Analytics or related discipline; MBA preferred. Certifications in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Business Analytics, or Power BI are advantageous.
* Experience: 10-14 years in Partner Success, Partner Operations, Performance Management, Service Operations, Customer Experience, or Business Operations; with 4+ years in leadership roles.
* Leadership: Experience managing high-volume, multi-location, SLA-driven partner ecosystems and senior partner stakeholders; leading cross-functional teams and reporting to senior leadership.
* Technical Expertise: Partner governance and relationship management; KPI/SLA design; MIS automation; Advanced Excel; Power BI or Tableau; working knowledge of SQL; performance scorecards; WBR/MBR/QBR management; RCA and CAPA; NPS/CSAT analytics.
* Soft Skills: Strategic, analytical, disciplined in action closure, strong executive communication, negotiation, stakeholder influence, and business/commercial acumen.

Why Consider this Opportunity?
  
  

* Lead the central governance and performance management function for a large, complex partner ecosystem impacting millions of customers.
* Drive measurable improvements in SLA, TAT, quality, productivity, NPS/CSAT, and partner performance scores.
* Shape and embed data-driven partner governance frameworks and automated reporting tools with high stakeholder visibility.
* Collaborate across Sales, Service, Logistics, Contact Centre, Quality, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to influence business outcomes.
* Operate at the intersection of customer experience and operational excellence within a fast-growing technology-enabled service platform.

Based in Mumbai, this role serves as the primary interface between Plaksha’s Office of Corporate Partnerships & Careers (CPC) and the corporate ecosystem, with a focus on establishing long-term, mutually value-adding relationships with leading organizations. The incumbent works closely with the Head – CPC, internal stakeholders including faculty and students, to align industry engagement with Plaksha’s mission of producing future-ready, industry-relevant talent.

**Corporate Outreach & Pipeline Development:**

* Identify, approach, and onboard new corporate partners for internships, placements, and broader engagement with Plaksha’s student community.
* Build and manage a structured funnel of leads by mapping target companies, researching hiring needs, and executing a systematic outreach strategy in coordination with the Head – CPC.

**Relationship Management & Partner Engagement:**

* Develop and deepen relationships with strategic corporate partners with the primary objective of securing firm, repeatable hiring commitments for Plaksha students.

* Leverage events as a platform to deepen existing partnerships and generate new leads for the CPC pipeline.
* Represent Plaksha at external forums, industry associations, and HR conferences to enhance brand visibility in the corporate ecosystem.

**Internship & Placement Execution:**

* Work with the CPC team to plan and execute the annual placement and internship calendar, ensuring adequate corporate   participation across sectors and roles.

* Ensure a high quality of roles offered – aligned to Plaksha’s student profiles.

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of industry hiring trends, competitor university placements, and evolving skill  demands to sharpen Plaksha’s employer positioning.

* Collaborate with faculty to develop co-curricular projects, capstone assignments, and live case studies with corporate partners.
* Leverage professional networks, LinkedIn, and industry databases to generate actionable intelligence on potential partners and role opportunities.

* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields; MBA with specialization in Sales, Marketing, or Business Development is preferred

* Excellent communication skills – oral and written – with the ability to engage senior leaders with confidence and credibility.

* Strategic thinking ability and analytical skills; ability to prioritize and execute in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Commitment to excellence, accuracy, and attention to detail in all external communications and data management.

**What can Plaksha offer you?**

title: Concierge Manager Position - India (Remote)
description:
Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership
  
  
**About Ascend**
Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.
  
  
We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.
  
  
Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.
  
  
As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.
  
  
This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead and Develop Your Team
  
  

* Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,
* Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders
* Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception
* Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations
  
  

* Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities
* Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client
* Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need
* Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences
  
  

* Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up
* Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment
* Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations
* Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence
  
  

* Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team
* Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively
* Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation
* Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend
  
  

* Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale
* Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations
* Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring
  
  
Must Have
  
  

* 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset
* 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines
* Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work
* A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards
* Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership
* Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs
* Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms
* A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs
* Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones
* Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.
  
  
What Makes You Stand Out
  
  
We are especially interested in candidates who:
  
  

* Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove
* Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them
* Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client
* Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium
* Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend
  
  
Clear Growth Path
  
  
The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.
  
  
Build, Don't Just Maintain
  
  
We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.
  
  
Real Support
  
  

* We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers
* Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback
* A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you
* A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance
  
  

* Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance
* Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late
* A global team with talented colleagues across continents
* Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead
  
  

* Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry
* How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making
* Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations
* Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like
  
  
First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.
  
  
Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.
  
  
Our Values
  
  

* Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win
* Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours
* Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust
* Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it
* Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?
  
  
If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:
  
  

* Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?
* Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?
* Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?
* Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Why You'll Love This Role
  
  
This is perfect for someone who:
  
  

* Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders
* Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership
* Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow
* Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices
* Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, And Benefits**
Ascend is a remote-first, global team. For candidates based in India, employment will be through Ascend's designated Employer of Record (EOR), which will be the legal employer and administer payroll, applicable statutory deductions, tax deductions and employment-related compliance.
  
  
Compensation will be stated in USD and paid in INR through the EOR's payroll, based on the applicable conversion arrangement. The salary breakup, statutory contributions, deductions and payment terms will be detailed in the employment offer. Any personal income tax return filing obligations remain the employee's responsibility.
  
  
This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends or public holidays, depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.
  
  
The monthly compensation accounts for the rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements of the role. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime or additional hours are not provided unless required by applicable law or specified in the employment terms.
  
  
Ascend does not currently provide additional employer-sponsored medical insurance or mediclaim for this role beyond any applicable statutory coverage. Details of leave entitlements, schedules and employment policies will be shared during the offer and onboarding process.
  
  
Ascend values work-life balance and aims to distribute schedules thoughtfully. At the same time, because this is a client-facing operational role, some flexibility and responsiveness may be required from time to time.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Strategic Client Engagement: Execute through structured, meaningful interactions—such as Quarterly Joint Business Reviews (JBRs)—to align on performance and identify future opportunities. The role involves crafting tailored engagement strategies for each key account to ensure continuous value delivery and alignment with client objectives. These efforts help strengthen trust, uncover growth potential, and reinforce the company’s position as a long-term strategic partner.

title: Key Account Manager - VIP Accounts
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today**
At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.
  
  
In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.
  
  
While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH with us!
  
  
**About The Role**
This isn’t a typical Sales role.
  
  
You will work on initiatives that genuinely transform how finance works in India, a type of work few roles offer.
  
  
Build and nurture relationships with VIP customers actively trading options on CoinDCX. Engage users through calls and personalised communications, sharing updates on new listings, product launches, market developments and trading features to drive engagement, retention and satisfaction.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive VIP Trader Engagement: Build and own relationships with high-value Options Traders through personalised engagement, delivering timely updates on options products, listings and market opportunities.
* Drive Product Penetration: Identify trader needs and lead cross-sell and adoption of relevant CoinDCX options and derivatives products.
* Own Trading Growth & Retention: Monitor trading activity and volumes, design targeted interventions to reactivate traders and deliver sustained trading engagement.
* Deliver Market & Product Insights: Build trader trust by sharing actionable insights on options strategies, volatility, market trends, margin and product developments.
* Drive Trader VoC: Own the feedback loop with active traders and collaborate with Product, Research and Operations to design and deliver a superior options trading experience.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You**

* Think like a trader: Stay curious about markets, options, volatility and trading behaviour.
* Learn fast, execute faster: Absorb new concepts quickly and turn learning into action.
* Think analytically: Use data to identify patterns, opportunities and trader behaviour.
* Own the outcome: Take end-to-end ownership of tasks and follow through with minimal hand-holding.
* Have a bias for action: Move quickly, experiment, and iterate based on results.
* Communicate with clarity: Present insights and ideas in a simple, structured and actionable way.
* Stay customer-obsessed: Understand the needs of options traders and continuously look for ways to improve their experience.

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When**

* Improved user retention: Contributed to initiatives that improve retention and reactivation of active Options Traders.
* Increased trading volumes: Delivered measurable growth in options trading activity and user volumes within the assigned cohort.
* Improved trader engagement: Built and executed targeted initiatives to increase engagement among high-value Options Traders.
* Delivered actionable insights: Generated data-backed insights on trader behaviour, churn, and product adoption to support growth initiatives.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You**

* Build from the ground up : Be part of the first major experiment focused on VIP Options as a product.
* Own & lead : Get meaningful ownership to shape initiatives, experiment with new ideas and drive outcomes.
* High-impact exposure : Work closely with Options Traders, Product, Research and business teams to understand and build for a fast-evolving market.
* Make your mark : Your work can directly influence how VIP Team builds and scales its Options business.

**Hiring Process**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best

**Where We Work**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
  
  
Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.
