title: Key Account Manager - Dispensing
description:
Life is too short for a boring career, so build an extraordinary one with us. We believe your career should spark the same thrill and curiosity as your personal interests. Creativity drives everything we do, turning ideas into meaningful impact. With opportunities across brands, markets, and divisions, your growth knows no boundaries. Read on to know more about what’s in store for you!
  
  
**Job Title:**
**Regional Dispensing Channel Manager – L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty Division (Mumbai, India)**
Hello, we’re L’Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**A Day in the Life**
Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty and the National Dispensing and Medical Visits Manager, you will be responsible for the following Key Deliverables:
  
  

* Channel Strategy & Business Development:
* Analyze market opportunities, potential, and gaps within the dispensing channel across the South and West regions.
* Analyse prescription potential of targets and the competitive, medical and regulatory environment.
* Drive RCPA (Retail Chemist Prescription Audit) compliance and execution across key pharmacies in the region.
* Define targets, their coverage and visit frequency.
* Develop and execute strategic Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with key dispensing clinics to drive sell-out and achieve regional sales targets.
* Devise action plans, budgets, giveaways (promotional items and samples) and validate medical visit tools, for each target, in conjunction with marketing / and staff in charge of medical communication.
* Portfolio Promotion & Negotiation: Present and negotiate commercial agreements, product bundles, and promotional strategies.
* Pilot performance based on criteria of prescriptions/recommendations and sales and analyse Return On Investment (ROI).
* Key Opinion Leader (KOL) & Commercial Account Management:
* Maintain strong personal connections and strategic relationships with top dermatologists and key dispensing stakeholders in the region.
* Build and nurture strong commercial relationships with key decision-makers, dermatologists, and clinic administrators within dispensing accounts in his/her region.
* Lead regional derm activation, engagement, and Advocacy agendas.
* Team Support & Performance Enablement:
* Support Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Medical Representative teams in executing dispensing strategies.
* Monitor and review MR team performance, field effectiveness, and target achievement within the dispensing channel.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:
* Liaison closely with the Medical Training and Communication teams to ensure seamless execution of medical detailing tools and training modules.
* Collaborate with regional sales and marketing teams to ensure synergy between commercial targets and medical/dispensing initiatives.
* Guarantee the excellence and professionalization of medical detailing:
* Makes sure field team has required digital tools and competences to engage with HCPs through all relevant channels (digital and face-to-face).
* Implement and guarantee the use of monitoring tools of CRM/CLM platform activity.
* Ethical Standards:
* Ensure training and respect of both internal and external ethical standards regarding relations with health professionals.
* Market Intelligence:
* Monitor account performance, track key commercial metrics, and maintain sharp awareness of competitor activities within the dermatology space.

**We Are Looking For**
To succeed in this role, you should possess the following attributes:
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Strong understanding of the dermatological and dispensing retail ecosystem.
* Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills with top HCPs/Dermatologists.
* High commercial acumen with experience in sales, key account management, or medical detailing leadership. Strong negotiation and business planning skills with a proven track record of driving revenue growth in clinic/dispensing environments.
* Ability to coach, influence, and drive performance across cross-functional field teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: MBA, Bachelor’s degree, B. Pharma/Life sciences
* Work Experience: Minimum 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, dermocosmetic, or medical sales, with exposure to key account management or field team leadership.

**What’s In It For You**

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference

**Who We Are**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
  
  
Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor & Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
  
  
L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
  
  
In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
  
  
L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. L’Oréal closely prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of the individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: District Manager, Pune
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  
Principal Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical & product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;

title: Sr. Specialist, Advisory Services
description:
**Position Summary**

Women’s World Banking is looking for a team member to join a forward thinking, cross-functional, high-performing, collaborative team focused on delivering innovative customer experiences, banking services and products, that create business and customer value to serve low-income women.

The Sr. Specialist will lead the design & implementation of advisory solutions in the field in collaboration with our Financial Service Partners. The candidate will be expected to understand business and customer needs, design solutions across functional teams, coordinate and lead sales/ channel teams, last mile marketing & sales agencies and bank stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation and drive project results. This role is responsible for managing project and providing excellent service delivery for our clients and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have either a background in banking / insurance / financial services or in management consulting. You must be a strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and propose new ideas for ways of engaging Women’s World Banking’s target audience.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Design of Financial Solutions**
in the space of savings, micro-credit, micro-insurance, digital financial services, or last mile solutions for low income women that are viable and scalable for Financial Service Providers:

* Develop research based perspective on financial products for low income women - the current context, challenges for women, trends and solutions for increasing financial inclusion of women in this sector.
* Conduct industry assessments that provide detailed insights into the competitive landscape and best practices; Collect and analyze complex data in the sector that can help define solutions.
* Establish relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and customer needs, continually enhance project processes, service offering and delivery for partners.
* Identify, scope and find implementation paths for needed product and/or customer experience enhancements;
* Develop business cases for new product and product enhancements to enable prioritization and justify investments into new and existing products.

**Delivery of Solutions in Field**
across various initiatives, locations and stakeholders to ensure project milestones and metrics are met. Drive execution of solutions for low income women with institution partners.

* Able to implement project in field across multiple geographies and last mile channels.
* Establish relationships and work with a cross-functional teams (internal and partner bank's) to ensure timely delivery of milestones.
* Coordinate among various external support organisations such as last mile agencies (training, sales promotions etc.) and local government bodies (state / region level) to drive project success.
* Lead project management including the development, delivery and monitoring of work plans, milestones, targets, budgets, and both internal and external reporting. Projects may vary in number, size and complexity.

**Mange & Deepen Relationships with Institutional Partners:**

* Develop, and drive execution of high priority business initiatives, financial products and services for the partner FSPs
* Establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with key client contacts
* Initiate and hand hold the project through all stages of the project
* Ensure positive client satisfaction results.
* Be the “voice of the clients” by interpreting the clients’ business plans and strategic intent into the Women’s World banking organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* MBA or Master’s degree in related field
* 8+ years or more experience in banking, financial services, consulting or other relevant role.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and successfully manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Proven collaborative, negotiation, and persuasion skills to influence field teams and senior management at partner institutions.
* Must be willing to travel extensively within India, and be on-site for 6-8 days a month.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Interest in the field of women’s financial inclusion and economic empowerment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present fact-based recommendations in a clear, logical and concise way to tell a story with the data.
* Track record of superior creativity and problem solving abilities.

**Measure of Success**

**Success within the first 75 days:**

* Embrace Women’s World Banking’s values – Think Big, Own and commit to it, Smarter together
* Assume full responsibility of the position;
* Forge positive working relationships with cross-functional staff and fully integrate in the India team
* Become trained in and fully integrate the use of Women’s World Banking systems and policies into your day-to-day activities;
* Learn and comprehend the Women’s World Banking business model and work closely with the team to understand and build upon existing plans.

title: Team Lead – Implementation
description:
**About Clari5**
Clari5, a product of CustomerXPs (now part of the Perfios group), is a category-leading real-time Enterprise Financial Crime Management platform trusted by banks across 15+ countries. The platform processes 12 billion+ transactions and secures over 200 million accounts, helping financial institutions combat fraud, manage AML compliance, and drive revenue — all in real time. Clari5 is consistently recognised in Chartis RiskTech Quadrants and has won multiple global awards for fraud detection innovation.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Team Lead – Implementation is a high-impact delivery role within Clari5’s Global Professional Services team. You will lead end-to-end implementation engagements of the Clari5 platform at banking and financial institution clients, owning project delivery from kick-off to go-live. You will manage a small squad of functional and technical consultants, serve as the primary client interface during implementation, and ensure every deployment meets Clari5’s quality, timeline, and customer-satisfaction benchmarks.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of banking domain expertise, product knowledge, and project leadership — ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and wants to shape how one of the world’s most advanced fraud management platforms goes live at marquee banks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implementation Delivery

+ Own end-to-end delivery of Clari5 implementations from project initiation to go-live and hypercare, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, and quality benchmarks.
+ Create and maintain detailed project plans, milestone trackers, risk logs, and status dashboards for each engagement.
+ Drive sub-90-day go-live timelines by leveraging Clari5’s pre-built integration adapters and accelerators.
+ Manage parallel implementation streams (EFM, AML, Case Management) across banking channels and core banking integrations.
+ Coordinate UAT cycles, defect triage, and sign-off activities with client teams.
+ Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

+ Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders (CTO, CIO, Risk Heads, IT teams) throughout the implementation lifecycle.
+ Conduct requirement-gathering workshops, present solution design documents, and validate functional configurations against client needs.
+ Manage client expectations proactively; communicate changes in scope, risk, and mitigation plans transparently.
+ Build lasting relationships that support successful post-go-live adoption and open doors for further engagement.
+ Team Leadership

+ Lead, mentor, and guide a team of 3–5 functional/technical consultants across implementation engagements.
+ Assign work, track deliverables, and conduct performance reviews for team members.
+ Foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and delivery excellence.
+ Onboard and ramp new team members on Clari5 product, banking domain, and delivery methodology.
+ Technical & Functional Oversight

+ Review and sign off on Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Interface Requirement Documents (IRDs), and test plans.
+ Oversee and validate configurations of fraud rules, AML scenarios, case workflows, and reporting dashboards.
+ Liaise with the Clari5 product engineering and DevOps teams on environment setups, deployments, patches, and escalations.
+ Ensure integrations with core banking systems (Finacle, Flexcube, Temenos, etc.), payment switches, and ancillary systems are correctly designed and executed.
+ Process & Quality

+ Enforce Clari5’s implementation methodology, quality gates, and project governance standards across all engagements.
+ Contribute to the development and improvement of delivery playbooks, templates, and best-practice documentation.
+ Conduct post-go-live reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery quality.
+ Identify and escalate risks and issues in a timely manner with clear mitigation plans.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Must Have


+ 7–10 years of experience in banking technology delivery, with at least 3 years in a team lead or project lead capacity.
+ Hands-on experience implementing banking software products (fraud management, core banking, AML, payments, or similar enterprise banking solutions).
+ Strong working knowledge of banking channels and operations: Core Banking, Payments (RTGS/NEFT/UPI/SWIFT), Cards, Mobile/Internet Banking.
+ Experience preparing and reviewing BRDs, SDDs, IRDs, test plans, and go-live checklists.
+ Proficiency in project management methodologies (Agile/Scrum or Waterfall) and tools (Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent).
+ Unix Shell script/ Python/ Database(RDBMS, Oracle/MYSQL/MSSQL)/ Java Debugging etc
+ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
+ Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and engagements.
+ Willingness to travel to client sites domestically and internationally.

* Good to Have


+ Prior experience implementing Fraud / AML platforms.
+ Exposure to integration middleware and API-based integrations (REST/SOAP) in a banking context.
+ Understanding of regulatory frameworks: RBI guidelines, FATF AML, PMLA, IRDAI, or regional equivalents.
+ PMP, Prince2, or equivalent project management certification.
+ Experience with BI/reporting tools and SQL for data validation during implementations.
+ Knowledge of real-time decisioning architectures, rule engines, and in-memory computing concepts.

Core Competencies
  
  
**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project & program management
* Team supervision & mentoring
* Risk & issue management
* Stakeholder communication

**Domain & Technical**

* Banking products & channels
* Fraud / AML platform configuration
* Core banking integrations
* SQL, APIs, test management tools

What We Offer
  
  

* Work on world-class fraud management technology deployed at Tier 1 banks across Asia, Middle East, and Africa.
* Exposure to complex, large-scale enterprise implementations — including the world’s largest real-time fraud management deployment.
* A dynamic, high-ownership environment where your impact is visible and your contributions are recognised.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities for global travel and cross-geography client engagement.
* A collaborative team of banking technology veterans committed to delivery excellence.
* Access to Clari5’s continuous learning resources, product certifications, and industry events.

title: Head of E-Commerce & Quick Commerce
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai (in-office)

**Function:**
E-Commerce & Quick Commerce

**Reports to:**
Founders

Earthful is a plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. Marketplaces and quick commerce are two of our largest growth channels — this role owns both end to end: the revenue, the profitability, the operational health, and the team that runs them day to day.

**Role Overview**

This role owns Earthful's marketplace (Amazon, Flipkart, and similar) and quick-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and similar) channels end to end — revenue growth, channel profitability (CM2), and operational health metrics like fill rate and on-shelf availability. You'll build and lead a team of Key Account Managers, with all KAMs reporting into this role, and you'll be the one who decides where to invest, where to pull back, and how the team is structured to hit both channels' targets without sacrificing margin. You'll report directly to the founders on revenue, profitability, and ops performance.

**What You'll Own**

**Marketplace & Quick Commerce Revenue Growth**

• Own and grow marketplace & quick commerce revenue according to AOP across platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto)

• Set and track platform-wise revenue targets, adjusting strategy as performance data comes in

**Channel Profitability**

• Keep every channel CM2-positive, tracking contribution margin by platform on a monthly basis

• Own retail media and ad spend on marketplace and quick-commerce platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads, Blinkit/Zepto sponsored placements), with ROAS targets that protect CM2 while hitting revenue goals

• Monitor competitive pricing and promotional activity on each platform, adjusting pricing and promotion strategy to protect margin and market share

**Operational Health Metrics**

• Track and sustain RIS%, PO fill rates, and on-shelf availability — with particular focus on quick commerce OSA given its real-time nature

• Coordinate with Supply Chain and Warehouse on demand forecasting and inventory allocation, so fill rate and OSA targets are actually achievable rather than just tracked after the fact

**Team Building & Leadership**

• Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of Key Account Managers (KAMs), with all KAMs reporting into this role

• Allocate platforms and accounts across the team, and set individual targets that ladder up to overall channel goals

• Build the team's capability so KAMs can independently manage platform relationships and day-to-day account operations

**Platform & Cross-Functional Relationship Management**

• Own strategic relationships with marketplace and quick-commerce platform category/account teams — unlocking better placements, programs, and support

• Coordinate new SKU listings and launches across all marketplace and quick-commerce platforms

• Coordinate with the Regulatory & Compliance team on marketplace listing compliance (claims, mandatory declarations) before SKUs go live

**Reporting**

• Report revenue, CM2, and operational metrics to leadership on a regular cadence, with a clear read on what's driving hits or misses

**What We're Looking For**

• 3+ years of experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or quick-commerce roles, including directly managing a team

• Proven experience owning contribution margin (CM1/CM2) or channel profitability for an e-commerce or marketplace channel, not just topline revenue

• Direct, hands-on experience managing retail media and ad spend on marketplace platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads) and/or quick-commerce sponsored placements

• A track record of scaling marketplace or quick-commerce revenue at a D2C or e-commerce brand

• Experience building or managing a team of Key Account Managers or similar account-owning roles

• Comfortable with operational metrics (fill rate, on-shelf availability, return rate) and coordinating with Supply Chain/Warehouse to hit them

• Strong analytical and Excel/dashboard skills

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement

title: Associate Director - FIG
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Associate Director in Financial Institutions Group, India, you will play an active role in driving a customer-centric, solutions-led and fast-growing FIG franchise. The role carries responsibility for client coverage, origination, portfolio management and execution activities, while contributing to revenue growth, risk discipline and high-quality client outcomes.
  
  
This is an independent Relationship Manager role with meaningful commercial accountability and exposure to client coverage in an Institutional setting. The role would suit a technically strong banker with sound commercial judgement, clear communication skills and the ability to contribute to origination, execution discipline, revenue delivery and portfolio growth. Understanding of relationship management, credit risk, key products and compliance is highly desirable
  
  
Financial Institutions Group (FIG) is a global business which entails tapping and optimising opportunities emanating from and into our global and regional clients and initiatives. It comprises Banks, Diversified Financials (DF), Insurance and Funds segments.
  
  
FIG India is part of the FIG South East Asia, India and Middle East (SEAIME) region and covers all the four FIG segments. The business offers its clients a wide range of products including clearing, FX, derivatives, precious metal sales, syndicated and bilateral loans, trade and debt capital markets.
  
  
FIG India is a growing business with a track record of prudent risk management, quality client coverage and superior returns.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
Role Location: Altimus, Mumbai
  
  
Role Type: Permanent
  
  
**What will your day look like?**

* Client Coverage: Take primary coverage responsibility for a portfolio of clients, while shadowing senior banker/s on strategic relationships. Develop a strong understanding of client priorities, decision-makers, wallet opportunities, and near-term revenue potential.
* Origination & Revenue Delivery: Support the origination of new business opportunities across the FIG portfolio, including identifying transaction ideas, maintaining an active pipeline, tracking deal conversion and contributing to revenue targets for the business.
* Portfolio Growth & Business Planning: Account planning, client prioritization and portfolio growth initiatives, including revenue budgeting, pipeline reviews, wallet analysis and preparation of business performance updates.
* Strategy and Planning: Contribute to FIG India’s strategic priorities through sector research, target client analysis, data-led insights and preparation of senior management presentations.
* Special Projects and Campaigns: Lead or support priority campaigns and special projects such as targeted segment campaigns, including financial sponsor banking initiatives.
* Information Management: Maintain accurate and actionable business information across revenue, pipeline, client activity and portfolio metrics to support timely decision-making.
* Transactional Support: Support transaction execution, documentation and client servicing in partnership with product, legal, risk, operations and support teams.
* Know Your Customer (KYC) & Customer Readiness: Ensure timely and thorough completion of inbound and outbound KYC for the portfolio, streamline the KYC process and ensure customers are deal-ready for key products and geographies.
* Risk & Compliance Assurance: Support disciplined business growth by ensuring activities are managed within applicable risk, compliance and governance standards.
* Product Exposure: Develop and apply knowledge of products relevant to FIG clients, including transaction banking for financial institutions (clearing, guarantees, local cash, trade), relationship lending, global markets investor sales, syndicated loans, debt capital markets and commodities

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* A commercially minded team player who strives for excellence and demonstrates ownership of client and business outcomes working in a fast paced International bank.
* Ability to form effective working relationships with clients, senior bankers, product partners and internal stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving ability, growth mindset and capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear client materials and senior management updates.
* High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly around pipeline, revenue, portfolio, KYC and transaction information.
* Graduate qualification in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 8-10 years of experience as a FIG Relationship Manager in banking.
* Experience with coverage of Indian Financial Sponsors and NBFCs will be considered positively.
* Understanding of origination processes, risk management and compliance requirements.
* Thorough understanding of banking regulation and local market nuances including Gift City.
* Understanding of the credit and documentation principles.
* Proficiency in computers, especially Co-Pilot, Microsoft Excel, word and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical capability to review client, portfolio, pipeline and revenue information and translate it into actionable insights

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 124978.

**Why join**

**A small team that commits its own capital to the companies it brings; the companies on the next year's IPO calendar, seen early; a desk built on a modern platform rather than spreadsheets and WhatsApp forwards.**

**About Us**
Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
  
  
**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
  
  
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
  
  
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
  
  
****Culture and Total Rewards****
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
  
  
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
  
  
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
  
  
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
  
  
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the
**Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**
, we uphold the following principles:
  
  

* Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* Accessible Workplace: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* Career Growth: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* Support & Confidentiality: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* Awareness & Inclusion: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.
  
  
Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

title: Customer Success Software Configuration Engineering -Billing
description:
TITLE
  
  
Software Configuration Engineering Senior Analyst
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Software Configuration Engineering Senior Analyst plays a critical role and is responsible for upgrading client applications to the latest base versions. This involves a thorough understanding of the current application landscape and the new version's features and improvements. Post-upgrade, the engineer will identify, debug, and resolve any issues that arise. This ensures that the upgraded applications function seamlessly and meet client expectations. The engineer will analyze client code to identify deviations and determine what can be upgraded directly and what requires client confirmation.
  
  
The Software Configuration Engineering Senior Analyst will work closely with various departments, including development, quality assurance, and client support teams, to ensure a smooth upgrade process and effective issue resolution
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Meticulously analyze and assess the impact of upgrades based on release notes and code changes for new release features. This involves understanding the nuances of each release and predicting how these changes will affect the existing applications.
* Debugs custom code and base code to provide workarounds or solutions to third-party implementation teams or customers. This requires a deep understanding of the application and the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.
* Leverage Duck Creek upgrade tools to generate differential analysis and produce low-impact upgrade paths for Duck Creek customers.
* Leverage AI-driven tools and processes to identify automation opportunities and reduce manual effort across product upgrade and certification activities.
* Apply strong product implementation knowledge and technical expertise to effectively support product upgrade and certification processes
* Expected to act independently, demonstrating initiative and self-reliance in managing their tasks and responsibilities.
* Identify opportunities to automate processes or develop utilities that assist in faster and more effective upgrades.
* Interacts with customer counterparts to triage issues and present solutions.
* Reviews, Mentors and Shares knowledge with the team members.
* Informs the Technical Lead and Project Manager of any issues and risk that may affect overall upgrade schedules.

* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:

+ Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
+ Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
+ Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree, or higher educational level, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science strongly preferred
* Minimum 3 years’ related industry experience in system development and implementation
* Demonstrated proficiency in Analysis, Development, and Triage.
* Demonstrated proficiency and implementation experience in Duck Creek Billing Product
* Strong understanding of Duck Creek Billing concepts such as billing forms, billing plans, payment plans, Direct Bill, Agency Bill, EFT/payment processing, and billing transactions
* Hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, SQL Server, XML/XSLT, REST/SOAP APIs, and Duck Creek extensibility/configuration
* Experience with SQL query development, stored procedures, database troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Demonstrated proficiency in Insurance domain knowledge

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Knowledge of insurance products a plus
* Experience/knowledge of P&C Insurance software applications a plus
* Experience/knowledge of software development life cycle for P&C insurance software a plus
* Experience developing and troubleshooting integrations between Duck Creek Billing and external systems, such as Policy, payment gateways, general ledger, or document-generation systems
* Good to have knowledge in TFS, GitHub and GIT workflow.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
* Experience in Duck Creek Billing upgrades/certifications and assessing customizations, integrations, and compatibility

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.

title: Creative Strategist & Client Success Manager
description:
About Bforbranding

Bforbranding is the parent organization behind ShortVids, ShortM, and ShortX. We work with international clients across content, performance marketing, and automation. Our focus is on structured execution, strong fundamentals, and long-term scalable growth

ShortVids is a Creative-as-a-Service company helping agencies and growing brands produce high-performing organic content and paid advertising creatives at scale.

Our team delivers short-form videos, long-form content, UGC-style ads, Meta and YouTube ads, VSLs, motion graphics, static ads, carousels and repurposed content.

We are looking for a Creative Strategist & Client Success Manager who can take complete ownership of client strategy, communication, creative quality and delivery operations.

About the role
  

This is not a position where you simply forward messages between clients and editors.

You will understand each client’s business, plan their organic and paid content strategy, convert ideas into actionable creative briefs, manage production, review every important deliverable and ensure clients receive accurate, polished work on time.

Your primary outcome will be:

Every client receives strategically strong, brand-aligned creatives without needing to supervise our production process.

Key responsibilities
  

Creative strategy :

* Understand each client’s business, offer, audience, brand and objectives
* Develop monthly organic content strategies and content pillars
* Plan topics, formats, hooks and content calendars
* Create concepts and angles for Meta and YouTube advertising
* Plan UGC, founder-led, static, carousel, VSL and performance-ad concepts
* Research competitors, trends and winning creative patterns
* Review content and advertising performance to improve future concepts
* Identify creative fatigue and maintain a consistent pipeline of fresh ideas

Client success :

* Manage onboarding, strategy and review calls
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
* Communicate timelines, progress, blockers and next steps proactively
* Present strategic recommendations clearly and confidently
* Organise client feedback and convert it into actionable revision notes
* Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients before issues escalate
* Build strong relationships that position ShortVids as a creative partner

Production and operations :

* Convert strategies and client requirements into detailed production briefs
* Provide editors with scripts, references, timestamps, brand assets and clear instructions
* Coordinate editors, designers and other production team members
* Track projects from briefing through editing, revisions and final delivery
* Maintain accurate project boards and client documentation
* Ensure every deadline is communicated and met
* Improve briefing, feedback and delivery processes

Creative quality control :

* Review videos and creatives before they are delivered
* Ensure every client instruction has been followed
* Check hooks, pacing, storytelling, captions, footage, audio and CTAs
* Verify spelling, names, claims, numbers, logos, fonts and brand consistency
* Check aspect ratios, resolution and export quality
* Identify weak creative execution and provide precise improvement notes
* Prevent previously corrected mistakes from recurring

Who we’re looking for
  

* 3+ years of experience in a creative, video production, social media or performance marketing agency
* Experience communicating directly with international clients
* Strong understanding of both organic content and paid advertising creatives
* Ability to develop content plans, creative concepts and editor-ready briefs
* Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, retention, pacing and CTAs
* Working knowledge of video editing and the ability to recognise quality issues
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously
* Confidence when providing feedback to editors and recommendations to clients
* Familiarity with tools such as Slack, Frame.io, Trello, ClickUp, Notion and Google Drive

Performance marketing knowledge
  

You should understand :

* Creative testing and creative fatigue
* Hooks, angles, offers and awareness levels
* UGC and founder-led advertising
* CTR, hook rate, hold rate and conversion rate
* CPA, CAC and ROAS
* Creative variations and testing grids
* Direct-response storytelling
* Funnel stages and campaign objectives

You do not need to be an advanced media buyer, but you must understand how creative decisions influence advertising performance.

You’ll be a strong fit if you :
  

* Notice details that other people miss
* Think strategically while remaining highly organised
* Take ownership instead of waiting for reminders
* Can manage creative teams without creating unnecessary friction
* Communicate problems early and offer solutions
* Can handle demanding clients calmly and professionally
* Understand the difference between personal preference and a genuine creative problem
* Have extremely high standards for anything delivered to a client

Success in this role looks like

* Clients always know what is happening with their projects
* Organic and paid creative plans are delivered consistently
* Editors receive complete briefs requiring minimal clarification
* Creatives are delivered on time and without preventable errors
* Revision rounds decrease because instructions are clearer
* Client feedback is documented and applied to future work
* Clients receive proactive ideas—not just completed editing tasks
* Routine client and production management does not require founder involvement

Please begin your application with the words “Creative Ownership” so we know you have read the complete job description.

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
Way of Working - Office/Field - Employees will work full-time from their base location
  
  
About Swiggy:
  
  
Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
  
  
Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
  
  
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
With Swiggy's New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market, while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
The Partner Success Manager / Senior Account Manager will own the post-sales relationship with restaurant partners,
  
  
ensuring successful adoption, active usage and measurable ROI. The role is central to driving partner satisfaction,
  
  
retention and revenue growth while acting as a trusted growth advisor to restaurant partners.
  
  

* Partner Onboarding & Adoption
* Own end-to-end post-sales onboarding of the product suite for assigned restaurant partners, including Digital Menu,

CRM tools, reservations and QR-based ordering.
  
  

* Coordinate product setup, POS integration, QR deployment and account configuration, including menus, floor

plans, shifts and outlet details.
  
  

* Conduct structured product walkthroughs, demos and staff training to ensure smooth go-live within defined

timelines.
  
  

* Partner Success & Relationship Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for restaurant partners in the city.
* Build strong, long-term relationships with owners, decision-makers and outlet managers.
* Regularly engage partners through check-ins, reviews and on-ground visits.
* Driving ROI & Business Growth
* Help restaurant partners translate product feature usage into measurable business outcomes.
* Drive higher AOV/table value through upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Improve repeat visits using CRM and targeted campaigns.
* Enable better table utilization and demand shaping.
* Reduce operational friction through QR-led ordering and billing.
* Track and communicate ROI metrics such as adoption depth, repeat-rate uplift, campaign performance and

menu-led revenue impact.
  
  

* Performance Monitoring & Reviews
* Conduct monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) with partners.
* Analyze partner performance data and recommend actionable improvements.
* Identify early warning signs of churn and proactively resolve issues.
* Expansion & Feature Adoption Support
* Identify opportunities to increase depth of usage across available product features.
* Train restaurant staff on new workflows and maintain adoption through repeat training and SOPs, especially during staff changes.
* Support expansion across multiple outlets by demonstrating value and sharing best practices.
* Work closely with Sales and City teams to enable renewals and portfolio expansion through strong post-sales outcomes.
* Product Support & Issue Resolution
* Act as the first-level support point for product-related queries and issues.
* Coordinate with Product, Tech, Ops and Support teams to resolve bugs, integrations and workflow challenges.
* Ensure minimal downtime and a smooth partner experience.
* Partner Feedback & Continuous Improvement
* Act as the voice of restaurant partners by sharing structured feedback on product usability, gaps and enhancement needs.
* Contribute inputs to improve product features, onboarding journeys and partner-facing processes.

Key Success Metrics (KPIs)
  
  

* Product feature adoption and activation rate
* Partner retention and churn reduction
* Usage frequency across product features
* Partner ROI and satisfaction metrics, including NPS
* Revenue expansion from existing partners

**Qualifications**
Experience & Qualifications
  
  

* 4–7 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partner Success or B2B relationship

management.
  
  

* Prior experience in F&B;, hospitality, SaaS, CRM, POS or restaurant technology is highly preferred.
* Experience managing city-level or portfolio-based accounts is a strong plus.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Good understanding of business metrics, ROI and growth levers.
* Comfortable working with data, dashboards and performance reports.
* Ability to train and influence non-technical restaurant owners and staff.
* High ownership mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication skills; local language proficiency and English preferred.

**Additional Information**
**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
**About Kapture CX**
Founded in Bengaluru in 2014,
**Kapture CX**
began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an
**AI-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises**
.
  
  
Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its
**AgentOS platform**
enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows — including
**customer support, sales, collections, and claims**
.
  
  
Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end-to-end across
**voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels**
, with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision-making is required.
  
  
**What is this role all about?**
As a
**Customer Experience Manager,**
you become the trusted technical advisor for our clients. You ensure customers successfully onboard, integrate, and scale on Kapture’s platform while proactively solving complex technical challenges and driving long-term value.
  
  
**Sounds interesting?**
Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
  
  

* You will lead client onboarding and integrations, working hands-on with APIs, JSON payloads, and tools like Postman and cURL to ensure seamless adoption.
* You will own technical support and escalations, diagnosing issues using logs, Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, and collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to drive fast resolutions.
* You will build strong, trusted client relationships by acting as a technical advisor and advocate, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* You will proactively identify optimization opportunities, conduct platform health checks, and recommend technical strategies to help clients maximize ROI.
* You will document issues, resolutions, and RCAs while sharing feedback and insights to influence product improvements and best practices.

This is a
**Mumbai-based role**
. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
  
  
**What does success look like in this role?**
You consistently deliver smooth client experiences, resolve issues before they escalate, and help customers fully leverage Kapture’s platform to achieve measurable business impact.
  
  
**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**

* You have strong hands-on experience with API integrations and system troubleshooting.
* You are comfortable working directly with enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities.
* You can collaborate effectively with engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems in fast-paced environments.

**What are the most critical skills for this role?**

* You can debug issues by inspecting logs, tracing errors, and identifying root causes quickly.
* You are proficient with modern tech stacks and monitoring tools like Kafka, Grafana, and Sentry (or similar).
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You take ownership and think proactively about client success and platform optimization.

**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* You have prior experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
* You are comfortable working with SQL/NoSQL databases and understanding data flows.
* You have exposure to chatbot technologies or AI-driven automation platforms.
* You enjoy creating clear documentation, troubleshooting guides, and RCAs.

**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**

* An opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, clients, and business impact.
* Hands-on exposure to large-scale CX automation and AI-powered platforms.
* Collaboration with highly skilled product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Strong growth opportunities in a fast-scaling global SaaS organization, along with competitive compensation and performance-linked rewards.

title: Senior Client Service Manager
description:
**We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.**
At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.
  
  
Job Title: Client Service Manager / Sr. Client Service Manager (Skale 50)
  
  
**PURPOSE:**
TO BE A KEY POINT OF CONTACT FOR CLIENTS ON A SPECIFIC AREA OF THEIR BUSINESS. TO HANDLE ALL DATA REQUESTS AND PROJECT BRIEFS ENSURING TIMELY, ACCURATE DELIVERY OF INFORMATION AND OFFERING GOOD LEVELS OF INSIGHT, WHILST ALSO CONTRIBUTING TO THE GROWTH OF THE CLIENT’S BUSINESS WITHIN KANTAR WORLDPANEL BY IDENTIFYING POTENTIAL REVENUE OPPORTUNITIES.
  
  
**Client Relationship**
ü Be a key point of contact for a specific area of the client’s business, attending on-site days and owning all related client data requests and project briefs
  
  
ü Deliver a highly responsive service to clients, continuing to build good relationships and trust with your contacts
  
  
ü Understand where Worldpanel complements and competes with other information your client buys
  
  
ü Further develop the client relationship by seeking out opportunities to introduce other Worldpanel capabilities and services to your contacts
  
  
**Account Handling**
ü Be responsible for managing your own day-to-day workload on the area of the business you have responsibility for and establishing priorities with the client as needed
  
  
ü Anticipate client demands and proactively find solutions, rather than just answering requests
  
  
ü Support Manager in client meetings/whilst on-site by preparing meeting material and handling follow-up requests
  
  
ü Personally de-brief key contacts on any requests/project briefs that you have completed
  
  
ü Demonstrate commercial awareness by understanding revenue targets, identifying and acting upon potential revenue opportunities
  
  
ü Manage client expectations if demands are unreasonable or you can see a better approach
  
  
ü Demonstrate an inquisitive nature and desire to go the extra mile for your client contacts
  
  
ü Anticipate client needs and be cognizant of the Worldpanel plans for developing the account
  
  
ü When faced with a problem adopt a positive, solution-driven attitude
  
  
ü Train client users on software and data interpretation
  
  
**Service Development**
ü Highlight and escalate client concerns with any Worldpanel deliverables and help identify potential issues as they arise
  
  
ü Offer your opinion and recommendations to your team manager regarding the relevance and effectiveness of regular deliverables and general client servicing in order to ensure the service’s high standard is maintained.
  
  
ü Share best practices and efficient ways of working with other team members
  
  
**Basic Data & Tracking**
ü Assume responsibility for checking and reviewing any regular reports that are sent out to your client contacts to ensure their accuracy and relevance
  
  
ü Production and interpretation of BIG 5 analyses (Cross Tabs, Gain & Loss, Entry - Erosion, LMH, Multiple Usership) with a focus on finding patterns in the data, highlighting key points and making recommendations
  
  
ü Confidently use the more advanced capabilities within PulsePlus such as Customized Grouping etc
  
  
ü Build a network of contacts within Worldpanel Operations who can help you resolve difficulties with the data or systems if they arise
  
  
**Analysis & Insight**
ü Attend on-site days and de-brief key contacts on any requests/smaller project briefs that you have completed
  
  
ü Discuss briefs with clients, challenging appropriately to make sure requests have been properly thought through and offering advice on how best to tackle issues
  
  
ü Be conversant in the methodology and deliverables of all the panels and services run by the division - eg building a good working knowledge of Expert Services capabilities in order to introduce them as relevant to help solve client issues
  
  
ü Recognise patterns, draw logical conclusions, consider implications and make recommendations based on your analysis and knowledge of the client’s business
  
  
ü Always add value to basic ad-hoc client data requests by adding commentary and drawing out key findings
  
  
ü Draw on your understanding of your client’s business, brand plans and category goals in order to ensure your recommendations are relevant
  
  
ü Be responsible for managing client briefs from start to finish ie - designing correct methodology, running the required analysis, adding interpretation and insight based on category knowledge, delivering back to the client
  
  
**Team, People & Self Development**
ü Actively participate in your Academy training programmes to develop the required skills
  
  
ü Seek opportunities to practice and apply what you have learned in training
  
  
ü Take part in your own performance management using the KWP appraisal system
  
  
ü Ensure you maintain an up-to-date PDP with your line manager - monitor your progress and find solutions for your development needs
  
  
ü Engage with your line manager - seeking their feedback, input and contribution to your development - act upon it appropriately asking for advice when relevant
  
  
ü Build relationships internally, specifically with immediate team with the view to willingly offer help and support to others in the team where possible
  
  
ü Understand your personal impact, and build your reputation as a member of the team who has the confidence to work independently when required, but who is also an active, flexible, confident and trusted team member
  
  
ü Show that you are a positive, inquisitive individual who is prepared to go the extra mile and get involved
  
  
ü Seek out opportunities to grow your client and category knowledge by reading trade press, making store visits, meeting the panel respondents having an opinion on your clients’ products and advertising (and their competitor products/advertising) for example
  
  
**What You'll Bring to Numerator**
**PERSON SPECIFICATION**
**A person in this role is likely to have the ability to:**
ü Gather facts and figures, monitor self and others, and achieve goals in a timely and factual manner
  
  
ü Seek ways of perfecting things, raising standards, reducing errors and overcoming omissions
  
  
ü Bring a sense of urgency to situations, demonstrating an active approach, and a willingness to get involved in order to increase the pace, achieve goals and meet objectives
  
  
ü Take decisions as appropriate, and ensure others do likewise
  
  
ü Provide satisfactory solutions in situations involving the new and unexpected
  
  
ü Have a flexible approach in changing situations and be adaptable in difficult circumstances, continuously striving to achieve a result
  
  
ü Work independently when required, while remaining responsive to feedback and direction received from their line manager
  
  
ü Be curious, demonstrate a real desire to learn, seek out training opportunities and actively participate in meetings (both internal and external as appropriate)
  
  
ü Show dedication to both the client and the client service team, demonstrating a professional work ethic and willingness to go the extra mile when required
  
  
**A person aspiring towards promotion to Account Manager should be demonstrating:**
ü A good understanding of client’s overall goals and objectives, as well as the role that different departments and individuals are playing in achieving these
  
  
ü An increasing network of contacts within the client organisation, not limited to the insight department
  
  
ü An increasing network of internal contacts in “expert” roles within the Kantar Worldpanel India
  
  
ü An awareness of contractual obligations and ability to spot potential conflicts or issues arising
