title: Customer Service Manager
description:
**Job Title:**
Customer Service Manager

**Department:**
Customer Service / Operations

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Must-Haves**

·        6–8 years of experience in customer service / client servicing, with significant experience in 3PL, logistics, warehousing or supply chain operations.

·        Strong experience handling large B2B / key customer accounts and senior customer stakeholders.

·        Hands-on understanding of warehouse, transportation, order processing, inventory and distribution operations.

·        Proven experience managing customer escalations, SLAs, service reviews and operational issues.

·        Experience leading and managing a customer service team.

·        Strong understanding of logistics documentation, billing coordination and ERP/WMS/TMS systems.

·        Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

·        Strong analytical ability with experience in MIS, KPI tracking and service performance reporting.

·        Ability to work closely with Operations, Warehouse, Transport, Finance and Commercial teams.

·        Strong ownership of customer satisfaction, service quality and issue resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.     Customer Relationship Management

·        Own relationships with key customers and act as the primary escalation point for service-related matters.

·        Understand customer requirements, SLAs, operational expectations and commercial commitments.

·        Conduct regular customer reviews and track service performance against agreed KPIs.

·        Build strong, long-term relationships with customers and identify opportunities to improve service delivery.

·        Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution in coordination with internal teams.

2.     Order & Logistics Coordination

·        Oversee end-to-end coordination between customers, warehouse, transport and operations teams.

·        Ensure timely order processing, dispatches, deliveries and shipment updates.

·        Monitor operational issues, delays and exceptions and ensure proactive communication with customers.

·        Ensure customer instructions and service requirements are accurately communicated to the relevant teams.

·        Maintain visibility on order, inventory, dispatch and delivery status.

3.     Customer Service Operations

·        Lead the customer service team and establish clear processes for handling customer queries, requests and escalations.

·        Monitor response and resolution timelines and ensure adherence to defined SLAs.

·        Review recurring customer issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.

·        Standardise customer communication, documentation and reporting processes.

·        Ensure accurate maintenance of customer records and service documentation.

4.     MIS & Performance Management

·        Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly customer service and operational reports.

·        Track KPIs including SLA adherence, order processing, on-time delivery, response time, resolution time, complaints and customer satisfaction.

·        Analyse service performance and identify gaps requiring operational intervention.

·        Present customer performance and key issues to management through regular reviews.

5.     Billing & Commercial Coordination

·        Coordinate with Finance and Operations to ensure accurate and timely customer billing.

·        Verify billing inputs against contracts, work orders, service records and operational data.

·        Support resolution of billing discrepancies and customer queries related to invoices.

·        Track outstanding customer issues impacting billing and collections.

·        Coordinate on customer quotations, rate revisions and service agreements where required.

6.     Documentation & Compliance

·        Ensure accuracy and completeness of shipment and customer documentation, including PODs, invoices, e-way bills and related logistics records.

·        Ensure customer and operational data is accurately maintained in ERP/WMS/TMS systems.

·        Maintain proper records for customer reviews, audits and internal reporting.

·        Ensure adherence to company processes and customer-specific documentation requirements.

7.     Team Management

·        Lead, mentor and manage the customer service team across assigned accounts.

·        Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual and team performance.

·        Train the team on customer processes, systems, communication and escalation handling.

·        Build a proactive customer service culture focused on responsiveness and resolution.

8.     Cross-Functional Coordination

·        Work closely with Warehouse, Transport, Operations, Finance, Sales and Commercial teams to resolve customer requirements.

·        Coordinate internally on capacity, dispatches, inventory, transportation and billing issues.

·        Ensure customer commitments are understood and delivered across functions.

·        Drive cross-functional resolution of recurring service issues.

title: Customer Manager
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You and this Role:**
As a
**Customer Manager – Consumer & Electronics and Mobility & Transportation**
to be located at Navi Mumbai/Bangalore and Pune, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth across strategic accounts and key market segments. You will work closely with OEMs, Tier suppliers, Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers and distribution partners to expand Dow's silicone solutions portfolio within Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Applications, Release Coatings, Elastomers, Railways, and other high-growth industries.
  
  
This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence market development, build strong customer partnerships, and contribute to Dow's growth strategy in India.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts while identifying new business opportunities.
* Develop strong relationships with OEMs, Tier customers, EMS partners, distributors, and key decision-makers.
* Create and execute territory and account growth plans aligned with business objectives.
* Identify and convert opportunities within target segments including Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Solutions, Elastomers, Railways, and Emerging Technologies.
* Lead opportunity pipeline management, pricing initiatives, contract negotiations, and commercial discussions.
* Collaborate closely with Technical Service & Development (TS&D), Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Conduct regular customer visits, business reviews, and market assessments to identify growth opportunities and competitive insights.
* Drive customer engagement around innovation, sustainability, localization, and new product adoption.

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Technology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, Technical Sales, Application Development, or Customer-Facing Commercial Roles.
* Proven track record of managing strategic customer relationships and delivering sustainable business growth.
* Strong understanding of commercial sales processes, account planning, opportunity management, and value-based selling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India to support customers and business growth initiatives.

**Preferred Experience:**
Experience in one or more of the following industries & product technology is highly desirable:
  
  

* Silicone and Specialty Chemicals
* Thermal Interface Materials
* Release coatings
* Silicone or other Elastomers.
* Electronics Materials
* EV and Mobility Solutions
* Consumer Solutions

**Your Skills:**

* Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and relationship-building capabilities
* Strong commercial acumen with a growth-oriented approach
* Technical aptitude and ability to learn new technologies, applications, and market trends
* Proactive approach to identifying and developing business opportunities
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Ability to influence stakeholders and develop long-term customer partnerships
* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills when collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams

**Additional Notes:**

* Travel within India is required based on business needs.
* Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.

* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
  
  
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. title: Account Manager
description:
**Job Title:**

Client Success Coach / Account Manager

**Company:**

Mudita

**Location:**

Bangur Nagar, Goregaon West, Mumbai

**Work Mode:**

Full-Time, Work From Office

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Experience Required:**

2–4 Years

**Preferred Background:**

EdTech, online coaching, client success, account management, community management, customer success, sales support, or learning program management

**Joining:**

Immediate joiners preferred

**About Mudita**

Mudita is a fast-growing education and transformation company offering outcome-driven learning programs across business, investing, AI, leadership, e-commerce, consulting, trading, and digital growth.

Our current programs include:

* **Algo Intelligence Elite**

  — AI Trading
* **Digital Wealth Domination**

  — Digital Finance
* **Decode Your Wealth**

  — Investing
* **Automate Your Business Using AI**

  — Business & AI
* **Leadership Mastery Action Plan**

  — Leadership
* **Build Your E-commerce Business**

  — E-commerce
* **Build a High-Income Consulting Business**

  — Consulting

We work with entrepreneurs, business owners, professionals, investors, coaches, consultants, creators, and learners who join our programs to build skills, implement systems, and achieve measurable personal or business growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Client Success Coach / Account Manager**

who will be responsible for ensuring that clients enrolled in Mudita’s programs receive the right guidance, support, accountability, and motivation throughout their learning journey.

This role is not just customer support. It is a mix of
**client success, account management, program engagement, implementation support, relationship building, upsell opportunity identification, and client success storytelling**

.

The ideal candidate should be able to build strong relationships with clients, understand their goals, track their progress, help them stay engaged, resolve concerns, coordinate with internal teams, and ensure that clients get maximum value from the programs they have purchased.

The role also involves helping Mudita identify
**client wins, testimonials, case studies, success stories, referrals, and higher upsell opportunities**

from existing clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Conduct onboarding calls with clients after they purchase a Mudita program and clearly explain the program structure, roadmap, timelines, support process, sessions, assignments, recordings, and expected outcomes.
2. Understand each client’s goals, background, challenges, expectations, and reason for joining the program.
3. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients throughout their program journey.
4. Regularly track client progress, attendance, participation, assignment completion, implementation status, and engagement levels.
5. Follow up with clients to ensure they attend sessions, complete action steps, stay accountable, and continue progressing in the program.
6. Help clients understand the course roadmap, key milestones, learning objectives, implementation steps, and available support systems.
7. Resolve client queries, concerns, doubts, access issues, communication gaps, and support requests in a timely and professional manner.
8. Coordinate with coaches, trainers, speakers, operations, sales, support, and internal teams to ensure smooth client experience.
9. Identify clients who are disengaged, inactive, confused, unhappy, or at risk of dropping off, and take proactive steps to re-engage them.
10. Maintain updated client records, call notes, progress updates, follow-up status, concerns, escalations, feedback, and success indicators in CRM, sheets, or trackers.
11. Build strong client relationships and create a positive, supportive, and trust-based experience for every client.
12. Identify client wins, improvements, progress stories, business results, implementation outcomes, and transformation moments.
13. Collect testimonials, feedback, screenshots, case study inputs, video testimonial opportunities, and client success stories.
14. Help the company create strong
    **client success assets**

    , such as testimonials, case studies, success stories, community highlights, proof posts, and brand-building content.
15. Identify clients who may be suitable for higher-level programs, premium offers, advanced mentorships, renewals, referrals, or upsells.
16. Support ethical and consultative upselling by understanding the client’s needs and recommending suitable next-level programs only where relevant.
17. Coordinate with the sales team or management for upsell opportunities, renewal possibilities, referral leads, and high-potential client accounts.
18. Share regular updates with management regarding client health, engagement, satisfaction, progress, complaints, escalations, testimonials, and upsell opportunities.
19. Help improve client satisfaction, retention, referrals, success ratios, repeat purchases, and overall program outcomes.
20. Support client communities, WhatsApp groups, live sessions, webinars, workshops, bootcamps, and internal communication wherever required.
21. Suggest improvements in client experience, onboarding flow, follow-up process, communication, program delivery, and support systems.
22. Perform any other client success, account management, coordination, or business growth-related tasks assigned by the Management from time to time.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in client success, account management, customer success, counselling, relationship management, community management, or EdTech support.
* Prior experience in online education, coaching, training, consulting, digital programs, or learning communities will be preferred.
* Strong communication skills in Hindi and English.
* Ability to build trust and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Good listening skills and ability to understand client needs, concerns, and goals.
* Strong follow-up discipline and ability to manage multiple clients at different stages.
* Ability to motivate clients and keep them accountable.
* Good problem-solving and query-resolution skills.
* Basic comfort with CRM tools, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, email, Zoom, and client trackers.
* Ability to identify testimonials, client wins, referrals, renewals, and upsell opportunities.
* Must be comfortable working full-time from the Goregaon West office.
* Must own a properly functioning laptop.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who:

* Enjoys talking to people and building relationships.
* Can support clients warmly while still being disciplined with follow-ups and accountability.
* Understands that client success means helping clients get real outcomes, not just answering questions.
* Can handle clients patiently, professionally, and confidently.
* Can identify when a client needs support, motivation, escalation, or a next-level solution.
* Can coordinate smoothly with coaches, speakers, sales, operations, and support teams.
* Can spot client wins and convert them into testimonials, case studies, and success stories.
* Has the maturity to identify upsell opportunities without sounding pushy.
* Is organized with documentation, trackers, follow-ups, and reporting.
* Can work in a fast-paced learning, coaching, and transformation-focused environment.

**Performance Expectations**

The candidate will be expected to improve:

* Client onboarding experience
* Client attendance and participation
* Assignment/action-step completion
* Client engagement and accountability
* Client satisfaction and relationship quality
* Query resolution time
* Drop-off reduction
* Program completion rates
* Client testimonials and success story collection
* Referral opportunities
* Renewal and upsell opportunities
* Overall client success ratios across Mudita’s programs

**Work Arrangement**

This is a
**full-time, work-from-office role**

based in
**Bangur Nagar, Goregaon West, Mumbai**

.

The candidate will be required to work from office and remain available for client calls, onboarding calls, follow-ups, live session coordination, internal team coordination, and reporting requirements.

Working days, working hours, weekly offs, holidays, and leave policy shall be as per Company policy and business requirements.

The role may require flexibility during live sessions, webinars, workshops, bootcamps, launches, or urgent client requirements.

**Why Join Mudita?**

* Work with a fast-growing education and transformation company.
* Get exposure to premium programs across AI trading, digital finance, investing, business automation, leadership, e-commerce, and consulting.
* Work closely with founders, speakers, coaches, and internal teams.
* Build strong client relationship and account management skills.
* Learn how client success directly contributes to retention, referrals, testimonials, upsells, and business growth.
* Opportunity to grow into senior client success, community, account management, or business growth roles based on performance.

**What You’ll Get:**

* Growth potential in higher-paying roles.
* Direct mentorship from industry leaders.
* Contribute to innovative learning solutions and client success.
* Exposure to competitive skills and exponential growth in the edtech industry.

**To Apply:**

Fill out the application form -
https://forms.gle/nnBpfmsTZenmfArq7

title: Student Support Manager - Edtech Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Student Query and Grievance Management**

* Oversee student queries received through email, ticketing systems, and other approved communication channels.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and complete resolution of student issues within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor ticket ageing, pending cases, repeat queries, escalations, and unresolved grievances.
* Coordinate with internal teams, institute representatives, faculty, and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Maintain clear communication with students until closure and ensure appropriate documentation of resolutions.

**B. Student Engagement and Retention**

* Proactively engage with students to understand their academic, administrative, and programme-related challenges.
* Identify disengaged, inactive, dissatisfied, and at-risk learners using available student data and engagement indicators.
* Execute structured outreach campaigns through email, calls, and other approved channels to improve participation and programme continuation.
* Follow up with students who have discontinued engagement or are at risk of dropping out.
* Support semester renewals, reactivation, and learner retention initiatives in coordination with relevant teams.

**C. Learner Experience and Satisfaction**

* Monitor recurring student concerns and identify root causes affecting the learner experience.
* Collect, analyse, and report student feedback, satisfaction trends, and grievance patterns.
* Recommend improvements in student-facing processes, communication, and service delivery.

**E. Student Communication and Online Reputation**

* Coordinate responses to student feedback and online grievances in accordance with approved communication guidelines.

* Identify emerging reputational risks and escalate sensitive issues promptly.

**F. Process Management and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures for student query management, outreach, escalation, and closure.
* Maintain accurate student interaction records, ticket histories, follow-up actions, and resolution documentation.
* Analyse recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce repeat queries and operational inefficiencies.
* Work with cross-functional teams to improve turnaround time, communication quality, and overall student experience.

**G. MIS, Reporting, and Team Management**

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) covering query resolution, SLA adherence, student satisfaction, retention, renewals, and outreach effectiveness.
* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports highlighting performance, risks, trends, and corrective actions.
* Lead daily operational reviews and weekly performance discussions with the Student Success team, where applicable.
* Coach team members on communication, problem-solving, ownership, and service quality.
* Ensure accountability for assigned activities, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

description:
We need someone to own growth on Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto and the platforms that come next, and to support our e-commerce marketplaces. You’ll grow sales, availability and visibility, and build strong ties with each platform’s category team.

* Net sales vs plan, by platform and city
* On-shelf availability (OSA) and fill rate
* Active cities and dark stores
* ROAS, share of search and listing health
* Seller tier progress and speed of issue resolution

* 3–6 years managing quick commerce or marketplace accounts, on the brand or agency side, with hands-on
* Blinkit, Instamart or Zepto experience

* Ownership mindset and comfort with fast-changing priorities

title: CRM Manager
description:
**Job description:**

**Job Description: CRM Manager**

**Mid-Senior Level 5–6 Years of Experience**

**Department: Customer Relationship Management**

**Preferred Industries: Wellness, Nutrition, FMCG, Lifestyle, Beauty and D2C**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on CRM Team Lead to manage the entire customer relationship and support function, including CRM executives, chat support executives and sales executives. The ideal candidate should have 5–6 years of experience in customer relationship management, team handling and sales operations, preferably in a D2C or consumer-focused business.

This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day team operations, ensuring high-quality customer interactions across calls and chats, monitoring ticket resolution and turnaround times, and supporting the team in handling escalations, delivery issues and other customer concerns. The candidate should have a strong understanding of CRM tools, reporting, customer service metrics and team performance management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Team Management & Leadership

Lead and manage a team of CRM executives, chat support executives and sales executives, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.

Allocate responsibilities, monitor individual and team performance, and ensure achievement of defined targets and KPIs.

Conduct regular team meetings, provide coaching and feedback, and support team members in resolving operational challenges.

Ensure adequate team coverage and timely handling of customer interactions across all communication channels.

2. Quality Assurance & Customer Experience

Own the quality of all customer interactions across outbound and inbound calls, chats, emails and social media channels.

Monitor call recordings and chat conversations to ensure adherence to communication standards, brand tone and customer service protocols.

Conduct regular quality audits, identify gaps and implement corrective actions through training and coaching.

Ensure consistent, professional and timely responses to customer queries, complaints and escalations.

3. Customer Support & Issue Resolution

Oversee the daily handling of customer queries, complaints, delivery-related issues, order concerns, refunds and other operational challenges.

Support the team in resolving complex customer issues and escalations, coordinating with relevant internal departments wherever required.

Ensure that all incoming messages across customer communication channels are acknowledged and addressed within the defined turnaround time.

Monitor open and pending tickets, follow up on unresolved cases and ensure timely closure with appropriate resolution.

Establish and maintain clear escalation processes to ensure customer issues are addressed efficiently.

4. CRM Operations & Ticket Management

Manage the daily CRM operations, ensuring accurate tracking and timely resolution of customer tickets across all channels.

Monitor open, closed, pending and escalated tickets, identify backlogs and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).

Maintain proper documentation of customer interactions, complaints, resolutions and follow-up activities.

Ensure the team follows standard operating procedures (SOPs) for ticket management, customer communication and issue resolution.

Have a strong working knowledge of CRM tools, ticketing systems and customer support platforms.

5. Sales Operations & Performance Monitoring

Monitor the performance of the sales executives, ensuring consistent follow-ups, customer engagement and achievement of assigned sales targets.

Support the team in driving upselling, cross-selling and repeat purchases through effective customer communication.

Track key sales and service metrics, identify performance gaps and work with team members to improve productivity and conversions.

Ensure coordination between the sales and customer support teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

6. Reporting & Data Analysis

Prepare and maintain daily, weekly and monthly reports covering call volumes, chat volumes, ticket status, resolution rates, customer complaints and team productivity.

Track key metrics such as first response time, average resolution time, ticket backlog, customer satisfaction and quality scores.

Analyse customer interaction data to identify recurring issues, operational bottlenecks and opportunities for process improvement.

Share regular performance updates, operational insights and escalation reports with the CRM Head.

7. Social Media & Omnichannel Support

Oversee customer communication across social media platforms, email, chat, calls and other relevant channels.

Ensure all incoming customer messages, comments and queries are monitored and responded to within the defined turnaround time.

Maintain basic social media customer service hygiene, including timely responses, appropriate communication and escalation of sensitive issues.

Ensure consistent customer service standards and brand communication across all channels.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

5–6 years of experience in CRM, customer service, customer experience or sales operations, preferably in a D2C or B2C business.

Prior experience managing a team of CRM executives, chat support executives and sales executives.

Experience in wellness, nutrition, FMCG, lifestyle, beauty or other consumer-facing industries will be preferred.

Strong understanding of CRM platforms, ticketing systems and omnichannel customer support operations.

Hands-on experience with quality monitoring, call audits, chat audits and team performance management.

title: Field Account Manager
description:

**Introduction**
Join our Account Management team as a Field Account Manager and play a key role in driving revenue growth and strengthening customer partnerships across assigned accounts. Through strategic account management, commercial leadership, and close collaboration with Technical Sales teams, you will help accelerate customer success and support the delivery of innovative solutions that contribute to better health for more people. * Identify and develop growth opportunities within assigned accounts by leveraging Technical Sales support for validation, trials, and solution design to deepen stakeholder engagement and expand portfolio adoption
* Drive adoption of innovative and newly launched products by communicating their value, supporting successful implementation, and delivering NPI-related targets

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field

* Strong commercial acumen with proven skills in negotiation, opportunity management, and account planning
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence decision-makers and partner effectively with Technical Sales teams
* High proficiency in SFDC and CRM tools for pipeline management, forecasting, and sales performance tracking
* Self-driven, results-oriented approach with the ability to coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and deliver business outcomes
* Willingness to travel more than 50% as this role is heavily focused on customer engagement

**About Sartorius**
Sartorius is part of the solution in the fight against cancer, dementia, and many other diseases. Our technologies help translate scientific discoveries into real-world medicine faster, so that new therapeutics can reach patients worldwide.
  
  
We look for ambitious team players and creative minds, who want to contribute to this goal and advance their careers in a dynamic global environment.
  
  
Join our global team and become part of the solution. We are looking forward to receiving your application.
  
  
www.sartorius.com/careers

title: Vice President, Client Services
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

**About Mindshare : A Leading WPP Media Brand,**
Mindshare delivers Good Growth for its clients. As “Growth Architects," we drive growth that benefits all stakeholders — better for people, planet, and business — by using media with intention. This approach creates more meaningful connections with consumers, increases consumer trust in the brand, and delivers better outcomes for all stakeholders.
  
  
****Role Summary And Impact****
**Reporting of the Role**
This role reports to:
**Head — Strategy & Intelligence**
****3 Best Things About The Job****

* Category depth with business breadth - You own one category completely - its media landscape, its competitive dynamics, its consumer and cultural context. But you never lose sight of the business. Everything connects back to growth.
* Senior work from day one - This is a client-facing strategic leadership role. You will be in senior conversations, leading strategic recommendations and influencing how some of India's most iconic brands invest in media.
* A strategy practice - You will be joining a team that is reimagining what media strategy looks like - integrating AI, data intelligence and cultural thinking into a practice that goes well beyond traditional media planning.

**In This Role, Your Goals Will Be**
**In 3 months:**
Develop deep working knowledge of your assigned category - brands, competitive landscape, consumer context and media history. Build relationships with key internal and client stakeholders. Begin owning deliverables and contributing meaningfully to strategic discussions.
  
  
**In 6 months:**
Independently lead strategic presentations and recommendations for your category. Become the internal authority on category intelligence. Be proactively bringing insights and opportunities to client teams rather than only responding to briefs.
  
  
**In 12 months:**
Own the strategic agenda for your category. Lead major client reviews independently. Have measurably elevated the quality and ambition of strategic thinking for the portfolio. Be seen by clients as an indispensable strategic partner.
  
  
****Skills And Experience****
**Key Responsibilities**
**Category Strategy & Intelligence**
Lead the strategic intelligence agenda for your assigned category - synthesising competitive media activity, consumer behaviour, cultural trends and business dynamics into clear, actionable strategic narratives for client and internal teams.
  
  
**Client Partnership & Senior Stakeholder Engagement**
Build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across brand and media. Drive strategic discussions that connect media investment to brand equity and business outcomes - going beyond campaign execution to category growth thinking.
  
  
**Media Strategy Leadership**
Develop and own the media strategy for your category portfolio - grounded in planning rigour, informed by data and connected to the broader business agenda. Ensure strategy translates consistently from brief to plan to outcome.
  
  
**Competitive & Consumer Intelligence**
Maintain a current and nuanced understanding of the competitive media landscape, consumer media behaviour and emerging cultural trends. Translate these into timely, actionable recommendations that give the brand a strategic edge.
  
  
**Data & Insights**
Build bespoke strategic analyses, deep-dive studies and intelligence frameworks using media data, consumer research tools and secondary sources. Turn complex data into clear points of view.
  
  
**Thought Leadership & Collaboration**
Partner with Central planning, data and activation teams to ensure strategic intent is reflected at every stage of the media investment cycle. Contribute to agency thought leadership and category best practice.
  
  
****What Your Day Job Looks Like****

* Monitoring competitive activity, consumer signals and cultural trends to identify strategic opportunities and risks for your category brands.
* Building and presenting strategic analyses and recommendations for client brand and planning reviews - connecting media thinking to business outcomes.
* Working with planning and data teams to ensure category strategy is reflected accurately in media plans and measurement frameworks.
* Scanning secondary research, social listening tools and consumer survey platforms to build and update category intelligence.
* Adding strategic nuances to CCBT, MOC and AOP discussions - developing the category point of view that shapes investment decisions.
* Collaborating with Central strategy and intelligence teams to build category-specific frameworks, tools and best practices.

****What You Will Need****
**Must Have**

* 10–14 years of experience in media strategy, with a strong foundation of must-have 3–6 years in core media planning at a leading media agency. A solid grounding in planning mechanics - channel strategy, audience and reach thinking, platform dynamics, ROI frameworks - is essential for this role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver senior-level strategic recommendations - to category heads, marketing directors or equivalent - with confidence and clarity.
* Strong experience working on large FMCG or consumer brand accounts, with an understanding of how brand strategy, consumer insights and media investment connect to business outcomes.
* Excellent analytical capability - ability to work across multiple data sources (media, consumer, competitive, business) and synthesise a clear and actionable point of view.
* Outstanding communication skills - able to simplify complexity, build compelling narratives and present to senior internal and external audiences.
* A proactive, independent working style - someone who brings the agenda rather than waiting for the brief.

**Good to Have**

* Domain expertise in one of the following categories: Beauty & Wellbeing, Home Care, Personal Care or Foods & Nutrition.
* Experience on the brand or strategy side at an FMCG or digital media/tech company.
* Familiarity with AI-powered intelligence tools, social listening platforms and emerging media research methodologies.
* Experience contributing to brand planning, AOP or marketing strategy discussions beyond the media brief.
* Working knowledge of 1PD strategy, audience intelligence frameworks and data-driven planning approaches.

****Minimum Qualifications****

* Postgraduate degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience with a demonstrated foundation in media planning and a track record of strategic leadership.
* Experience managing senior client relationships independently.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: General Manager – Cross-Border Healthcare
description:
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
5+ Years of Experience

**Locations:**
Mumbai, Delhi, Dubai, Geneva, Lagos, Abuja, Nairobi

**Work Mode:**
Remote / Hybrid

Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on General Manager to lead business development, strategic partnerships, and operational coordination for a growing cross-border healthcare business.

The role focuses on connecting patients, referring doctors, hospitals, insurers, and healthcare partners to facilitate access to quality and affordable international medical treatment. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and cross-functional teams to expand referral networks, develop hospital partnerships, improve patient coordination, and drive the adoption of a technology-enabled healthcare platform.

Key Responsibilities1. Healthcare Business Development & Partnerships

* Develop and manage relationships with doctors, hospitals, clinics, insurers, corporates, healthcare facilitators, and other referral partners.
* Drive patient referrals and build strategic partnerships across priority markets, particularly in Africa.
* Support partnership negotiations, agreements, onboarding, and ongoing engagement.
* Collaborate with digital marketing teams to support patient acquisition and business growth.

2. International Patient Management & Operations

* Oversee international patient journeys, from initial enquiries and treatment planning to travel, treatment, and post-treatment follow-up.
* Coordinate medical quotations, patient approvals, visa documentation, travel arrangements, accommodation, hospital coordination, insurance approvals, billing, and payments.
* Establish efficient workflows, service standards, and escalation mechanisms.
* Step in directly to resolve complex patient cases and operational challenges when required.

3. Hospital Network Development

* Expand and manage partnerships with hospitals across India, Türkiye, the UAE, Thailand, and other approved destinations.
* Coordinate hospital onboarding, commercial agreements, treatment quotations, and information collection.
* Work with hospitals, patients, and referring doctors to obtain treatment plans and necessary clarifications.
* Ensure clear documentation of patient cases, payment processes, and commercial arrangements.

4. Digital Healthcare Platform Adoption

* Work with product and technology teams to improve a digital platform supporting patients, hospitals, doctors, insurers, and healthcare partners.
* Provide operational feedback, participate in platform testing, and follow up on agreed development priorities.
* Onboard pilot partners and encourage active platform usage to increase patient referrals.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology.

5. Business Growth & Strategy

* Research new markets, healthcare services, and partnership opportunities.
* Support initiatives such as surgical camps, telemedicine services, post-treatment care, and insurance-focused healthcare solutions.
* Evaluate pilot projects and recommend opportunities for expansion.
* Support the implementation of business growth initiatives across international markets.

6. Team Management & Reporting

* Coordinate internal teams and external partners across multiple countries.
* Track patient cases, referral partnerships, hospital onboarding, and business development activities.
* Report performance, operational challenges, and key risks to the CEO.
* Ensure timely follow-ups, accountability, and a consistent patient experience.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* At least 4 years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, healthcare business development, patient services, or related fields.
* Strong experience in business development, strategic partnerships, stakeholder management, and team coordination.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage strategic responsibilities while contributing directly to operational activities.
* Comfortable working in a growing business environment with evolving processes.
* Relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in medical tourism, international patient management, medical travel, or cross-border healthcare.
* Experience working with hospitals, doctors, healthcare providers, insurers, or medical facilitators.
* Medical qualifications such as MBBS, BDS, or MDS will be preferred.
* Exposure to digital health platforms, telemedicine, or healthcare technology is an advantage.
* Experience working with international markets, particularly Africa, is desirable.

Key Performance Indicators

* Growth in active healthcare referral partners and qualified patient referrals.
* Number of successfully coordinated international patient cases and patient satisfaction.
* Expansion and performance of the destination-hospital network.
* Adoption of the digital platform by partners and pilot customers.
* Timely patient coordination, operational efficiency, and business growth.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an international healthcare business.
* Exposure to healthcare markets and partners across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.
* A collaborative work environment with direct access to senior leadership.
* An opportunity to help build technology-enabled solutions that improve international patient access to healthcare.
* Competitive remuneration, with potential performance-linked incentives and stock options.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with a brief summary of their relevant experience in healthcare business development, operations, or international patient management.

**Email:**
careers@duretechnologies.com

Application – General Manager, Cross-Border Healthcare

title: Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services
description:
At Corbion, we exist to champion preservation in all its forms, preserving food and food production, health, and our planet.

**The role**

As Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services, you will connect customer needs with practical ingredient solutions that support product innovation and commercial growth across India. Your primary focus will be bakery applications, complemented by opportunities in confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood.

This is a senior, customer-facing technical role rather than a traditional laboratory-based R&D position. You will engage directly with customers and their R&D teams, explore their current and future technical challenges, and translate these insights into viable solutions. Working closely with Corbion’s product management, commercial, regional and global application teams, you will develop, test and implement solutions using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.

A unique part of the position is the opportunity to help establish Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai. You will contribute your expertise and recommendations during its development and subsequently lead its activities as a regional innovation hub. The laboratory will support bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments applications and enable customer solutions to be tested and optimized before implementation at customer locations.

The position is based fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and involves approximately 30% to 40% travel, primarily within India and, where required, selected South Asian markets. Customer implementation and plant trials may require visits of several consecutive days.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build trusted technical partnerships with customers, distributors and strategic accounts by understanding their product, process, quality and manufacturing challenges.
* Work directly with customer R&D teams to identify current and future application needs and translate these into commercially viable ingredient solutions.
* Develop and optimize applications using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.
* Lead formulation and application work across bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood, with bakery as the primary area of focus.
* Develop solutions addressing shelf-life extension, food safety, clean-label reformulation, texture enhancement, yield improvement, flavour optimization and cost-in-use reduction.
* Take customer development projects from initial needs assessment and laboratory trials through validation, implementation and commercialization.
* Design and conduct application trials, including ingredient selection, dosage optimization and process improvement, to identify solutions customers can efficiently validate and implement.
* Lead customer plant trials, industrial validation and implementation across multiple manufacturing locations where required.
* Troubleshoot formulation, preservation, processing and implementation challenges, and conduct product benchmarking and competitive evaluations.
* Work with regional and global product management and application teams to adapt existing knowledge and solutions to Indian market requirements.
* Contribute expertise and recommendations to establishing Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai, and lead it as a center of excellence supporting customer innovation and business growth.
* Define laboratory objectives, budgets, equipment investment plans and capability-development roadmaps; manage resources, maintenance, calibration, utilization and materials inventory.
* Coordinate pilot-scale and customer-simulation trials, introduce new testing methodologies, and maintain protocols, formulation databases, technical reports and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with Corbion’s safety, quality, food-safety and housekeeping standards and support internal and external laboratory audits.
* Deliver technical presentations, customer workshops, seminars and training programs, and support customer qualification processes and technical audits.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to identify opportunities, develop the commercial pipeline and convert technical projects into business growth.
* Participate in strategic customer engagements, business reviews, innovation sessions, exhibitions, trade fairs and industry forums.
* Monitor market trends, regulatory developments, competitor activity and emerging technologies, and recommend innovation priorities based on customer and market insights.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and regional and global R&D teams.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution and, as the laboratory develops, help build and coach its technical capabilities.

**You bring**

*Requirements*

* A bachelor’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a closely related food-science discipline.
* At least 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in food ingredients, food manufacturing or the specialty ingredients industry.
* Strong experience in customer-facing technical support and the credibility to work directly with experienced customer R&D and manufacturing teams.
* Strong knowledge of food ingredients and their functionality within finished-product applications, with strong technical expertise in bakery applications.
* Experience in at least one additional relevant category, preferably confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry or seafood. Deep bakery expertise with some confectionery exposure may also fit.
* The ability to explore customer needs in depth, ask strong technical questions and translate customer challenges into practical application and ingredient solutions.
* Experience with laboratory or application trials, formulation optimization, technical troubleshooting and implementation in customer production environments.
* Understanding of product scale-up and commercialization, including implementation across multiple customer manufacturing locations.
* Knowledge of food preservation, clean-label product development, food safety and microbiology fundamentals.
* Strong project leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, communication, presentation and influencing skills.
* A customer-focused, commercially aware and collaborative approach, with the ability to work across functions and geographies.
* Willingness to work fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and travel approximately 30% to 40%.

*Preferred*

* A master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a related discipline.
* Experience in application or product development. Candidates whose primary strength is customer-facing technical support may also fit when combined with strong ingredient knowledge and solution-development capability.
* Experience leading or contributing to the establishment, management or capability development of an application laboratory.
* Experience within a multinational food-ingredient company.
* Specialized training or experience in bakery, confectionery, meat processing, culinary products, preservation technologies or product development.
* Knowledge of organic acids, cultured ingredients, fermentation-based solutions, functional blends and emulsifiers.
* Knowledge of HACCP, GMP, FSSC 22000 and other relevant food-quality systems.
* Experience with experimental design, laboratory documentation, audits and equipment or budget planning.
* Previous production experience or direct exposure to customer manufacturing environments.
* Experience coaching or developing technical or laboratory colleagues.

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to shape and lead Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai and contribute your expertise while its capabilities are being established.
* A highly visible role combining customer engagement, technical problem-solving, application development and commercial impact.
* The opportunity to work on strategic innovation priorities, including natural preservation solutions for bakery and new confectionery applications.
* Direct collaboration with customer R&D and manufacturing teams and with Corbion’s Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing and global innovation organizations.
* Access to expertise from Corbion’s regional and global application teams, allowing successful technologies and solutions from other markets to be adapted for India.
* The opportunity to build application capabilities that strengthen Corbion’s position as an innovation partner for preservation, food safety, clean-label and sustainable ingredient solutions.
* Scope to build and develop a technical laboratory team as the Navi Mumbai facility grows.
* Potential to broaden into larger technical-commercial or business-development responsibilities in India and across Asia.
* The opportunity to contribute to measurable customer and business outcomes, including successful product launches, commercialized projects, improved technical solutions and stronger strategic partnerships.

**About Corbion**

Corbion is the global market leader in lactic acid and its derivatives, and a leading supplier of emulsifiers, functional enzyme blends, minerals, vitamins, and algae ingredients. We use our unique expertise in fermentation and other processes to deliver sustainable solutions for the preservation of food and food production, health, and our planet. For over 100 years, we have been uncompromising in our commitment to safety, quality, innovation and performance. Drawing on our deep application and product knowledge, we work side-by-side with customers to make our cutting-edge technologies work for them. Our solutions help differentiate products in markets such as food, home & personal care, animal nutrition, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and bioplastics. In 2025, Corbion generated annual sales of €1,267.4 million and had a workforce of 2,408 FTE. For more information: www.corbion.com

Corbion is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse workplace. All applicants will be considered equally.

***Corbion does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers. All candidates must be submitted by approved Corbion vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Talent Acquisition team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Corbion Talent Acquisition team and such candidate was submitted to the Corbion Talent Acquisition Team.***

title: Enterprise Growth Associate
description:
All positionsEnterprise Growth Associate GrowthMumbai, IndiaFull-time Apply Now

**About the Role**

As an Enterprise Growth Associate at IQWorks, you will take our data protection platform to the enterprises that need it most and stay with them from the first conversation through implementation and early success. This is a revenue-focused role with a real product dimension: you will identify and scope prospective clients, act as their primary point of contact through evaluation, lead a fast implementation once they sign, and feed what you learn back into the product. Our growth is built on relationship-driven sales to large clients, not high-volume cold calling. The only services-like part of the job is standing up the product on the client side, and even that is designed to be quick — we hire people who can play a dual functional and semi-technical role so deployments finish in a few weeks, never drag on for months. You will lean on AI heavily to do the work that has traditionally been manual — research, account mapping, outreach, call prep, and follow-ups — while applying sharp judgment about where the human touch matters most, so relationships and deal quality are never compromised. We support hybrid working and flexible hours, and we look for people who bring the consistency and responsiveness that high-ownership work depends on. This role sits within a growing go-to-market team, with executive support from managers and leadership as you scale accounts.

**What You Will Do**

* Identify and scope prospective enterprise clients, reach out, and set up initial discussions through relationship-driven business development, not high-volume cold calling
* Act as the primary liaison for prospective customers — running demos, pitches, discussions, workshops, and in-person business development
* Lead product implementation for client onboarding, configuration, and customization, owning changes end to end so deployments complete in a few weeks
* Own client success after deployment — driving adoption, renewals, and account expansion, with executive support from managers and leadership
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers on data privacy regulations and how to operationalize them in IQWorks, running business reviews that connect outcomes to their goals
* Take functional ownership of product enhancements in conjunction with internal development teams
* Collaborate with marketing and PR to drive brand presence
* Support product development teams on new features, enhancements, and functional documentation
* Travel to Indian metros and international client locations as engagements require

**What We Are Looking For**

* 2+ years in a client-facing role — business development, sales, solutions, consulting, or customer success at a B2B or enterprise technology company
* Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (DPDPA, GDPR, HIPAA, or similar) and how enterprises operationalize compliance
* Comfort owning relationships with large enterprise clients through a full evaluation, onboarding, and renewal cycle
* A dual mindset — strong on the functional and business side, and semi-technical enough to lead a product implementation, configuration, and customization
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can run demos, pitches, and workshops with senior stakeholders
* Fluency with AI tools as a force multiplier — using them to automate research, outreach, and reporting that used to be done by hand, with a strong sense of when human judgment should lead so quality is never compromised
* Willingness to travel to Indian metros and international client locations
* Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data privacy, security, compliance, or governance software
* Familiarity with data privacy regulations (DPDPA, GDPR, HIPAA, or similar)
* Technical fluency — SQL, APIs, or basic scripting — enough to configure and troubleshoot during implementation
* Privacy certification such as CIPP, CIPM, or DCPP
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM
* Experience implementing or deploying enterprise software at customer sites
* Prior experience as an early go-to-market or implementation hire at a high-growth startup

title: Senior Customer Success Executive
description:
**Company Profile:** 




 MProfit is a rapidly growing wealth\-tech company reshaping how Indians view and track their wealth.
 



  





 Backed by Rainmatter (by Zerodha) and other distinguished investors, MProfit equips investors and wealth professionals with cutting\-edge solutions that offer a clear, consolidated view of their financial assets, enabling better insights and decision\-making.
 



  





 As a robust, data\-driven platform, MProfit is trusted by HNIs, UHNIs, and Family Offices to track and analyse diverse, multi\-asset investment portfolios. Our proprietary integrations with 1200\+ institutions elevate data aggregation to a new standard of precision and automation.
 



  





 Today, MProfit is a leader in India’s wealth\-tech ecosystem, with customers in 300\+ cities collectively tracking 1\.5 lakh\+ portfolios. As we continue to expand our dynamic team, we remain committed to launching new products, pioneering innovations, and redefining wealth tracking for modern India.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are looking for a highly driven and experienced
 **Customer Success Lead – Non\-Voice (Email Support** 
 ) to lead our customer support operations and deliver an exceptional customer experience. This role combines hands\-on customer support expertise with team leadership responsibilities. You will manage a team of 4–5 Customer Success Executives, oversee customer communication through email and ticketing platforms, and ensure timely resolution of customer queries related to portfolio tracking, investment data, integrations, and platform functionality. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, and SaaS platforms, as well as excellent written communication, analytical thinking, and leadership skills. We are looking for a self\-starter who can contribute from day one, work independently with minimal supervision, and take complete ownership of the customer support function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Team Leadership \& Support Operations Management:** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 4–5 Customer Success Executives (Non\-Voice Email Support).
* Drive team productivity, service quality, SLA adherence, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Monitor ticket queues, workload distribution, escalations, and resolution timelines.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions to improve team effectiveness.
* Establish best practices for customer communication, issue resolution, and support processes.
* Take complete ownership of customer support coordination and day\-to\-day support operations.
* Ensure effective resource planning, workload management, and timely resolution of customer issues.



  





**2\. Customer Query Resolution \& Ticket Management:** 



* Manage customer support tickets end\-to\-end through email and helpdesk platforms.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues related to portfolio tracking, imports, reconciliations, integrations, reports, and product functionality.
* Ensure adherence to defined SLAs, response quality standards, and customer satisfaction goals.
* Prioritise and manage multiple customer conversations simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Handle critical customer escalations and drive timely resolutions.
* Maintain ownership of customer issues until they are successfully closed.



  





**3\. Quality Assurance, Audits \& Coaching:** 



* Conduct regular audits of customer support emails, tickets, and calls in accordance with the organisation's quality audit framework.
* Review customer interactions to ensure adherence to communication standards, product knowledge requirements, SLA commitments, and customer experience benchmarks.
* Track quality metrics and identify recurring gaps, trends, and opportunities for improvement across the team.
* Provide structured feedback, coaching, and training recommendations based on audit findings.
* Ensure consistent compliance with support processes, quality standards, and customer communication guidelines.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective and preventive actions based on audit observations.



  





**4\. Financial Data \& Investment Product Support:** 




 Assist customers with queries related to:
 


* Equities (Stocks)
* Mutual Funds
* PMS
* AIFs
* Bonds \& Fixed Income Instruments
* ETFs
* Alternative Investments



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Analysing portfolio data, transactions, holdings, and reports to identify root causes of customer issues.
* Assisting customers in understanding platform outputs, reports, performance calculations, and investment\-related data.
* Providing consultative guidance on data interpretation and portfolio reporting.



  





**5\. Customer Success \& Relationship Management:** 



* Deliver a high\-quality customer experience through professional, accurate, and empathetic written communication.
* Build trust and credibility by acting as a knowledgeable advisor to customers.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer adoption and platform utilisation.
* Gather and document customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring pain points.
* Ensure consistent communication and follow\-up throughout the customer lifecycle.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Onboarding, and Customer Success teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure smooth handling of escalations and customer concerns.
* Communicate customer insights, recurring trends, and improvement opportunities to internal teams.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.



  





**7\. Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence:** 



* Take ownership of continuously improving customer support processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.
* Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, recurring customer issues, and inefficiencies across the support function.
* Analyse support metrics, ticket trends, audit findings, customer feedback, and escalation patterns to drive improvements.
* Design and implement scalable solutions that improve response times, resolution quality, customer satisfaction, and team productivity.
* Develop, standardise, and maintain SOPs, workflows, quality guidelines, and best practices across the support team.
* Drive automation and process optimisation initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve operational effectiveness.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and Customer Success teams to implement long\-term solutions for recurring issues.
* Track the impact of process improvement initiatives and establish measurable outcomes to ensure continuous enhancement of support operations.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence within the team.



  





**8\. Knowledge Management \& Documentation:** 



* Create and maintain internal knowledge resources, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and training documentation.
* Ensure knowledge repositories remain up to date with product enhancements, process changes, and resolutions of recurring issues.
* Contribute to onboarding and training initiatives for new team members.
* Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the Customer Success team.



  





**Desired Candidate** 



* ProfileBachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Support, Client Servicing, Operations, or related roles.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring customer support or customer success teams.
* Strong understanding of financial markets and investment products, including Stocks, Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Bonds, ETFs, and other wealth management products.
* Excellent written communication skills with strong grammar and business email etiquette.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to investigate customer issues, identify root causes, and communicate solutions effectively.
* Experience working with SaaS products and technology platforms.
* Proficiency in helpdesk and ticketing tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Zoho Desk, or similar platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with financial data.



  





**Key Leadership Traits** 



* Self\-starter who can quickly understand processes and contribute from day one.
* Self\-learner with the ability to independently acquire product, process, and domain knowledge.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high accountability.
* Strong ownership mindset with the capability to independently manage and improve support operations.
* Comfortable making decisions, driving initiatives, and resolving challenges proactively.
* Strong focus on quality, process discipline, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable solutions.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to analyse support metrics, audit findings, and customer feedback to drive decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to build processes, improve team performance, and scale customer support operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, and team coordination skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience in fintech, wealth\-tech, broking, investment advisory, mutual fund, PMS, AIF, or financial services organisations.
* Familiarity with portfolio management, capital markets, and investment operations.
* Exposure to customer support metrics, SLAs, CSAT, quality audits, and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing customer escalations and leading support teams in a fast\-paced SaaS environment.
