title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Maritime**
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Account Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
   

  

 Account Manager – Marketing Clients
   

  

 Company: BingeAt Media LLP
   

 Department: Client Servicing / Marketing
   

 Location: Kalyan / Mumbai
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Experience: Minimum 3years in Account Management, Client Servicing, Digital Marketing or Agency Operations
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 BingeAt Media LLP is looking for an Account Manager to manage day\-to\-day relationships with marketing clients and coordinate the successful execution of their marketing requirements.
   

  

 The Account Manager will be responsible for understanding client requirements, planning deliverables, coordinating with internal teams, maintaining communication, monitoring project progress, and ensuring client satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Client Management
   

  

 \- Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
   

 \- Understand client business objectives, requirements and expectations.
   

 \- Maintain regular communication through calls, meetings, email and approved communication channels.
   

 \- Build strong, professional and long\-term client relationships.
   

 \- Handle client feedback, concerns and escalations professionally.
   

  

 2\. Marketing Project Coordination
   

  

 \- Coordinate with Social Media, Performance Marketing, Creative, Content, Video and Web teams.
   

 \- Prepare and communicate briefs clearly to internal teams.
   

 \- Track project timelines, deliverables and approvals.
   

 \- Ensure deliverables are completed as per agreed scope and timelines.
   

 \- Follow up internally to avoid delays and bottlenecks.
   

  

 3\. Strategy \& Client Understanding
   

  

 \- Understand the client's business, target audience, competitors and marketing objectives.
   

 \- Participate in marketing planning and review meetings.
   

 \- Assist the team in developing monthly marketing plans, campaigns and content strategies.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve campaign and marketing performance.
   

  

 4\. Reporting \& Reviews
   

  

 \- Coordinate monthly/periodic performance reports.
   

 \- Present campaign updates and key performance metrics to clients.
   

 \- Maintain records of client feedback, approvals, pending items and action points.
   

 \- Conduct regular account reviews with clients where required.
   

  

 5\. Client Retention \& Growth
   

  

 \- Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential retention risks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for additional services based on client requirements.
   

 \- Coordinate cross\-selling/up\-selling of relevant services such as:
   

 \- Social Media Management
   

 \- Performance Marketing
   

 \- Branding \& Creative
   

 \- Website Development
   

 \- Video Production
   

 \- SEO
   

 \- Lead Generation
   

 \- Content Marketing
   

 \- Coordinate internally for proposals and quotations for additional requirements.
   

  

 6\. Account Administration
   

  

 \- Maintain updated client information, requirements, deliverables and communication records in the company's systems.
   

 \- Ensure proper documentation of approvals and important decisions.
   

 \- Follow BingeAt Media LLP's internal project management and documentation processes.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Excellent verbal and written communication.
   

 \- Strong client\-handling and relationship\-management skills.
   

 \- Good understanding of digital marketing and social media.
   

 \- Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
   

 \- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines.
   

 \- Problem\-solving and escalation\-management ability.
   

 \- Good presentation and meeting skills.
   

 \- Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into actionable briefs.
   

 \- Working knowledge of Google Workspace and project\-management tools.
   

 \- Basic understanding of marketing metrics and campaign performance.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication or a related field.
   

 \- Prior experience in a digital marketing / advertising / creative agency.
   

 \- Experience handling multiple marketing accounts will be preferred.
   

  

 Performance Expectations
   

  

 The Account Manager will be expected to maintain:
   

  

 \- High client satisfaction and retention.
   

 \- Timely completion of client deliverables.
   

 \- Clear and proactive client communication.
   

 \- Accurate internal coordination and follow\-ups.
   

 \- Strong understanding of assigned client accounts.
   

 \- Identification of opportunities for account growth.
   

 \- Proper documentation and project tracking.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 \- Client Retention
   

 \- Client Satisfaction
   

 \- Timely Delivery of Projects
   

 \- Client Communication \& Response Management
   

 \- Account Growth / Cross\-Selling
   

 \- Quality of Briefs \& Internal Coordination
   

 \- Reduction in Client Escalations
   

 \- Timely Collection/Follow\-up coordination where assigned
   

  

 Reporting
   

  

 Reports To: General Manager / Business Head / Assigned Team Leader
   

  

 Works Closely With:
   

 Creative Team • Social Media Team • Performance Marketing Team • Content Team • Video Team • Web Development Team • Management
   

  

 Candidate Profile
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is proactive, organised, client\-focused and commercially aware, with the ability to manage relationships while ensuring that the internal team delivers work efficiently.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should not merely take instructions from clients—they should understand the client's business, anticipate requirements, coordinate solutions and contribute to the growth of the account.

 Raise invoices for project milestones post\-architecture certification until the project is ready for possession.
   

  

 Manage the possession certification process to facilitate a smooth handover to customers.
   

  

**Snagging And Desnagging Process**
 Coordinate customer visits to properties for snagging and desnagging, ensuring all issues are documented and addressed promptly.
   

  

 Work with relevant teams to resolve all identified snags before handover.
   

  

**Final Handover**
 Facilitate the final handover of keys and parking allotment letters to customers.
   

  

 Ensure that customers receive all necessary documentation and support during the handover process.
   

  

**Documentation And Reporting**
 Prepare and maintain accurate records of client interactions, sales activities, and feedback for continuous improvement.
   

  

 Generate reports on customer satisfaction levels and operational performance.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Work closely with internal teams, including marketing and project management, to align client needs with business offerings.
   

  

 Attend industry events and conferences to network and promote Adani Realty's brand.

 Customers

 Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships

 SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships (Business Head); Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships; Strategy and Growth Team
 








  





**About Us** 





 Qure.ai
 
 is a global healthtech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.
 



 Today, our technology has impacted
 **40M\+ lives** 
 across
 **105\+ countries** 
 , deployed across
 **5,200\+ sites** 
 , and powered by one of the world’s largest real\-world medical imaging datasets. With
 **26 FDA\-cleared indications** 
 , we are helping shape the future of AI\-driven healthcare.
 



  





  





**The Opportunity** 




 Qure.ai’s AI solutions are already embedded in the workflows of leading pharmaceutical companies such as AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J. As pharma continues to be our fastest\-growing business in the US, this is a field\-facing, high\-ownership role at the forefront of driving our next phase of growth.
 



  





 You’ll report to the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads partnership strategy and deal development, and work closely with our Strategy and Growth Team, who support account planning, commercial collateral, and deal execution. You'll also collaborate with the SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads the business globally. In this role, you'll own the field\-building pipeline, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving opportunities from initial engagement through to successful closure.
 



 This role is designed as a high\-growth commercial path, with opportunities to take ownership of strategic accounts and grow into senior partnerships as the business scales.
 



  





 If you’re 3–5 years into a career in healthcare consulting, life sciences, digital health, or a client\-facing commercial role, and are eager to build strategic relationships, create new business opportunities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, field\-facing environment, this role is built for you.
 



  





  





**What You’ll Own \& Drive** 



* Build and manage a pipeline of pharma partnership opportunities across oncology, cardiology, respiratory and other priority therapeutic areas.
* Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders – including Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital Health and Commercial leads \- within strategic accounts including AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J, while expanding into new pharma logos.
* Represent Qure.ai at industry conferences, customer meetings and life sciences events across the US \- identifying new opportunities and converting engagements into qualified pipeline.

* Collaborate closely with the Strategy and Growth team to develop account plans, proposals, presentations, and commercial collateral that support successful customer engagements.
* Own the day\-to\-day commercial execution, including prospecting, outreach, meeting cadence, CRM management, follow\-ups, forecasting, and pipeline reporting.
* Develop a strong understanding of priority disease areas, clinical workflows, and Qure.ai's AI solutions to engage credibly with physicians, scientists, and pharmaceutical stakeholders.
* Drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, partnering with the Senior Director on commercial structuring, negotiations, and final approvals.








  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:
 


* Built and actively managed a qualified pipeline of strategic pharmaceutical partnership opportunities, with accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.
* Represented Qure.ai at major industry conferences and customer events, establishing meaningful relationships with key stakeholders across strategic pharmaceutical accounts.
* Successfully progressed at least one partnership opportunity from initial engagement through to contract execution, in collaboration with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships.
* Developed sufficient expertise across multiple disease areas and clinical workflows to independently lead introductory customer discussions and identify partnership opportunities.
* Established yourself as a trusted commercial partner through well\-developed account plans, disciplined pipeline management, and reliable execution



  





  





**Core Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of experience in strategy or management consulting, healthcare, life sciences, digital health, or pharmaceutical commercial roles, or another high\-performance, client\-facing environment.
* Bachelor's degree required; an MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Demonstrated success in building and managing client relationships, driving commercial opportunities, and delivering against commitments with a high degree of ownership.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders across pharmaceutical organizations.
* Strong analytical and learning agility, with the ability to quickly understand new disease areas, clinical workflows, and AI\-driven healthcare solutions.

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

title: Sr. CSM (Logistics Tech)
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

****ABOUT THE ROLE:****
 We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C\-suite. This is a senior individual\-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.
   

  

 At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross\-sell, and new teams and regions.
   

  

 You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C\-suite level.
* Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
* A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
* Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high\-impact experience.
* Lead discovery: deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
* Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C\-suite, aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
* Identify and drive expansion (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.
* Own customer questions and tickets: triage the issue, work with the Data team to get the answer, then review and communicate a clear resolution back to the customer.
* Run QBRs, success plans, and regular check\-ins, using data, outcomes, and clear narratives to drive adoption and expansion.
* Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to channel customer feedback and influence the roadmap.
* Analyze customer usage and data to surface actionable insights and continuously improve the customer journey.


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Logistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
* 7\+ years in a commercial, customer\-facing role, Customer Success, Account Management, Pre\-sales/Solutions, or Sales, within the logistics industry or logistics technology space.
* A pre\-sales or solutions background is highly valued. Strong discovery is one of the most important skills in this role, it's what lets you expand existing customers and drive new revenue.
* Logistics / logistics\-tech domain: familiarity with freight forwarding and global logistics workflows, and the ability to confidently engage customers across operations and commercial stakeholders.
* Comfortable with enterprise customers and their C\-suite, with strong stakeholder management across functions and seniority levels.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with basic data, APIs, and SaaS concepts, enough to handle customer questions and tickets, work with our Data team, and translate technical answers into clear customer\-facing resolutions.
* A track record of driving account expansion (upsell, cross\-sell) and revenue growth from existing customers.
* Experience running QBRs and structured account success plans, using data and outcomes to drive adoption and expansion.
* Excellent, structured communication, especially with complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise customers.
* High ownership and independence, with the ability to operate in a lean startup environment and a bias for action.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Work at the intersection of AI, data, and logistics: help enterprise customers turn predictive data into decisions and measurable business impact.
* Real impact from day one: we're lean by design, with few layers between you and the outcome, so your work moves adoption, retention, and expansion directly.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: This is where discovery lives. We dig beneath what a customer asks for to what they're actually trying to achieve, staying genuinely curious about their business, their workflows, and how a freight forwarder really operates. That depth is where every expansion starts.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome end to end, adoption, renewal, and expansion, and we stay on an account until the value is real and the number moves.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for a renewed contract. We aim for customers who adopt deeply, expand with us, and become advocates, and we hold ourselves to that standard on every account.
* Effectiveness: We focus on the outcomes that matter, real adoption, retention, and revenue growth from our customers, not check\-ins or activity for their own sake. We prioritize the accounts and conversations that actually move the business.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders

* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 6\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level

title: Manager, Travel Experience (Mumbai - Remote)
description:
As a Manager, Travel Experience Consultant, you will lead a dedicated team of Travel Consultants. This role requires a unique blend of people leadership, operational management, and relationship cultivation. You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day oversight of your team, ensuring they provide exceptional service, while also managing the strategic service relationship with the dedicated customer's Travel Manager and Specialists.
   

  

 Your leadership will be key to developing a high\-performing team, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring the success of the offline travel program for our most valued customers.
   

  

 This is a Remote Opportunity within Mumbai, requires candidate to be based in Mumbai.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* People Leadership \& Development: Serve as the frontline manager for a team of Business Travel Consultants. You will be responsible for coaching, training, and upskilling team members to deliver a best\-in\-class customer experience.
* Performance Management: Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and quarterly reviews to monitor progress, set clear expectations, and track career development using career maps. Provide continuous performance feedback to encourage desired behaviors and ensure alignment with corporate goals.
* Operational Management: Oversee the team's operational performance, monitoring call queues (ACD) and SLAs to ensure goals are met. You will perform root cause analysis on common service issues to develop and implement permanent corrective actions and process improvements.
* Customer Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for the dedicated customer's Travel Manager. You will conduct regular check\-ins, present performance statistics, and collaborate on improvement plans and service enhancements.
* Issue \& Escalation Resolution:Take ownership of customer escalations, managing and resolving issues from start to finish. You will coach your team to proactively address traveler inquiries and aim for first\-contact resolution. As Manager, you may also need to step in and directly handle escalated chats and calls to ensure prompt and effective resolution.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Collaborate with the wider support team to meet performance and behavior metrics. You will work with your manager to prioritize and address customer requests for product and service enhancements. You will also communicate transparently with the dedicated customer about service improvements and corrective actions.
* Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding: Screen and interview new hires as the organization scales. You will provide input for the New Hire Training Program and ensure its effective execution for modules delivered by the support team.
* Administrative Oversight: Manage approvals for employee travel bookings and handle Resignation Conversations with departing employees. You will lead these discussions with respect and curiosity, documenting insights to help improve the company.
* Engagement \& Culture: Organize team engagement activities, both in\-person and remote, to foster a positive, collaborative, and high\-performing team culture.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in a contact center or support environment, with at least 5 years of experience at the manager level.
* Industry Expertise: A minimum of 5 years of experience in the travel industry, with deep knowledge of GDS platforms (Sabre and/or Amadeus).
* Customer Focus: A proven ability to live and breathe customer support, with a commitment to high customer engagement and a passion for resolving complex customer issues.
* Leadership Skills: A track record of building relationships, motivating teams, and acting as a proven mentor. You should have a clear understanding of the challenges facing a fast\-growing company.
* Analytical Abilities: The ability to use a data\-driven approach to identify operational challenges and inform strategic decisions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Technical Acumen: Familiarity with CRM applications (e.g., Salesforce, Twilio) and contact center applications (e.g., Calabrio, WorkDay).
* Personal Attributes: Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills. You should be able to work independently and as part of a team, and be flexible to work non\-traditional shifts as needed.
* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred.


**What Sets You Apart**
* A reputation as a resolution\-focused leader who champions change and consistently exceeds expectations.
* A proven ability to proactively identify and implement process improvements.
* A passion for developing others and fostering a solutions\-oriented team culture.

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully\-billable, high\-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.
   

  

 You will act as the key strategic advisor and point of accountability, building trust with executive stakeholders and ensuring the customer's long\-term success on the platform.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Program Accountability: Assume ultimate accountability for establishing, executing and overseeing program governance to deliver strategic value\-realization and recovery plans for strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear governance frameworks for complex multi\-cloud and enterprise AI implementation roadmaps.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with C\-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics, and demonstrate measurable platform ROI. You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation \& ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.
* Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary, billable expert providing strategic oversight to ensure program delivery aligns with the customer's core business objectives.
* Risk \& Scope Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, dependencies, and scope changes. You will own the executive\-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.
* Commercial Acumen: Lead and support pre\-sales teams in initial scoping, change management, and identifying opportunities for expansion of the running program, accurately sizing the organizational change management and delivery effort required for generative AI and digital agent rollouts.
* Delivery Governance: Define, structure, and oversee complex engagement models (e.g., T\&M, Fixed Price), ensuring all delivery commitments, milestones, and scope are meticulously managed. You will champion an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross\-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a deep subject matter expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, industry trends, and best\-practice implementation strategies involving custom development, integration, and data migration.
* Contract Management: Prior experience in understanding and working with MSA/SOW and ensuring delivery is compliant to the terms laid out there.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 15\+ years of experience, predominantly in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large\-scale, complex SaaS/CRM program implementations.
* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C\-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high\-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at\-risk customer environments.
* Cross\-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi\-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre\-sales \& delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well\-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well\-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self\-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer \& internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Certifications: Must have at least either of these Project management certification (PMI\-ACP / PMP / PgMP / Prince 2\) and having Salesforce Certification is an asset. An AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Wealth Manager
description:
**Locations:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Industry:** 
 Wealth Management
 



**Company:** 
 Stockify Fintech
 



**Package:** 

 Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus (3\-6 months salary)
 








**About Stockify** 




  






 Stockify is building India's most trusted marketplace for pre\-IPO and unlisted shares, giving HNI and UHNI investors access to exclusive investment opportunities before companies go public. We cover a wide universe of high\-growth unlisted companies across sectors and provide investors with pricing, research and seamless transaction support. Our offices are in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurugram and Dubai, and we are expanding our wealth management team aggressively to serve the growing demand from sophisticated investors.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are hiring experienced Wealth Managers for our Mumbai office. This is a senior client\-facing role where you will manage a portfolio of HNI and UHNI investors, advise them on pre\-IPO and unlisted share investment opportunities, and drive AUM and revenue growth for Stockify. The role combines relationship management, investment advisory and business development in equal measure.
 




  






 This is the right role for a wealth professional who already understands how HNI clients think, has experience with alternative investments or capital markets products, and wants to work in one of the most exciting and high\-growth segments of Indian finance. You will have the full backing of Stockify's research, operations and technology teams, but the relationships you build and the revenue you generate will be very much your own.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  




* Build, manage and grow a dedicated book of HNI and UHNI clients who are interested in pre\-IPO and unlisted share investments, with a focus on deepening relationships and increasing AUM over time
* Advise clients on specific unlisted share opportunities available on the Stockify platform, clearly explaining pricing, liquidity considerations, transfer timelines, risk factors and potential upside in a way that is suitable to their financial profile
* Proactively source new HNI leads through your personal network, referrals from existing clients, community events, industry associations and targeted outreach to high\-net\-worth individuals across Mumbai \& west India
* Conduct client meetings, portfolio reviews and investment update calls at regular intervals, keeping clients informed on the performance of their holdings and new opportunities that match their profile
* Cross\-sell Stockify's broader investment offering to existing clients and introduce referrals to the B2B sales team where appropriate
* Work closely with the back office team to ensure smooth and timely execution of all client transactions, including documentation, share transfer and settlement
* Maintain detailed and up\-to\-date records of all client interactions, portfolios, upcoming transactions and follow\-ups in the CRM on a daily basis
* Represent Stockify professionally at investor events, wealth management conferences and community gatherings to build brand visibility and source new relationships



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* Three to six years of experience in wealth management, private banking, investment advisory or relationship management within a financial services organisation
* A strong and demonstrable existing network of HNI clients in Mumbai and west India who trust your investment recommendations and are open to alternative investments
* Prior experience advising clients on alternative investment products such as PMS, AIF, unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investments, structured products or private equity is strongly preferred
* NISM certification in Mutual Funds Distribution or Investment Advisory is preferred; candidates without certification but with a strong track record will also be considered
* Excellent consultative selling skills, with the ability to explain complex investment ideas in a simple and compelling way without oversimplifying the risks involved
* High integrity, a client\-first approach and the professional maturity to build lasting relationships based on trust rather than transactional interactions
* Self\-motivated with the discipline to independently manage a pipeline, set your own outreach schedule and consistently deliver against revenue targets



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  




* Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus
* Performance Incentives: Bonus of up to 3 to 6 months of monthly salary, paid based on individual and company performance
* Review Cycle: Performance review at 6 months with potential for salary revision, with earning potential that grows significantly with AUM and revenue performance

title: AVP/Manager - Special projects (Consumer awareness & Skilling)
description:
**About the Job:**



1. Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE) is a non\-profit industry association and RBI\-recognised Self\-Regulatory Organisation in the FinTech sector (SRO\-FT). FinTech companies come together at FACE to facilitate consumer\-centric digital financial services that are safe, suitable, and transparent, delivering positive impacts on society and the economy. Please visit our website and refer to the SRO\-FT Framework to understand our work.
2. As an industry association and SRO\-FT, FACE works with the FinTech ecosystem towards innovative, sustainable, and responsible conduct in the FinTech sector, delivering consumer progress and well\-being in line with public policy objectives. The work requires working with a) the supply side, i.e. industry, to improve their employees’ capacity and awareness of conduct and compliance and b) the demand side, i.e. consumers, to improve their understanding of risks, rewards, rights and responsibilities with respect to digital financial services.
3. In this context, we are seeking professionals to join FACE for special projects on consumer awareness of digital financial services and skilling for the FinTech/BFSI sector. The work will involve the complete value chain of the projects, comprising proposal development, partnerships, stakeholder engagement, execution, monitoring, communication and reporting.
4. Location preference is Mumbai, but open to suitable candidates in other locations as well. Position and salary commensurate with work experience and skill sets.



  





**Responsibilities:**



* Identify and develop high\-impact and scalable projects for consumer empowerment\[1] and skilling/training\[2] in line with strategic objectives of FACE.
* Develop proposals, funding plans, and maintain a pipeline of opportunities.
* Ownership of approved projects by converting ideas into detailed proposals with implementation plans, partnership framework, budgets, timelines, milestones, KPIs and measurable outcomes.
* Close engagement with FinTech industry/FACE members, foundations, civil society organisations, educational/training/skilling institutions and certification bodies, implementation agencies, vendors and other ecosystem stakeholders, apex bodies relevant to the project.
* Coordinate internal team, members/stakeholder and implementation partners to monitor progress and risks for timely corrective action and delivery within scope.
* Identify and assess implementation partners/vendors, define deliverables and reporting requirements, support negotiations and agreements, and monitor performance.
* Manage approved projects within agreed scope, timelines and budgets, monitor risks and ensure timely corrective action.
* Prepare project budgets and utilisation plans; track expenditure, review supporting documents and maintain complete documentation, compliance records and audit trails.
* Develop and track KPIs and prepare MIS, dashboards, management reports, and impact reports etc., covering delivery, budgets, reach and outcomes.
* Communication for project activities including events, workshops for dissemination across communication channels, ensuring consistency, timeliness and brand alignment.
* Contribute to other priorities and cross\-functional tasks as required.



  





**Selection Criteria:**



* Graduate/Post\-graduate
* Relevant experience in project management, stakeholder engagement, communications, preferably in the area of FinTech/digital financial services, consumer education, skilling/training ecosystem, grant/CSR funded initiatives projects.
* Understanding of the BFSI and FinTech ecosystem would be a significant advantage.
* Excellent research, analytical, writing and presentation skills, with the ability to prepare clear proposals, concept notes, reports, briefs and stakeholder communications.
* Strong project planning, budgeting, and fund management with proficiency in work and productivity software like Google/MS Office.
* Comfort with digital communication tools and basic design capability using Canva, PowerPoint or similar tools.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across levels and stakeholders.
* Highly organised, self\-driven, collaborative, and adaptable, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in an evolving environment.



  





**How to Apply:**




 5\.     Please send your latest CV and current CTC to teamface@faceofindia.org with AVP/Manager, Special Project in the subject line.
 



  





 \[1] Such as financial literacy for digital financial services, responsible digital financial behaviour, data/privacy/safety, fraud prevention, and financial health, with a special focus on excluded vulnerable segments like youth, women and rural communities
